words.ex: He will enroll in the English course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将注册英语课程。
words.en: To officially register or enlist oneself or someone else in a course, institution, or organization.

words.tr: n. 入会；入学 ；登记；注册；加入人数
words.ex: His enrollment in the club was approved last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周被批准加入该俱乐部。
words.en: The act of officially joining a course, school, etc., or the number of people who do this.

words.tr: phrase. 新生入学指导；学生迎新活动
words.ex: The student orientation helps new students find their classrooms.
words.ex_cn: 新生入学指导帮助新生找到他们的教室。
words.en: An event or program designed to introduce new students to a school or university, its services, and its policies.

words.ex: He completed the registration for the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了这门课程的登记。
words.en: Registration is the act of officially recording something, especially in an official list or record.

words.ex: He completed the deregistration before leaving the school.
words.ex_cn: 他离开学校前完成了注销手续。
words.en: The act of removing or canceling the registration of something.

words.tr: n. 记录员；登记员；教务主任
words.ex: The registrar gave me my schedule.
words.ex_cn: 注册处给我发了课表。
words.en: A registrar is an official keeper of records, especially in an educational institution, who is responsible for student records and registration.

words.tr: phrase. 系主任；部门负责人
words.ex: The department chair speaks to students every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 系主任每周一和学生谈话。
words.en: The person who is in charge of a department in a college or university, responsible for its administration and academic programs.

words.ex: The chairperson spoke at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 主席在会议上发言。
words.en: A chairperson is the person in charge of a meeting, committee, or organization.

words.tr: n. 主席；主持人；董事长；
words.ex: The chairman called the meeting to order.
words.ex_cn: 主席宣布会议开始。
words.en: A chairman is a man who is in charge of a meeting, committee, or organization.

words.ex: I will make an appointment with the doctor tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天要预约医生。
words.en: To arrange a meeting or consultation at a specific time.

words.ex: The course of the river changed after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 河流的流程在洪水后发生了变化。
words.en: A course is a series of lessons or lectures on a particular subject.

words.ex: The school changed its curriculum last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年学校更改了课程。
words.en: A curriculum is the subjects that are studied in a school, college, or university.

words.ex: We attended a workshop on writing skills.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了一个关于写作技巧的研讨会。
words.en: A workshop is a room or building where things are made or repaired using tools or machinery. It can also refer to a meeting at which a group of people engage in intensive discussion and activity on a particular subject or project.

words.ex: He attended a seminar on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个关于气候变化的研讨会。
words.en: A seminar is a meeting where a group of people discuss a problem or topic.

words.tr: phrase. 课程负担；学生在某一学期内所修的课程总量
words.ex: He has a heavy course load this semester.
words.ex_cn: 他这学期课程负担很重。
words.en: The amount of coursework a student is taking in a given term.

words.tr: phrase. 课程指南；课程指导方针
words.ex: The teacher gave us the course guideline on the first day.
words.ex_cn: 老师在第一天给了我们课程指南。
words.en: A course guideline is a document that provides information and instructions about a particular course, including its objectives, content, and requirements.

words.ex: The school changed the course arrangement for next semester.
words.ex_cn: 学校更改了下学期的课程安排。
words.en: The organization and scheduling of courses within an educational program.

words.ex: He checks the course schedule every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都查看课程表。
words.en: A timetable showing the times at which particular events or activities are planned to happen, especially in the context of educational courses.

words.ex: He submitted his academic record to the university.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的学业成绩提交给了大学。
words.en: A document that provides a detailed account of a student's academic performance, including grades, courses taken, and degrees awarded.

words.ex: The coach raised a warning flag when the player looked tired.
words.ex_cn: 当球员看起来疲惫时，教练举起了警告旗。
words.en: A warning flag is a piece of cloth or other material used as a signal to indicate danger or a problem, especially in contexts like beaches, roads, or sports.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；
n. 大调；主修课；
words.ex: Math is a major subject in school.
words.ex_cn: 数学是学校里的主要科目。
words.en: A major is a student's principal field of study or specialization in college or university.

words.tr:
adj. 次要的；轻微的；小的；小调的；
n. 未成年人；
words.ex: The mistake was a minor error.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误是一个小错误。
words.en: A minor is a person who is under the age at which they legally become an adult.

words.tr: phrase. 宣布主修专业；选定主修科目
words.ex: He will declare a major in biology next semester.
words.ex_cn: 他下学期将选择生物作为专业。
words.en: Formally choose a main field of study for a degree.

words.ex: He got an exemption from paying the fee.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了免交费用的豁免。
words.en: An exemption is an official permission not to do something or not to pay something that you would normally have to do or pay.

words.tr:
n. 信用；赊账；赞扬；贷款；荣誉；
v. 相信；
words.ex: He has good credit with the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他在银行有良好的信用。
words.en: If you are allowed credit, you are allowed to pay for goods or services several weeks or months after you have received them.

words.ex: He wants to transfer the credits to a new school.
words.ex_cn: 他想把学分转到新学校。
words.en: Move academic credits from one institution to another.

words.ex: Math is a required course for all freshmen.
words.ex_cn: 数学是所有大一新生的必修课。
words.en: A required course is a course that students must take to complete their degree or program.

words.ex: Math is a compulsory course for all students.
words.ex_cn: 数学是所有学生的必修课。
words.en: A compulsory course is a subject that students are required to take as part of their curriculum.

words.ex: He took a selective course in photography.
words.ex_cn: 他选了一门摄影选修课。
words.en: A course that students can choose to take as part of their studies, rather than a required course.

words.tr: phrase. 选修课程；非必修的课程
words.ex: He takes an elective course in music.
words.ex_cn: 他选修了一门音乐课。
words.en: An elective course is a course that students can choose to take as part of their studies, which is not compulsory but allows them to explore subjects of interest outside their main field of study.

words.ex: She took an optional course in photography.
words.ex_cn: 她选了一门摄影选修课。
words.en: A course that is not required for a degree but can be chosen.

words.ex: You need basic math as a prerequisite for this course.
words.ex_cn: 你学习这门课程的前提是掌握基础数学。
words.en: A prerequisite is something that must exist or happen before something else can exist or happen.

words.tr: phrase. 初步名单；预备清单
words.ex: He made a preliminary list of tasks for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他列了一个明天任务的初步清单。
words.en: An initial, not final, list of items or names.

words.tr: adj. 引导的；介绍的；开端的；
words.ex: This is an introductory book for beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这是一本为初学者引导的书。
words.en: An introductory remark, event, or action is one that comes at the beginning of something, often in order to explain or introduce it.

words.ex: He is learning elementary math at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习初级数学。
words.en: Elementary means relating to the simplest and most basic aspects of a subject.

words.tr: adj. 基本的；基础的；根本的；
words.ex: Water is a fundamental need for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本需求。
words.en: You use fundamental to describe things, activities, and principles that are very important or essential. They affect the basic nature of other things or are the most important element upon which other things depend.

words.tr: adj. 首要的；小学的；初等的；原来的；最初的；
words.ex: Primary goal is to stay safe.
words.ex_cn: 首要目标是保持安全。
words.en: Something that is primary is more important than anything else.

words.ex: This is a basic math skill.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个基本的数学技能。
words.en: You use basic to describe things, activities, and principles that are very important or necessary, and on which others depend.

words.ex: He is an intermediate student in English.
words.ex_cn: 他是英语的中级学生。
words.en: An intermediate stage, level, or position is one that occurs between two other stages, levels, or positions.

words.tr: adj. 中等的；次要的；第二的；
words.ex: He attends a secondary school in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他在城里上一所中学。
words.en: If you describe something as secondary, you mean that it is less important than something else.

words.tr: adj. 先进的；高级的； v. 提前；前进；“advance”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: This school uses advanced technology in classrooms.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校在教室里使用先进的技术。
words.en: An advanced system, method, or design is modern and has been developed from an earlier version of the same thing.

words.ex: He loves reading poetry before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在睡前读诗歌。
words.en: Poetry is the expression of ideas and feelings through the use of distinctive style and rhythm.

words.ex: He wrote a short poem for his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他为母亲写了一首短诗。
words.en: A poem is a piece of writing in which the words are chosen for their beauty and sound and are carefully arranged, often in short lines which rhyme.

words.ex: He is a famous poet who writes simple poems.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位写简单诗歌的著名诗人。
words.en: A poet is a person who writes poems.

words.tr: phrase. 课程容量；指教育体系或学校在特定时间内能够提供的课程数量或承载的学生人数
words.ex: The curriculum capacity of this school is 500 students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校的课程容量是500名学生。
words.en: The maximum number of students a curriculum can accommodate.

words.tr: n. 开口；开幕；空缺职位；“opening”的复数
words.ex: The holes in the wall are small openings.
words.ex_cn: 墙上的洞是小开口。
words.en: Openings refer to the act of making or becoming open, or the beginning of something. It can also refer to opportunities or positions that are available.

words.tr: phrase. 房间分配表；宿舍房间安排表
words.ex: Please check the room assignment sheet to find out your room number.
words.ex_cn: 请查看房间分配表以了解您的房间号。
words.en: A document or list that shows which rooms have been assigned to which people, often used in hotels, schools, or conferences.

words.ex: He put a note on the bulletin board.
words.ex_cn: 他把一张便条贴在公告栏上。
words.en: A bulletin board is a board on a wall which notices can be pinned to.

words.tr: phrase. 开设一门课程；提供一堂课
words.ex: The school will offer a class in algebra next term.
words.ex_cn: 学校下学期将开设一门代数课程。
words.en: Provide a course for students to enroll in.

words.ex: He adds two and three to get five.
words.ex_cn: 他把二和三相加得到五。
words.en: To put something together with something else so as to increase the size, number, or amount.

words.tr:
v. 落下；掉下；
n. 滴；下落；
words.ex: The apple dropped from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 苹果从树上落了下来。
words.en: If you drop something, you accidentally let it fall.

words.tr: phrase. 特殊添加表单（用于特定用途的附加信息填写表格）
words.ex: He filled out a special add form for the event.
words.ex_cn: 他为这个活动填写了一份特殊的附加表格。
words.en: A specific form used to request special permission or addition.

words.tr: phrase. 缺课；旷课；错过上课
words.ex: He missed class because he was sick.
words.ex_cn: 他因为生病而没上课。
words.en: To fail to attend a class or lecture.

words.ex: He skipped class yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天逃课了。
words.en: To intentionally not attend a class or school without permission.

words.ex: The attendance rate in class is very high.
words.ex_cn: 课堂的出勤率很高。
words.en: The proportion of people who attend an event, such as a school, meeting, or performance, compared to the number expected or invited.

words.ex: He improves his grade with good class participation.
words.ex_cn: 他通过积极的课堂参与提高成绩。
words.en: Active involvement in classroom discussions and activities, often assessed for grading.

words.ex: He starts his new class in the fall semester.
words.ex_cn: 他在秋季学期开始他的新课程。
words.en: A semester is one of the two periods that the school or college year is divided into, especially in the United States and Canada.

words.tr:
n. 术语；学期；期限；措辞；
v. 把…称作；把…叫做；
words.ex: The word 'algorithm' is a technical term in computer science.
words.ex_cn: ‘算法’是计算机科学中的一个术语。
words.en: A term is a word or expression used in relation to a particular subject, especially one that has a specific meaning, or a fixed period of time during which something lasts or is intended to happen.

words.tr: n. 四分之一；季度；一刻钟；地区；方向；
words.ex: He ate a quarter of the pizza.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了四分之一的比萨。
words.en: A quarter is one of four equal parts of something, or a period of three months.

words.tr: phrase. 注册；登记；报名参加（课程、活动等）
words.ex: Students need to register for their courses before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要在截止日期前注册他们的课程。
words.en: To officially sign up or enroll in a course, event, or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 报名参加；注册（某项活动、课程或服务）
words.ex: He wants to sign up for the English class.
words.ex_cn: 他想报名参加英语课。
words.en: To agree to become involved in an organized activity.

words.tr: v. 入学；招收( enrol的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is enrolling in university next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将入学大学。
words.en: To officially register or enter someone as a member of a group or a student at an institution.

words.tr:
n. 大楼；大厦；块；街区；障碍物；
v. 阻塞；阻碍；
words.ex: The new block is next to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这栋新大楼就在公园旁边。
words.en: A block is a large solid piece of material with flat surfaces on each side. As a verb, to block means to prevent movement or progress.

words.ex: He finished his homework before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他在截止日期前完成了作业。
words.en: A deadline is a time or date before which a particular task must be finished or a particular thing must be done.

words.ex: He signed his name with a clear signature.
words.ex_cn: 他用清晰的签名签了名字。
words.en: A signature is a person's name written in a distinctive way as a form of identification in authorizing a document or letter.

words.ex: He needs to get his signature on the form.
words.ex_cn: 他需要在表格上签名。
words.en: To obtain someone's written name on a document, typically for authorization or verification.

words.ex: The teacher gave her approval for the project.
words.ex_cn: 老师对这个项目表示了赞成。
words.en: If you give your approval to something, you agree with it or allow it to happen.

words.ex: He asked for permission to leave early.
words.ex_cn: 他请求允许早点离开。
words.en: If someone who has authority over you gives you permission to do something, they say that they will allow you to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 学术顾问；负责为学生提供课程选择、学业规划等建议的教师或工作人员
words.ex: My academic advisor helped me choose my classes.
words.ex_cn: 我的学术顾问帮我选了课程。
words.en: An academic advisor is a person who helps students with their educational planning and career choices.

words.tr: n. 顾问；咨询师；法律顾问；
words.ex: He asked his counselor for advice about his future.
words.ex_cn: 他向他的顾问咨询了关于未来的问题。
words.en: A counselor is a person whose job is to give advice to people who need it, especially advice on their personal problems.

words.ex: The faculty of engineering has many labs.
words.ex_cn: 工程学院有许多实验室。
words.en: A faculty is a group of departments in a university or college that specialize in a particular subject or group of subjects, or the teachers in such a group.

words.ex: The instructor explained the math problem clearly.
words.ex_cn: 教员清楚地讲解了这道数学题。
words.en: An instructor is someone who teaches a skill or subject, especially in a college or university, or in a specialized field such as driving or skiing.

words.ex: My mentor helped me choose my career path.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮助我选择了职业道路。
words.en: A mentor is a person who gives a younger or less experienced person help and advice over a period of time, especially at work or school.

words.ex: The dean gave a speech at the graduation ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 院长在毕业典礼上发表了演讲。
words.en: A dean is a senior official in a college or university, who is in charge of a faculty or department or a group of students.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；最重要的；
n. 校长；负责人；
words.ex: The principal reason for his success is hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的主要原因是努力工作。
words.en: The person with the highest authority or most important position in an organization, institution, or group.

words.ex: The president signed the new contract.
words.ex_cn: 总裁签署了新合同。
words.en: The president is the elected head of a republic or the head of a company or organization.

words.ex: The chancellor announced a new tax policy.
words.ex_cn: 大臣宣布了一项新的税收政策。
words.en: A chancellor is the head of the government in some countries, or a high-ranking official in a university or other institution.

words.ex: He is a freshman at university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学的一名新生。
words.en: A freshman is a student in the first year of high school, college, or university.

words.ex: He is a sophomore at Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的二年级学生。
words.en: A sophomore is a student in the second year of college or high school.

words.tr:
adj. （职位或等级）较低的；年幼的；（高中、大学的）三年级学生；
n. 年幼者；
words.ex: He is a junior employee in the company.
words.ex_cn: 他是公司里职位较低的员工。
words.en: A junior person is younger or has a lower position than another person.

words.tr:
adj. 资深的；高级的；年长的；
n. 年长者；大四学生；
words.ex: He is a senior engineer with 20 years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有20年经验的资深工程师。
words.en: Higher in rank, status, or importance; older in age.

words.ex: All new students must attend the orientation meeting on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 所有新生必须参加周一的新生报到会。
words.en: An orientation meeting is a gathering designed to introduce new members, employees, or students to an organization or institution, providing them with essential information and helping them to adapt to their new environment.

words.tr: phrase. 新生/新员工介绍会；迎新培训；情况说明会
words.ex: The orientation session starts at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 迎新会早上九点开始。
words.en: An orientation session is a meeting or series of meetings designed to introduce new members to an organization or environment, providing them with information and training to help them adapt and understand their roles.

words.ex: You have three options to choose from.
words.ex_cn: 你有三个选项可以选择。
words.en: An option is something that you can choose to do in preference to one or more alternatives.

words.tr: phrase. 在线课程；网络课程
words.ex: She enrolled in an online course to improve her programming skills.
words.ex_cn: 她报名参加了一个在线课程，以提高她的编程技能。
words.en: An online course is a program of study that is conducted over the internet, allowing students to learn from anywhere at any time.

words.ex: The company hired an expert to do an audit.
words.ex_cn: 公司聘请了一位专家进行审计。
words.en: An audit is an official examination of the accounts of a business or organization to check that they are accurate and correct.

words.tr: n. 开始；毕业典礼；学位授予典礼
words.ex: The commencement of the class was at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 课程的开始时间是上午9点。
words.en: The commencement of something is its beginning.

words.ex: My brother walked at the graduation ceremony last week.
words.ex_cn: 我哥哥上周参加了毕业典礼。
words.en: A graduation ceremony is an event where students receive their academic degrees or diplomas.

words.ex: He attends class every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上上课。
words.en: To be present at a class or lecture as part of a course of study.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a handout about photosynthesis.
words.ex_cn: 老师发给我们一份关于光合作用的讲义。
words.en: A handout is a document which contains news or information about something and which is given, for example, to journalists or to people attending a talk or lecture.

words.ex: The professor gave a lecture on history.
words.ex_cn: 教授上了一节历史课。
words.en: A lecture is a talk that someone gives in order to teach people about a particular subject, often at a university or college.

words.ex: My tutor helps me with math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮我做数学作业。
words.en: A tutor is someone who gives private lessons to one pupil or a very small group of pupils.

words.ex: He gave a presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的报告。
words.en: The act of showing or explaining something to an audience.

words.ex: He attended a seminar on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个关于气候变化的研讨会。
words.en: A seminar is a meeting where a group of people discuss a problem or topic.

words.ex: We attended a workshop on writing skills.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了一个关于写作技巧的研讨会。
words.en: A workshop is a room or building where things are made or repaired using tools or machinery. It can also refer to a meeting at which a group of people engage in intensive discussion and activity on a particular subject or project.

words.ex: The teacher gave us the syllabus for the course.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们这门课的教学大纲。
words.en: A syllabus is an outline or summary of the main points of a text, lecture, or course of study.

words.tr:
n. 文本；课文；
v. 发短信；
words.ex: He read the text carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他仔细阅读了文本。
words.en: Text refers to any written material, especially the main body of a book or other piece of writing, as distinct from illustrations, notes, or appendices.

words.ex: He bought a new textbook for math class.
words.ex_cn: 他为数学课买了一本新教科书。
words.en: A textbook is a book containing a comprehensive compilation of content in a branch of study with the intention of explaining it. Textbooks are produced to meet the needs of educators, usually at educational institutions.

words.ex: He read the first chapter of the book.
words.ex_cn: 他读了这本书的第一章。
words.en: A chapter is one of the parts that a book is divided into. Each chapter has a number, and sometimes a title.

words.tr:
n. 幻灯片；滑梯；
v. （使）滑动；下滑；
words.ex: He showed a slide of his vacation photos.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了一张他度假照片的幻灯片。
words.en: To move smoothly along a surface while maintaining continuous contact with it; to pass or move quietly or smoothly; a structure with a smooth sloping surface for children to slide down; a decline from a higher to a lower level or status.

words.tr: phrase. 指定教材；必修课本
words.ex: The teacher said the required textbook is on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 老师说所需的教科书在书架上。
words.en: A textbook that is mandatory for a particular course or subject.

words.tr: phrase. 等级制度；评分系统；分级体系
words.ex: The school uses a simple grading system to evaluate students.
words.ex_cn: 学校使用一个简单的等级制度来评估学生。
words.en: A grading system is a method used to assess and categorize students' academic performance based on predefined criteria.

words.ex: He made eye contact with the teacher during the lesson.
words.ex_cn: 他在上课时与老师进行了眼神交流。
words.en: The act of looking directly into someone's eyes as a means of communication or to express interest.

words.ex: His intonation made the sentence sound friendly.
words.ex_cn: 他的语调让这句话听起来很友好。
words.en: Intonation is the way the voice rises and falls in speech, especially the pitch pattern in a sentence.

words.ex: The movie is fascinating because it shows strange aliens.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极有吸引力，因为它展示了奇怪的外星人。
words.en: If you describe something as fascinating, you find it very interesting and attractive, and your thoughts tend to concentrate on it.

words.ex: The movie was fantastic!
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极好！
words.en: If you describe something as fantastic, you are emphasizing that you think it is very good or that you like it a lot.

words.tr: phrase. 发人深省的；引人思考的
words.ex: The movie was thought provoking.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影发人深省。
words.en: Causing people to think seriously about a particular subject or issue.

words.tr: adj. 激励人的；有刺激性的；振奋人的； v. “stimulate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The teacher gave a stimulating talk to the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师给学生们做了一场激励人的演讲。
words.en: Making you feel enthusiastic and full of ideas.

words.ex: He has a good sense of humor.
words.ex_cn: 他有很好的幽默感。
words.en: The ability to perceive and express or appreciate humor.

words.tr: adj. 无聊的；令人厌倦的； v. “bore”的现在分词；
words.ex: The movie was boring.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很无聊。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as boring, you mean that they are not interesting and make you feel tired or impatient.

words.tr:
n. 笔记；便条；音调；注释；语气；
v. 注意；记录；
words.ex: I took notes during the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我在讲座期间做了笔记。
words.en: A note is a short piece of writing, a musical sound, or a piece of paper money. It can also mean to pay attention to something or to write something down.

words.ex: He sends an email every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上发一封电子邮件。
words.en: Email is a system for sending messages from one computer to another via the Internet.

words.ex: The ticket is your admission to the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这张票是进入音乐会的许可。
words.en: An admission is a statement in which you admit that something bad, unpleasant, or embarrassing is true, or the act of allowing someone to enter a place or organization.

words.ex: He called an emergency doctor when he felt sick.
words.ex_cn: 当他感到不舒服时，他叫了急诊医生。
words.en: An emergency is an unexpected and usually dangerous situation that calls for immediate action.

words.ex: He oversleeps every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都睡过头。
words.en: To sleep longer than intended, especially so as to wake up late.

words.ex: This idea makes no sense.
words.ex_cn: 这个想法没有意义。
words.en: To be illogical, incoherent, or impossible to understand.

words.tr: phrase. 集中（精力；注意力等）于
words.ex: He focuses on his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上专心做作业。
words.en: to direct your attention or effort towards something specific

words.ex: He did not show up for class yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天没有来上课。
words.en: If someone shows up, they arrive somewhere, especially unexpectedly or after they have been waiting a long time.

words.ex: Don't mix up the red and blue paints.
words.ex_cn: 别把红色和蓝色的颜料弄混了。
words.en: To confuse or mistake one thing for another.

words.ex: Can you clarify your answer?
words.ex_cn: 你能澄清一下你的答案吗？
words.en: To clarify something means to make it easier to understand by explaining it more clearly.

words.ex: He will take a leave next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周要请假。
words.en: To take a period of time off from work or duty, often with permission.

words.tr: 短语动词. 退掉一门课程；放弃一门课程的学习
words.ex: He decided to drop a course because it was too hard.
words.ex_cn: 他决定退掉一门课，因为太难了。
words.en: To withdraw from a course before completion, typically to avoid a poor grade or due to scheduling conflicts.

words.tr: phrase. 退选一门课程；放弃上课
words.ex: I decided to drop a class because it was too difficult.
words.ex_cn: 我决定退课，因为太难了。
words.en: To withdraw from a course or class before its completion.

words.ex: The teacher will cancel the class tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会取消这节课。
words.en: To cancel a scheduled class, lesson, or appointment.

words.tr: phrase. 逃离课堂；离开教室
words.ex: He got out of the class early.
words.ex_cn: 他早早地离开了教室。
words.en: To avoid attending a class, often by leaving or not going.

words.ex: He works hard to keep pace with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以跟上同学的步伐。
words.en: To move or progress at the same rate as someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 教授的办公时间（学生可在此期间前往办公室向教授请教问题或讨论学业）
words.ex: The student visits the professor's office hour to ask questions.
words.ex_cn: 学生去教授的办公时间提问。
words.en: Time set aside by a professor for students to discuss academic matters.

words.ex: The students walk to the lecture hall for class.
words.ex_cn: 学生们走向礼堂上课。
words.en: A large room in a college or university where lectures are given.

words.tr: phrase. 时间段；时间档；预定的时间区间
words.ex: I have a time slot at 3 p.m. for the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 我下午三点有一个会议时段。
words.en: A specific period of time allocated for a particular activity or event.

words.ex: He often skips classes to play video games.
words.ex_cn: 他经常逃课去打电子游戏。
words.en: To intentionally not attend classes that one is supposed to attend.

words.ex: He misses classes because he is sick.
words.ex_cn: 他因为生病而缺课。
words.en: To fail to attend classes, resulting in absence.

words.tr: phrase. 学费（指大学或教育机构收取的费用）
words.ex: He pays tuition fees every semester.
words.ex_cn: 他每学期支付学费。
words.en: Tuition fees are the money that you pay to be taught, especially in a college or university.

words.ex: The practicum is an essential part of the medical school curriculum.
words.ex_cn: 实习课是医学院课程的重要组成部分。
words.en: A practicum is a course of study designed especially for the preparation of teachers and clinicians that involves the supervised practical application of previously studied theory.

words.ex: The instructor explained the math problem clearly.
words.ex_cn: 教员清楚地讲解了这道数学题。
words.en: An instructor is someone who teaches a skill or subject, especially in a college or university, or in a specialized field such as driving or skiing.

words.ex: The lecturer explains math clearly.
words.ex_cn: 这位授课老师讲解数学很清晰。
words.en: A lecturer is a person who gives lectures, especially as a profession.

words.tr: phrase. 春假（尤指美国学校在春季的假期）
words.ex: Many students travel during spring break to enjoy the warm weather.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生在春假期间旅行，享受温暖的天气。
words.en: A vacation period in early spring at universities and schools in some countries.

words.ex: My tutor helps me with math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮我做数学作业。
words.en: A tutor is someone who gives private lessons to one pupil or a very small group of pupils.

words.tr: v. 当家教；辅导；“tutor”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is tutoring math to middle school students.
words.ex_cn: 他正在给中学生当数学家教。
words.en: The act of teaching or instructing someone, especially in a one-to-one or small group setting.

words.ex: He takes general education classes to learn basic skills.
words.ex_cn: 他上通识教育课程来学习基本技能。
words.en: General education refers to the part of a student's education that is not focused on a specific field of study but rather on providing a broad foundation of knowledge and skills.

words.tr:
n. 试听；试唱；试演；听力
v. 试听；试音；试镜；让…试演
words.ex: He went to an audition for the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加学校话剧的试听。
words.en: An audition is a short performance given by an actor, dancer, or musician so that someone can decide if they are good enough to be in a play, film, or orchestra.

words.ex: The teacher used a pointer to show the map on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 老师用一根指物棒指着墙上的地图。
words.en: A pointer is a piece of advice or information which helps you to understand a situation or to find a way of making progress.

words.ex: The teacher used an overhead projector to show the diagram.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用高射投影机展示图表。
words.en: An overhead projector is a device that projects images or text onto a screen or wall, typically used in classrooms or meetings for presentations.

words.ex: The teacher will assign homework today.
words.ex_cn: 老师今天会布置作业。
words.en: To give someone a particular job or task; to allocate a resource or responsibility to a particular person or purpose.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a math assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一份数学作业。
words.en: An assignment is a task or piece of work that you are given to do, especially as part of your job or studies.

words.ex: He finished his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭前完成了家庭作业。
words.en: Homework is school work that teachers give to pupils to do at home in the evening or at the weekend.

words.tr:
n. 锻炼；行使；练习；
v. 运用；使用；锻炼；
words.ex: He does exercise every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上锻炼以保持健康。
words.en: Physical activity that you do to make your body strong and healthy.

words.tr:
n. 练习；实践；惯常做法；
v. 从事；练习；
words.ex: Daily practice helps you improve your skills.
words.ex_cn: 每天的练习帮助你提高技能。
words.en: Practice is the act of rehearsing a behavior over and over, or engaging in an activity again and again, for the purpose of improving or mastering it, as in the phrase 'practice makes perfect'.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a handout about photosynthesis.
words.ex_cn: 老师发给我们一份关于光合作用的讲义。
words.en: A handout is a document which contains news or information about something and which is given, for example, to journalists or to people attending a talk or lecture.

words.ex: He wrote his name on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上写了名字。
words.en: A material made from cellulose pulp, derived mainly from wood, rags, and certain grasses, processed into flexible sheets or rolls by deposit from an aqueous suspension, and used chiefly for writing, printing, drawing, wrapping, and covering walls.

words.ex: He wrote an essay about his summer trip.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于他暑假旅行的文章。
words.en: An essay is a short piece of writing on a particular subject.

words.ex: His thesis is that exercise improves memory.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点是锻炼能改善记忆力。
words.en: A thesis is a long piece of writing based on your own ideas and research that you do as part of a university degree, especially a higher degree such as a PhD.

words.ex: He wrote his dissertation on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的学位论文。
words.en: A dissertation is a long piece of writing on a particular subject, especially one written for a university degree.

words.tr: phrase. 研究论文；学术论文
words.ex: He wrote a research paper about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的研究论文。
words.en: A research paper is a piece of academic writing that provides analysis, interpretation, and argument based on in-depth independent research.

words.tr: phrase. 学期论文；学期报告（通常为大学课程结束时提交的学术论文）
words.ex: He wrote a term paper about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的学期论文。
words.en: A term paper is a research paper written by students over an academic term, accounting for a large part of a grade.

words.tr:
n. 报告；报道；
v. 报告；报道；
words.ex: He wrote a report about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份关于天气的报告。
words.en: A report is a detailed account or statement about a particular matter, especially in the form of an official document, after thorough investigation or consideration by an appointed person or body.

words.ex: He wrote a lab report after the science experiment.
words.ex_cn: 他在科学实验后写了一份实验报告。
words.en: A lab report is a document that describes and analyzes laboratory experiments conducted in a scientific context. It typically includes the purpose of the experiment, the methods used, the results obtained, and the conclusions drawn.

words.tr: phrase. 读书报告；对所读书籍的内容、主题和观点进行总结和分析的书面作业
words.ex: He wrote a book report about a detective story.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份关于侦探故事的读书报告。
words.en: A written assignment summarizing and analyzing a book, typically for educational purposes.

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.ex: He is working on a research project about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他正在做一个关于气候变化的研究项目。
words.en: A research project is a detailed and careful study of a specific topic or problem, often carried out over a period of time and involving the collection and analysis of information.

words.tr: phrase. 小组项目；团体作业
words.ex: Our group project on renewable energy sources received high praise from our professor.
words.ex_cn: 我们关于可再生能源的小组项目得到了教授的高度赞扬。
words.en: A group project is a task or assignment that requires a group of people to work together to complete it. It often involves collaboration, division of tasks, and collective responsibility for the outcome.

words.ex: He gave a short speech at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上做了一个简短的讲话。
words.en: Speech is the expression of or the ability to express thoughts and feelings by articulate sounds.

words.ex: He gave a presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的报告。
words.en: The act of showing or explaining something to an audience.

words.ex: The topic of our talk is climate change.
words.ex_cn: 我们谈话的话题是气候变化。
words.en: A topic is a particular subject that you discuss or write about.

words.tr:
n. 主题；学科；对象；
v. 使臣服；
adj. 易遭受…的；受…支配的；
words.ex: The subject of the book is ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的主题是古代历史。
words.en: A subject is something that is discussed, studied, or written about. It can also refer to a person or thing that is the focus of attention or action. In grammar, a subject is the part of a sentence that performs the action of the verb.

words.ex: The river is broad and slow.
words.ex_cn: 这条河宽阔而平缓。
words.en: Something that is broad is wide.

words.tr: phrase. 缩小范围；精简；使变窄
words.ex: He tried to narrow down the list of options.
words.ex_cn: 他试图缩小选项的范围。
words.en: To reduce the number of possibilities or choices.

words.tr: phrase. 感到不知所措；被压倒；被淹没（常指情绪或事务过多而难以应对）
words.ex: She is overwhelmed by too much homework.
words.ex_cn: 她被太多的作业压得喘不过气。
words.en: To feel completely overcome by a task or situation, unable to cope.

words.tr: phrase. 被淹没；忙得不可开交；被大量事务压得喘不过气
words.ex: He is swamped with homework every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都被作业压得喘不过气。
words.en: To be extremely busy or overwhelmed with work or tasks.

words.tr:
n. 内容；含量；
adj. 满足的；
words.ex: The content of the video is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这个视频的内容非常有趣。
words.en: Content refers to the things that are held or included in something, or the state of being happy and satisfied.

words.tr:
n. 轮廓；纲要；
v. 描画轮廓；概述；
words.ex: The artist drew the outline of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家画出了山的轮廓。
words.en: An outline is a line that shows or forms the outer edge of something, or a general description or plan showing the essential features of something but not the detail.

words.tr:
adj. 抽象的；非具体的；
n. 摘要；概要；抽象派艺术作品；
words.ex: The painting shows an abstract shape.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画展示了一个抽象的形状。
words.en: An abstract idea or way of thinking is based on general ideas rather than on real things and events.

words.ex: He gave a summary of the story at the end.
words.ex_cn: 他在结尾对故事做了总结。
words.en: A summary is a brief statement or account of the main points of something.

words.ex: The book has a short introduction at the beginning.
words.ex_cn: 这本书开头有一段简短的引言。
words.en: The act of presenting something new to someone or something, or the process of making something known or familiar to people.

words.tr: phrase. 文献综述；文献回顾
words.ex: He wrote a literature review for his research paper.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的研究论文写了一篇文献综述。
words.en: A literature review is a survey of scholarly sources on a specific topic. It provides an overview of current knowledge, allowing you to identify relevant theories, methods, and gaps in the existing research.

words.tr:
v. 引用；报价；
n. 引用；引文；报价；
words.ex: He quoted Shakespeare in his speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中引用了莎士比亚的话。
words.en: To repeat or copy out (a group of words from a text or speech), typically with an indication that one is not the original author or speaker.

words.tr: n. 来源；出处；源泉；源头；提供资料者；
words.ex: The river's source is in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的源头在山里。
words.en: The place, person, or thing from which something comes or can be obtained.

words.ex: The school needs more resources for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校需要为学生提供更多的资源。
words.en: A resource is a source or supply from which benefit is produced. Typically resources are materials, energy, services, staff, knowledge, or other assets that are transformed to produce benefit and in the process may be consumed or made unavailable.

words.tr:
n. 材料；原料；
adj. 物质的；
words.ex: The table is made of wood material.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是由木头材料制成的。
words.en: Material refers to the substance or substances from which a thing is made or can be made, or information or ideas for use in creating a book or other work.

words.tr: n. 参考；提及；介绍信；引用；
words.ex: Please use this book for reference.
words.ex_cn: 请使用这本书作为参考。
words.en: A reference is a mention of something or someone, or a letter or statement about someone's character or abilities.

words.ex: He added the bibliography at the end of his report.
words.ex_cn: 他在报告末尾添加了参考书目。
words.en: A bibliography is a list of the books and articles that have been used by someone when writing a particular book or article.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.ex: He found a new method to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了一种解决这个问题的新方法。
words.en: A method is a particular way of doing something.

words.ex: The teacher collected data from the students' tests.
words.ex_cn: 老师收集了学生测试的数据。
words.en: Data is information, especially facts or numbers, collected to be examined and considered and used to help decision-making, or information in an electronic form that can be stored and used by a computer.

words.ex: The statistics show a rise in sales last year.
words.ex_cn: 这些统计数字显示去年销售额有所上升。
words.en: Statistics is a branch of mathematics dealing with the collection, analysis, interpretation, presentation, and organization of data.

words.ex: The teacher showed a chart of temperatures.
words.ex_cn: 老师展示了一张温度图表。
words.en: A chart is a graphical representation of data, in which the data is represented by symbols, such as bars in a bar chart, lines in a line chart, or slices in a pie chart.

words.ex: He drew a graph to show the temperature changes.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一个图表来显示温度变化。
words.en: A graph is a mathematical diagram which shows the relationship between two or more sets of numbers or measurements.

words.ex: The teacher drew a diagram to explain the water cycle.
words.ex_cn: 老师画了一个图表来解释水循环。
words.en: A diagram is a simple drawing which consists mainly of lines and is used, for example, to explain how a machine works.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.tr: phrase. 社会调查；社会研究
words.ex: He did a social investigation about poverty.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一项关于贫困的社会调查。
words.en: Systematic study of social structures, behaviors, and issues within communities or groups.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a questionnaire about our habits.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们一份关于我们习惯的问卷。
words.en: A questionnaire is a written list of questions which are answered by a lot of people in order to provide information for a report or a survey.

words.tr: n. 观察；观测；注意；监视；(观察后的）意见；
words.ex: The scientist made an observation about the bird's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 科学家对这只鸟的行为进行了观察。
words.en: The act of noticing or watching something carefully in order to gain information.

words.tr:
n. 面试；访谈；
v. 面试；接见；
words.ex: He has an interview tomorrow for a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他明天有一场新工作的面试。
words.en: An interview is a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out if they are suitable for a job or a course of study.

words.ex: We had a discussion about homework.
words.ex_cn: 我们进行了一次关于作业的讨论。
words.en: A discussion is a conversation or debate about a specific topic.

words.ex: He did an analysis of the data.
words.ex_cn: 他对数据进行了分析。
words.en: Analysis is the process of considering something carefully or using statistical methods in order to understand it or explain it.

words.ex: He uses critical thinking to solve problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用批判性思维解决问题。
words.en: Critical thinking is the objective analysis and evaluation of an issue in order to form a judgment.

words.tr: phrase. 缺乏你自己的想法；缺少个人主见
words.ex: He just repeats what others say because he lacks your own ideas.
words.ex_cn: 他只是重复别人说的话，因为他缺乏你自己的想法。
words.en: To not have or be without your own original thoughts or concepts.

words.ex: He was punished for plagiarism in his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他因论文剽窃而受到惩罚。
words.en: Plagiarism is the practice of using or copying someone else's idea or work and pretending that you thought of it or created it.

words.ex: After the experiment, we reached a conclusion.
words.ex_cn: 实验结束后，我们得出了一个结论。
words.en: A conclusion is the last part of something, its end or result.

words.tr: phrase. 参考书区；参考资料部分；文献引用部分
words.ex: He checked the reference section for the book.
words.ex_cn: 他去参考文献区查找那本书。
words.en: The part of a library where reference materials, such as encyclopedias and dictionaries, are kept for in-library use only.

words.ex: He revised his answer to make it correct.
words.ex_cn: 他修正了他的答案，使其正确。
words.en: To revise something means to alter or amend it, especially in order to correct or improve it.

words.ex: He had to rewrite his essay after the teacher gave feedback.
words.ex_cn: 他在老师给出反馈后不得不重写他的作文。
words.en: If someone rewrites a piece of writing such as a book, an article, or a law, they write it in a different way in order to improve it or because circumstances have changed.

words.ex: He went back to retrieve his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他回去取回他的钥匙。
words.en: To retrieve something means to get it back from somewhere, especially after it has been lost or taken away.

words.ex: He wrote a draft of the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送之前写了这封信的草稿。
words.en: A draft is a preliminary version of a piece of writing, or a current of air in a room or other confined space. It can also refer to the act of selecting someone for a particular purpose or task, especially in sports or the military.

words.ex: The first version of the software had several bugs that needed to be fixed.
words.ex_cn: 该软件的第一版有几个需要修复的错误。
words.en: The initial or earliest form of something, such as a product or document.

words.tr: phrase. 最终草案；最后定稿
words.ex: He wrote the final draft yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天写了最终稿。
words.en: The last version of a document or piece of writing that is ready to be published or submitted.

words.ex: He finished his homework before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他在截止日期前完成了作业。
words.en: A deadline is a time or date before which a particular task must be finished or a particular thing must be done.

words.ex: The teacher will extend the deadline for the homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师会延长作业的截止日期。
words.en: To extend the deadline means to make the time by which something must be done or completed longer than originally planned.

words.tr: 短语动词. 请求延期
words.ex: He asked for extension because the homework was too hard.
words.ex_cn: 他因为作业太难而申请了延期。
words.en: To request additional time to complete a task or meet a deadline.

words.ex: She will organize a meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 她明天将安排一次会议。
words.en: To organize something means to arrange it in a systematic way, especially on a large scale.

words.ex: The percentage of students who passed the test was 85.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试的学生百分比是85。
words.en: A percentage is a proportion or ratio expressed as a fraction of 100.

words.ex: I recommend this book to you.
words.ex_cn: 我向你推荐这本书。
words.en: If someone recommends a person or thing to you, they suggest that you would find them good or useful.

words.ex: The theory of gravity explains why things fall down.
words.ex_cn: 重力理论解释了为什么东西会往下掉。
words.en: A theory is a formal idea or set of ideas that is intended to explain something.

words.ex: The manager asked for a weekly report on the work progress.
words.ex_cn: 经理要求每周报告工作进展。
words.en: The forward movement or development of work towards completion.

words.ex: He looked at the catalog to find the book.
words.ex_cn: 他翻看目录来找那本书。
words.en: A catalog is a list of things, such as the goods you can buy from a particular company, the objects in a museum, or the books in a library.

words.tr: phrase. 已出版的资料来源；已发表的信息来源
words.ex: He found the information in a published source.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个已出版的来源中找到了这些信息。
words.en: Information or data that has been formally released in print or digital form by an author or organization.

words.tr: phrase. 未发表的资料；未出版的来源
words.ex: He used an unpublished source for his research.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一个未发表的资料来做研究。
words.en: Information or material that has not been formally published or made public.

words.tr: phrase. 收集资料；搜集材料
words.ex: He gathers material for his science project.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的科学项目收集材料。
words.en: To collect information or data for a purpose, such as writing or research.

words.ex: He paraphrased the poem in simple words.
words.ex_cn: 他用简单的语言意译了这首诗。
words.en: To paraphrase means to express the meaning of something written or spoken using different words, especially to achieve greater clarity.

words.tr: 短语动词. 抓住主要思想；概括要点
words.ex: He tried to capture the main idea of the story.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抓住这个故事的主要意思。
words.en: To identify and record the central or most important point of a text or discussion.

words.tr: phrase. 直接引用；逐字引用
words.ex: He quote directly from the book.
words.ex_cn: 他直接引用了这本书。
words.en: To repeat or cite someone's exact words, often in quotation marks.

words.tr: phrase. 完成研究论文的最终定稿；使研究论文定型
words.ex: He will finalize the research paper tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天将完成研究论文。
words.en: To complete and submit a research paper for final approval or publication.

words.ex: The students do experiments in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在实验室做实验。
words.en: A lab is a place where scientific experiments and research are conducted.

words.ex: He works in a laboratory on Fridays.
words.ex_cn: 他在星期五去实验室工作。
words.en: A laboratory is a place equipped for scientific research, experiments, or teaching.

words.ex: Follow the procedure step by step.
words.ex_cn: 一步一步地按照步骤进行。
words.en: A procedure is a way of doing something, especially the usual or correct way.

words.tr: phrase. 实验室操作程序；实验步骤
words.ex: The lab procedure is simple and safe.
words.ex_cn: 实验步骤简单且安全。
words.en: A set of step-by-step instructions for conducting a scientific experiment or analysis.

words.tr: phrase. 实验课指导教师；实验室讲师
words.ex: The lab instructor showed us how to use the microscope.
words.ex_cn: 实验室指导老师教我们如何使用显微镜。
words.en: A person who supervises and instructs students in a laboratory setting.

words.ex: The lab assistant helped students with their experiments.
words.ex_cn: 实验室助手帮助学生做实验。
words.en: A person who provides support in a laboratory, often with experiments, equipment, or data collection.

words.tr: phrase. 追踪路线；跟踪进程
words.ex: He uses a phone app to track the course.
words.ex_cn: 他用手机应用追踪路线。
words.en: To monitor progress or follow the development of a course of study or path.

words.ex: The teacher monitors the students' progress each week.
words.ex_cn: 老师每周监控学生的进步。
words.en: A monitor is a machine that is used to check or record things, for example in a factory or hospital. In a school, a monitor is a student who helps the teacher with various duties.

words.ex: The gym has new exercise equipment.
words.ex_cn: 健身房有新的健身设备。
words.en: The necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 重金属（一种摇滚音乐风格）；重金属（指密度较高的金属元素）
words.ex: Lead is a well-known heavy metal.
words.ex_cn: 铅是一种众所周知的重金属。
words.en: Heavy metal is a genre of rock music that developed in the late 1960s and early 1970s, largely in the United Kingdom and the United States. With roots in blues rock and psychedelic rock, the bands that created heavy metal developed a thick, massive sound, characterized by highly amplified distortion, extended guitar solos, emphatic beats, and overall loudness.

words.tr:
n. 实验；试验；
v. 做试验；进行实验；
words.ex: The boy did a science experiment in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在课堂上做了一个科学实验。
words.en: An experiment is a scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.

words.ex: He put on his glove before playing baseball.
words.ex_cn: 他在打棒球前戴上了手套。
words.en: A glove is a piece of clothing which covers your hand and wrist and has individual sections for each finger.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful instrument for building.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是建造时有用的工具。
words.en: An instrument is a tool or device used for a particular task, especially for scientific, medical, or technical work. It can also refer to a musical instrument.

words.tr:
v. 测量；衡量；度量；
n. 衡量；量度；措施；
words.ex: He uses a ruler to measure the length of the table.
words.ex_cn: 他用尺子测量桌子的长度。
words.en: To measure something means to determine its size, amount, or degree, often by using a tool or device designed for this purpose.

words.ex: He dig a hole in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园里挖了一个洞。
words.en: To dig means to break up, turn over, or remove earth, sand, etc., using a tool, a machine, or your hands. It can also mean to search for something by moving or looking through something, or to like or enjoy something very much.

words.ex: He will participate in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参与学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To take part in an activity or event.

words.ex: We went on a field trip to the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 我们去动物园进行了实地考察。
words.en: An excursion or journey made by a group of people, especially students, for the purpose of learning or research outside the classroom.

words.tr: phrase. 野外工作；实地考察
words.ex: The biologists did field work in the rainforest.
words.ex_cn: 生物学家在雨林中进行了野外工作。
words.en: Field work refers to practical work conducted by a researcher in the natural environment, rather than in a laboratory or office.

words.tr: phrase. 从事于…；继续工作；设法说服；影响
words.ex: He works on his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都做家庭作业。
words.en: To spend time repairing or improving something.

words.ex: He put off his homework until tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他把作业推迟到明天。
words.en: To delay something or to cause someone to feel dislike or lack of interest.

words.ex: He will hand in his homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天交作业。
words.en: To give something to someone in authority, especially a piece of work or a document.

words.ex: He will submit his homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会提交他的作业。
words.en: To yield or surrender (oneself) to the will or authority of another.

words.tr: n. 扩展；延长期；延伸；电话分机；
words.ex: The company added an extension to its office building.
words.ex_cn: 公司为办公楼加了一个扩建部分。
words.en: An extension is a part that is added to something to make it longer or larger, or the act of adding this part.

words.ex: He studied hard for the mid-term exam.
words.ex_cn: 他为期中考试努力学习。
words.en: An examination taken in the middle of an academic term.

words.ex: Students are preparing for their final exams.
words.ex_cn: 学生们正在为期末考试做准备。
words.en: The final exams are the last set of examinations in a course of study, typically determining a student's grade in the course.

words.tr: phrase. 带回家完成的考试；开卷笔试（通常允许学生在规定时间内在家作答并提交）
words.ex: He finished his take-home exam last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚完成了他的带回家考试。
words.en: An examination that students complete at home rather than in a classroom setting.

words.ex: He took a make-up test after he returned from hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他从医院回来后参加了补考。
words.en: A test taken by a student who has missed or failed an earlier test.

words.tr: phrase. 主观的测试；依赖个人判断或感受的测验
words.ex: The teacher gave a subjective test to check our opinions.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个主观测试来检查我们的观点。
words.en: A subjective test is an assessment method that relies on the personal judgment of the examiner rather than objective criteria.

words.tr: phrase. 客观测验；客观性测试（答案明确、评分不受主观因素影响的考试，如选择题、判断题等）
words.ex: The students took an objective test with multiple-choice questions.
words.ex_cn: 学生们参加了一次有多个选择题的客观测验。
words.en: An objective test is a test that has right or wrong answers and can be scored without the need for interpretation.

words.tr: phrase. 突击测验；随堂小考
words.ex: The teacher gave us a pop quiz today.
words.ex_cn: 老师今天给我们做了一次突然小测验。
words.en: A short, unannounced test to assess recent learning.

words.ex: The teacher gave an assessment of the students' work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作品进行了评估。
words.en: An assessment is a judgment about something, especially about how good or bad it is, or an amount that is calculated for something, especially for tax purposes.

words.ex: The hotel has a five-star grade.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有五星级别的等级。
words.en: A grade is a level of quality, rank, or value, or a mark given in an examination or for school work.

words.tr:
n. 记号；分数；痕迹；
v. 做标记；（使）留痕迹；评分；
words.ex: He put a mark on the map to show the place.
words.ex_cn: 他在地图上做了一个记号来表示那个地方。
words.en: A mark is a small area or spot on a surface which is different in colour or texture from the area around it. If you mark something, you make a mark on it in order to identify it or to give information about it.

words.tr:
n. 分数；得分；总谱；乐谱；
v. 得分；
words.ex: He got a high score on the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了高分。
words.en: If you score a particular amount or number in a game or test, you achieve that amount or number.

words.tr:
n. 要点；点；观点；分数；
v. 指出；指向；
words.ex: The main point of his speech was to save energy.
words.ex_cn: 他演讲的主要要点是节约能源。
words.en: A point is a particular place or position, or a detail or aspect of something. It can also refer to the sharp end of something, or a unit of scoring in games. As a verb, it means to direct someone's attention towards something by extending a finger or other object.

words.tr: n. 平均成绩点；平均绩点
words.ex: He has a high gpa because he studies hard.
words.ex_cn: 他因为努力学习而有很高的GPA。
words.en: A GPA is a measure of a student's academic achievement at a college or university, calculated by averaging the grades obtained in all courses.

words.tr: phrase. 平均成绩；平均学分绩点（GPA），用于衡量学生学业表现的平均分数
words.ex: Her grade point average was high enough to qualify for the scholarship.
words.ex_cn: 她的平均绩点足够高，有资格获得奖学金。
words.en: A grade point average is a number representing the average value of the accumulated final grades earned in courses over time.

words.ex: I asked the school for a transcript of my grades.
words.ex_cn: 我向学校要了一份成绩单的副本。
words.en: A transcript is a written or printed version of something that has been recorded or spoken, especially in the context of academic records.

words.ex: I received my grade report and was pleased to see all As.
words.ex_cn: 我收到了我的成绩报告单，很高兴看到全是A。
words.en: A document that shows a student's grades in various subjects over a period of time.

words.ex: He got full marks in the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了满分。
words.en: The highest possible score or grade that can be achieved in a test or examination.

words.tr: phrase. 完美的成绩；满分等级
words.ex: He got a perfect grade on his math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了满分。
words.en: A top score or mark, indicating the highest level of achievement.

words.tr: phrase. 高等级的；优质的；高级别的
words.ex: He got a high grade on his math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了高分。
words.en: A high level of quality or excellence, especially in academic or professional contexts.

words.tr: phrase. 低等级的；低质量的；轻度的；低级别的
words.ex: The student got a low grade on the test.
words.ex_cn: 这个学生考试成绩很低。
words.en: Of inferior quality or standard.

words.tr: phrase. 及格分数；通过课程的最低成绩
words.ex: He got a passing grade on the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了及格分。
words.en: A passing grade is the minimum grade required to pass an exam or a course.

words.ex: He received a failing grade in math this semester.
words.ex_cn: 他这学期数学得了不及格分数。
words.en: A failing grade is a mark given to a student who has not met the minimum requirements to pass a course or exam.

words.ex: He got straight A's in all his subjects this semester.
words.ex_cn: 他这学期所有科目都得了直A。
words.en: Grades of A in all subjects.

words.tr: phrase. （非正式）指某人成绩优异，尤指在学校考试中获得全是A和B的好成绩；也可引申为表现非常出色
words.ex: He was all a's and b's on his math test.
words.ex_cn: 他的数学考试得了全A。
words.en: To be in a state of complete harmony or agreement; to have everything going perfectly.

words.ex: The temperature is a minus five degrees.
words.ex_cn: 温度是零下五度。
words.en: A minus is a grade or mark that is slightly below the standard of an A, or it can refer to the mathematical symbol for subtraction or a negative value.

words.ex: He got a B plus in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学课上得了B+。
words.en: A grade that is slightly higher than a B, often used in academic grading systems.

words.tr: phrase. 以优异成绩通过考试；出色地通过考试
words.uk: pɑːs ði ɪɡˈzæm wɪð ˈflaɪɪŋ ˈkʌləz
words.us: pæs ðə ɪɡˈzæm wɪð ˈflaɪɪŋ ˈkʌlɚz
words.ex: He passed the exam with flying colors.
words.ex_cn: 他以优异的成绩通过了考试。
words.en: To pass an examination with great success or distinction.

words.tr: n. 彩色；颜料；脸色；脸色（color 的复数）；
words.ex: The children love to paint with bright colors.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢用鲜艳的彩色画画。
words.en: Colors are the different hues that can be seen in light and pigment, and are used to describe the appearance of objects.

words.tr: 短语动词. 以优异成绩毕业；荣誉毕业
words.ex: He will graduate with honors this summer.
words.ex_cn: 他今年夏天将以优异成绩毕业。
words.en: To complete a course of study at a college or university with a high level of achievement.

words.tr: adj. 优秀的；杰出的；卓越的；
words.ex: He got an excellent score on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中取得了优异的成绩。
words.en: Something that is excellent is very good indeed.

words.tr:
n. 平均数；平均水平；
adj. 平均的；普通的；
v. 平均为…；
words.ex: The average of 4, 5, and 6 is 5.
words.ex_cn: 4、5和6的平均数是5。
words.en: An average is the result that you get when you add two or more numbers together and divide the total by the number of numbers you added together.

words.tr: phrase. 低于平均水平的；较差的
words.ex: His test score is below average.
words.ex_cn: 他的考试分数低于平均分。
words.en: If something is below average, it is worse than the average or usual standard.

words.tr: phrase. 学分制；信贷系统；信用体系
words.ex: The school uses a credit system to track student progress.
words.ex_cn: 学校使用学分制来跟踪学生的学习进展。
words.en: A credit system is a system that allows people to borrow money or buy goods and services on credit, based on their credit history and ability to repay.

words.tr:
n. 回顾；复习；审查；评论；
v. 回顾；复习；审核；评论；
words.ex: We had a quick review of last week's lesson.
words.ex_cn: 我们对上周的课程做了一个简短的回顾。
words.en: If you review something, you consider it again, especially in order to make changes to it or to give your opinion about it.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细检查；复习；重做；转向；受欢迎
words.ex: I will go over my homework tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚会复习我的家庭作业。
words.en: To examine or review something carefully; to cross over something.

words.tr: phrase. 经历；仔细检查；完成；通过；穿过
words.ex: He went through a hard time last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年经历了一段艰难的时光。
words.en: To experience something, often something difficult or unpleasant, or to examine or discuss something in detail.

words.tr: n. 通宵不眠（尤指为学习或工作）；通宵活动
words.ex: He pulled an all-nighter to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他熬夜完成作业。
words.en: Staying awake all night, typically to study or work.

words.tr: phrase. 自习室；学习休息室（供学生或学者安静学习或短暂休息的场所）
words.ex: Students sit in the study lounge to do their homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在学习休息室里做作业。
words.en: A study lounge is a room or area in a school, college, or university where students can study in a quiet and comfortable environment.

words.ex: He worked extra hours to make up for the lost time.
words.ex_cn: 他加班工作来弥补失去的时间。
words.en: To compensate for something that is lacking or has been lost.

words.tr:
v. 重取；重新摄制；重考
n. 重取；重新摄制；重考
words.ex: He will retake the math test next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将重考数学考试。
words.en: To take something again, especially a photograph or a film scene, or to take control of a place again after losing it.

words.tr: phrase. 追分；提高比分（通常指在比赛中缩小与对手的分差）
words.ex: The team managed to bring up the score in the last minutes of the game.
words.ex_cn: 球队在比赛的最后几分钟设法提高了比分。
words.en: To increase the score in a game or competition, often by a significant margin.

words.tr: phrase. 在考试中取得高分
words.ex: He scored high in the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中得了高分。
words.en: To achieve a high score or mark in an examination.

words.tr: phrase. 成绩单；成绩报告单
words.ex: He got a good report card this month.
words.ex_cn: 他这个月拿到了一份好成绩单。
words.en: A report card is a document that shows a student's grades in school subjects.

words.ex: I received my grade report and was pleased to see all As.
words.ex_cn: 我收到了我的成绩报告单，很高兴看到全是A。
words.en: A document that shows a student's grades in various subjects over a period of time.

words.ex: He won a scholarship to study at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一项去哈佛学习的奖学金。
words.en: A scholarship is a grant or payment made to support a student's education, awarded on the basis of academic or other achievement.

words.tr: n. 伙伴关系；情谊；团体；联谊会；研究生奖学金
words.ex: They formed a fellowship to work on the project together.
words.ex_cn: 他们建立了伙伴关系一起来做这个项目。
words.en: A fellowship is a group of people who join together for a common purpose or interest, or a financial grant given to a scholar to allow them to study or research at an advanced level.

words.ex: He crammed the suitcase with clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服塞满了行李箱。
words.en: If you cram things or people into a place, you put them into it even though there is hardly enough room for them.

words.ex: He goes to the library every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午去图书馆。
words.en: A library is a building where books, documents, CDs, and sometimes videos and music are kept for people to read, study, or borrow.

words.ex: The librarian helps students find books.
words.ex_cn: 图书管理员帮助学生找书。
words.en: A librarian is a person who is in charge of a library or who has been trained to do this work.

words.ex: He shows his student card to get a discount.
words.ex_cn: 他出示学生证来获得折扣。
words.en: A card issued by an educational institution to a student, which is used to identify the student and may provide access to certain facilities or services.

words.tr: phrase. 学生证；学生通行证
words.ex: The student pass lets him ride the bus for free.
words.ex_cn: 这张学生证让他可以免费乘坐公交车。
words.en: A student pass is a card or document that allows a student to access certain services or areas, often at a reduced cost or for free.

words.ex: He uses his library card to borrow books.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的借书证借书。
words.en: A library card is a card issued by a library to individuals, entitling them to borrow books and other materials.

words.tr: phrase. 图书馆通行证；借书证
words.ex: He uses his library pass to borrow books.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的图书馆通行证借书。
words.en: A permit or card allowing a person to use a library's resources, often for borrowing books.

words.tr:
v. 检查；核对；
n. 检查；支票；阻止；
words.ex: Please check your homework before class.
words.ex_cn: 请在上课前检查你的作业。
words.en: To examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition, or to make sure that something is correct or safe.

words.ex: He looks for his keys every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都找他的钥匙。
words.en: To search for something or someone.

words.ex: The fish swam fast using its fin.
words.ex_cn: 鱼用它的鳍快速游动。
words.en: A fin is a thin flat part that sticks out from the body of a fish, used for swimming and balancing.

words.ex: We checked out of the hotel after paying the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我们付完账后离开了酒店。
words.en: To check out means to leave a hotel after paying your bill, or to examine something or someone in order to be certain that everything is correct, safe, or satisfactory.

words.ex: I will borrow a book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我将从图书馆借一本书。
words.en: To take and use something that belongs to someone else with the intention of returning it.

words.tr:
n. 返回；归还；
v. 返回；归还；
words.ex: The return of the train was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 火车的返回被推迟了。
words.en: To go or come back to a place or person. To give, send, or put something back to its original place or condition.

words.ex: He will renew his passport next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会更新他的护照。
words.en: To renew something means to begin it again or to make it new again.

words.tr:
n. 保护区；储备；保留；
v. 预订；
words.ex: The wildlife reserve is home to many endangered animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个自然保护区是许多濒危动物的家园。
words.en: If you reserve something such as a table, ticket, or magazine, you arrange for it to be kept for you and not given to anyone else.

words.tr:
v. 回忆起；召回；
n. 记忆力；
words.ex: I recall my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我想起了我上学的第一天。
words.en: If you recall something, you remember it and tell others about it.

words.ex: He put the books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在架子上。
words.en: A shelf is a flat piece of wood, metal, or glass which is attached to a wall or to the sides of a cupboard. Shelves are used for keeping things on.

words.ex: He will reshelf the books after reading.
words.ex_cn: 他读完书后会重新放回书架。
words.en: To put books or goods back on the shelves after they have been taken off or used.

words.tr: v. 暂停；中止；延期； suspending
words.ex: The school will suspend the class due to snow.
words.ex_cn: 由于下雪，学校将暂停课程。
words.en: If you suspend something, you delay it or stop it from happening for a while or until a decision is made about it.

words.tr:
v. 做标记；签名；
n. 征兆；手势；符号；标志；告示牌；
words.ex: Sign the box with a checkmark.
words.ex_cn: 用对勾在盒子上做标记。
words.en: A sign is a mark or shape that always has a particular meaning, for example in mathematics or music. It can also be an event, action, or fact that shows that something exists, is happening, or may happen in the future.

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.tr: adj. 拥挤的；密集的； v. “crowd”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The bus was crowded during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段公交车很拥挤。
words.en: If a place is crowded, it is full of people.

words.tr: 某事到期；某事应发生（或支付、完成等）
words.ex: The homework is due tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 作业明天到期。
words.en: Something, especially a book or item, is required to be returned or is scheduled for return.

words.ex: The book is overdue at the library.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在图书馆逾期了。
words.en: If you say that a change or an event is overdue, you mean that you think it should have happened before now.

words.tr: phrase. 将某物保留；将某物预订；将某物留作备用
words.ex: I put the book on reserve at the library.
words.ex_cn: 我把这本书在图书馆预约了。
words.en: To set aside a library item for a specific user to borrow, preventing others from taking it.

words.tr:
adj. 很好的；晴朗的；健康的；
n. 罚款；
words.ex: She did a fine job on the project.
words.ex_cn: 她在这个项目上做得很好。
words.en: If you say that something is fine, you mean that it is satisfactory or acceptable.

words.ex: He got a penalty for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因违反规则而受到惩罚。
words.en: A penalty is a punishment that is imposed on someone for doing something that is against the rules or the law.

words.ex: Going first is a privilege, not a right.
words.ex_cn: 优先权是一种特权，而不是权利。
words.en: A privilege is a special right or advantage that only one person or group has.

words.tr: phrase. 延长的借阅权限；扩展的借书特权
words.ex: Students have extended borrowing privileges this semester.
words.ex_cn: 这学期学生有延长的借阅权限。
words.en: Extended rights allowing a user to borrow more items or for longer periods than usual.

words.tr: n. 设施；特色功能；特定场所；资质；
words.ex: The school has a new sports facility.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有一个新的体育设施。
words.en: A facility is a place, building, or service that is designed for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 资料室；参考阅览室
words.ex: He went to the reference room to find a book.
words.ex_cn: 他去参考室找一本书。
words.en: A room in a library or other institution where reference materials such as books, journals, and encyclopedias are kept and can be consulted.

words.ex: The photocopier broke down this morning.
words.ex_cn: 这台复印机今天早上坏了。
words.en: A photocopier is a machine that makes copies of documents or pictures by photographing them.

words.ex: He put the books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在架子上。
words.en: A shelf is a flat piece of wood, metal, or glass which is attached to a wall or to the sides of a cupboard. Shelves are used for keeping things on.

words.ex: I looked up the word in a dictionary.
words.ex_cn: 我在词典里查了这个词。
words.en: A dictionary is a book in which the words of a language are listed alphabetically, together with their meanings, pronunciations, and other information.

words.ex: He added the bibliography at the end of his report.
words.ex_cn: 他在报告末尾添加了参考书目。
words.en: A bibliography is a list of the books and articles that have been used by someone when writing a particular book or article.

words.ex: He reads the newspaper every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读报纸。
words.en: A newspaper is a publication consisting of a number of large sheets of folded paper, on which news, advertisements, and other information is printed.

words.tr:
n. 回顾；复习；审查；评论；
v. 回顾；复习；审核；评论；
words.ex: We had a quick review of last week's lesson.
words.ex_cn: 我们对上周的课程做了一个简短的回顾。
words.en: If you review something, you consider it again, especially in order to make changes to it or to give your opinion about it.

words.tr: phrase. 报纸评论；报刊书评
words.ex: He read a newspaper review about the new movie.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一篇关于新电影的报纸评论。
words.en: A critical assessment or commentary on a book, film, or other work published in a newspaper.

words.tr: phrase. 当代评论；对当前时期事物的评价或分析
words.ex: The book received mixed contemporary reviews when it was first published.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在首次出版时收到了褒贬不一的时评。
words.en: A contemporary review is an evaluation or critique of a work, such as a book, movie, or art piece, that is written or produced in the same period as the work itself.

words.ex: He wrote an article about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的文章。
words.en: An article is a piece of writing on a particular subject in a newspaper, magazine, or online. It can also refer to a particular item or object, or a clause in a legal document.

words.tr: phrase. 预约书；保留图书（图书馆中为特定读者预留、暂不外借的藏书）
words.ex: The library has a section for reserved books that students can check out for a limited time.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆有一个预约图书区，学生可以在有限的时间内借阅。
words.en: A reserved book is a book that has been set aside for a specific person to borrow, usually for a limited period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 珍本；善本；稀有书籍
words.ex: He bought a rare book at the old bookstore.
words.ex_cn: 他在旧书店买了一本稀有书籍。
words.en: A book that is not often found and is considered valuable because of its age, rarity, condition, or other factors.

words.tr: 名词短语 学术期刊；学术杂志（指发表学术研究论文的定期出版物）
words.ex: He published his research in an academic journal.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的研究发表在一本学术期刊上。
words.en: An academic journal is a periodical publication in which scholarship relating to a particular academic discipline is published. Academic journals serve as permanent and transparent forums for the presentation, scrutiny, and discussion of research.

words.ex: The library has the latest current issue of the magazine.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆有这本杂志的最新现期刊物。
words.en: The most recent edition of a newspaper, magazine, or journal.

words.tr: phrase. 较早的问题；旧议题；过期期刊
words.ex: He found an older issue of the magazine in the library.
words.ex_cn: 他在图书馆里找到了一本旧期的杂志。
words.en: An older or earlier version of a publication, such as a journal or magazine.

words.ex: The book has an electronic edition for tablets.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有供平板电脑使用的电子版。
words.en: A version of a publication, such as a newspaper or magazine, that is available in digital format.

words.ex: He recorded the game on a video tape.
words.ex_cn: 他把比赛录在录像带上。
words.en: A video tape is a magnetic tape used for recording visual images and sound.

words.ex: He put on his glove before playing baseball.
words.ex_cn: 他在打棒球前戴上了手套。
words.en: A glove is a piece of clothing which covers your hand and wrist and has individual sections for each finger.

words.ex: The school stores student records in a database.
words.ex_cn: 学校将学生记录存储在数据库中。
words.en: A database is a collection of data that is organized so that it can easily be accessed, managed, and updated.

words.tr: 短语动词. 获得对……的使用权；能够使用或接触到某物
words.ex: Students can get access to the library after school.
words.ex_cn: 学生放学后可以进入图书馆。
words.en: To obtain the right or opportunity to use or see something.

words.tr: phrase. 馆际互借服务；图书馆之间的图书互借服务
words.ex: The inter-library loan service allows patrons to borrow books from other libraries if the desired item is not available in their local library.
words.ex_cn: 馆际互借服务允许读者在本地图书馆没有所需图书时，从其他图书馆借阅。
words.en: A service provided by libraries that allows the borrowing and lending of books and other materials between libraries.

words.tr: phrase. 封面；书本或杂志的前面外页
words.ex: The book has a red front cover.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的封面是红色的。
words.en: The outermost page of a book, magazine, or brochure, which often displays the title, image, and other key information.

words.tr: phrase. 索书号（图书馆中用于标识图书位置的编号）
words.ex: The librarian helped me find the book by its call number.
words.ex_cn: n. 图书管理员通过图书编目号帮我找到了这本书。
words.en: A call number is a unique identifier assigned to each book in a library, used to locate the book on the shelves.

words.tr: phrase. 按标题列出；以标题方式登记
words.ex: The books are listed by title on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 这些书按书名排列在书架上。
words.en: Arranged or indexed according to the name of the work or subject.

words.ex: He asked for help at the information desk.
words.ex_cn: 他在信息台寻求帮助。
words.en: A place in a public building where you can go to get information.

words.ex: He returned the book at the circulation desk.
words.ex_cn: 他在借还书台归还了这本书。
words.en: The circulation desk is the place in a library where you can borrow and return books.

words.ex: He returned the book at the delivery desk.
words.ex_cn: 他在借书台还了书。
words.en: A place in a building where you can collect or arrange for the delivery of items.

words.tr: phrase. 参考咨询台；资料查询台（图书馆中提供信息咨询服务的柜台）
words.ex: He asked for help at the reference desk.
words.ex_cn: 他在参考台寻求帮助。
words.en: A service point in a library where patrons can ask for help finding information.

words.tr: phrase. 返回区域；回收区；退货区
words.ex: The return area is near the exit door.
words.ex_cn: 返回区域在出口门附近。
words.en: The designated section in a library or store where customers can bring back borrowed or purchased items.

words.ex: He bought a novel at the bookstore.
words.ex_cn: 他在书店买了一本小说。
words.en: A bookstore is a shop where books are sold.

words.tr: phrase. 二手书店；出售旧书的店铺
words.ex: He bought a used book from a secondhand bookstore.
words.ex_cn: 他从一家二手书店买了一本旧书。
words.en: A shop that sells used books, typically at lower prices than new bookstores.

words.ex: He bought a used book at the thrift store.
words.ex_cn: 他在旧货店买了一本旧书。
words.en: A book that has been previously owned and is available for purchase.

words.ex: I asked for a refund after the product broke.
words.ex_cn: 产品坏了之后，我要求退款。
words.en: A refund is a sum of money that is returned to you, for example because you have paid too much or because you have returned goods to a shop.

words.ex: He got a full refund for the broken phone.
words.ex_cn: 他因为坏了的手机得到了全额退款。
words.en: A full refund is the return of the entire amount of money paid for a product or service, typically due to dissatisfaction or defect.

words.tr: phrase. 商店政策；店铺规定
words.ex: The store policy says no returns after 30 days.
words.ex_cn: 商店政策规定30天后不退换。
words.en: The set of rules and guidelines that govern the operations and conduct within a business or establishment.

words.tr:
n. 购买；采购；
v. 购买；采购；
words.ex: The purchase of a new car took all his savings.
words.ex_cn: 买一辆新车花光了他所有的积蓄。
words.en: To purchase something means to buy it. It can also refer to something that has been bought.

words.tr: phrase. 指定教材；指定课本
words.ex: The teacher assigned textbooks for the math class.
words.ex_cn: 老师为数学课分配了教科书。
words.en: Books required by an instructor for a particular class, which are often provided or assigned to students.

words.tr: phrase. 特定课程；具体课程
words.ex: He enrolled in a specific course on computer programming.
words.ex_cn: 他报名了一个关于计算机编程的特定课程。
words.en: A particular class or subject of study for which a curriculum is designed.

words.ex: He uses the course book for his English class.
words.ex_cn: 他用这本教材上英语课。
words.en: A course book is a textbook used in a course of study.

words.tr: phrase. 商店信用额度；店内购物凭证（可用于下次消费，通常代替现金退款）
words.ex: He used store credit to buy a new shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他用店铺积分买了一件新衬衫。
words.en: Store credit is a credit that a store gives you when you return goods, which you can use to buy other goods from the store.

words.tr:
n. 交换；兑换；交易所；
v. 交换；
words.ex: They made an exchange of books.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了书籍的交换。
words.en: If you exchange something, you give it to someone and receive something else in return.

words.tr:
n. 材料；原料；
adj. 物质的；
words.ex: The table is made of wood material.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是由木头材料制成的。
words.en: Material refers to the substance or substances from which a thing is made or can be made, or information or ideas for use in creating a book or other work.

words.ex: He reads a science journal every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读一本科学期刊。
words.en: A journal is a newspaper or magazine that deals with a particular subject or professional activity.

words.ex: The photocopier broke down this morning.
words.ex_cn: 这台复印机今天早上坏了。
words.en: A photocopier is a machine that makes copies of documents or pictures by photographing them.

words.ex: She works at the front desk of the hotel.
words.ex_cn: 她在酒店的前台工作。
words.en: The front desk is the place in a hotel, office building, or other establishment where visitors are greeted and dealt with.

words.tr: phrase. 电子材料；用于制造电子器件或设备的材料
words.ex: He uses electronical material to learn science.
words.ex_cn: 他使用电子材料来学习科学。
words.en: Information or resources that are available in digital or electronic format, such as online articles or e-books.

words.ex: Please check the Lost and Found if you can't find your belongings.
