words.ex_cn: 如果你找不到你的物品，请查看失物招领处。
words.en: A place where items that have been lost and then found are kept until their owners claim them.

words.tr: phrase. 学生身份证号码；学生识别编号
words.ex: The student showed her student i.d. number to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 学生把她的学生证号码给老师看了。
words.en: A unique identification number assigned to a student.

words.tr:
n. 一摞；一叠；一堆；大烟囱；
v. 把…放成整齐的一摞；
words.ex: He put the books in a stack on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书堆成一摞放在桌子上。
words.en: A stack is a pile of things, usually arranged one on top of another.

words.ex: He uses a reference book to find the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他用一本参考书来找答案。
words.en: A reference book is a book of facts, such as a dictionary or an encyclopedia, that you look at to find particular information.

words.ex: He loves reading science fiction.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读科幻小说。
words.en: Fiction refers to literature in the form of prose, especially novels, that describes imaginary events and people.

words.tr: n. 纪实文学；非小说类文学作品
words.ex: He reads non-fiction books about history.
words.ex_cn: 他读关于历史的非小说类书籍。
words.en: Writing based on facts, real events, and actual people, rather than imagination.

words.ex: He looked up the word in an encyclopedia.
words.ex_cn: 他从百科全书中查找这个词。
words.en: An encyclopedia is a book or set of books giving information on many subjects or on many aspects of one subject and typically arranged alphabetically.

words.tr:
adj. 周期的；定期的
n. 期刊
words.ex: The plant has a periodical blooming cycle.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物有周期性的开花周期。
words.en: A periodical is a magazine, especially one that is published regularly, or something that happens at regular intervals.

words.ex: He reads a magazine every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上读一本杂志。
words.en: A magazine is a type of thin book with large pages and a paper cover which contains articles, photographs, and advertisements, usually on a particular subject or aimed at a particular readership.

words.tr: phrase. 过期的期刊；往期杂志
words.ex: He bought a back issue of the magazine.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一本往期的杂志。
words.en: A back issue refers to a past edition of a magazine, journal, or other periodical that is no longer the current issue.

words.ex: He looked up the country in an atlas.
words.ex_cn: 他在地图册里查找那个国家。
words.en: An atlas is a book of maps or charts.

words.ex: He checks the almanac for the next full moon.
words.ex_cn: 他查阅历书以查找下一个满月的日期。
words.en: An almanac is a book published every year which contains information about events connected with a particular subject or activity, and facts and statistics about that subject or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 计算机访问；使用计算机的权限或能力
words.ex: He has computer access at the library.
words.ex_cn: 他在图书馆可以使用电脑。
words.en: The ability or right to use a computer system or its resources.

words.tr: phrase. 互联网服务；网络接入服务；在线服务
words.ex: He pays for internet service every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月都支付网络服务费用。
words.en: Internet service refers to the provision of internet access to users by an internet service provider (ISP).

words.tr: phrase. 在线数据库；可通过网络访问并查询的数据集合
words.ex: He uses an online database to find books.
words.ex_cn: 他使用在线数据库查找书籍。
words.en: An online database is a database accessible from a network, including from the Internet.

words.ex: The book is in the closed reserve at the library.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在图书馆的闭架阅览区。
words.en: A state of being reserved or restrained, often due to shyness or caution.

words.ex: He found the book in the online catalogue.
words.ex_cn: 他在在线目录中找到了这本书。
words.en: A list of items that is available on the internet, where you can find information about products, books, etc., that are available from a particular organization.

words.tr:
adj. 多媒体的；
n. 多媒体；
words.ex: The school uses multimedia tools to teach students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校使用多媒体工具来教学。
words.en: Multimedia is the use of computers to present text, graphics, video, animation, and sound in an integrated way.

words.tr: phrase. 索书号（图书馆中用于标识图书位置的编号）
words.ex: The librarian helped me find the book by its call number.
words.ex_cn: n. 图书管理员通过图书编目号帮我找到了这本书。
words.en: A call number is a unique identifier assigned to each book in a library, used to locate the book on the shelves.

words.ex: The keyword helps you find the right page.
words.ex_cn: 这个关键词帮助你找到正确的页面。
words.en: A word or concept of great significance, especially in the context of information retrieval or search engine optimization.

words.tr: phrase. 借阅期；贷款期限；借出期间
words.ex: The loan period for books is two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 书籍的借阅期是两周。
words.en: The duration for which something, especially a book from a library, is borrowed.

words.tr: phrase. 借阅期限；借款期限
words.ex: The borrowing period for books is two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 书籍的借阅期是两周。
words.en: The length of time for which an item, such as a library book or rented equipment, may be kept before it must be returned.

words.ex: He will renew his passport next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会更新他的护照。
words.en: To renew something means to begin it again or to make it new again.

words.ex: He reads books in his spare time.
words.ex_cn: 他在空闲时间读书。
words.en: Spare time refers to the time when one is not working or occupied; leisure time.

words.ex: The expense of the trip was higher than expected.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的费用比预期的要高。
words.en: An expense is the amount of money that you spend on something.

words.tr:
n. 预算；预算金额；
adj. 廉价的；花钱少的；
v. 为 ... 做预算；
words.ex: We made a budget for our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行制定了一个预算。
words.en: A budget is a plan that shows how much money a person or organization will earn and how much they will need or be able to spend.

words.tr: phrase. 工作录用通知；职位邀约；聘书
words.ex: He got a job offer from a big company.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了一家大公司的录用通知。
words.en: An offer of employment, typically extended to a candidate after a successful interview process.

words.tr: phrase. 校内工作；在校园内进行的兼职或勤工俭学岗位
words.ex: He has an on-campus job at the library.
words.ex_cn: 他在图书馆有一份校内工作。
words.en: A part-time job available to students, typically located on the university or college campus.

words.tr: phrase. 校外工作；在校外从事的兼职或全职工作
words.ex: He has an off-campus job at a coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他在校外的一家咖啡店工作。
words.en: A job located outside the university or college campus, typically for students seeking work experience or income.

words.ex: He works a part-time job after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后做一份兼职工作。
words.en: A part-time job is a job in which you work fewer hours each week than people who have a full-time job.

words.tr: phrase. 全职工作；需要每天工作固定较长时间的职位
words.ex: He has a full-time job at a bank.
words.ex_cn: 他在银行有一份全职工作。
words.en: A full-time job is a job in which you work the full number of hours considered normal or standard.

words.ex: The employee arrived at work early.
words.ex_cn: 这位雇员早早到达了工作地点。
words.en: An employee is a person who is paid to work for an organization or for another person.

words.ex: The employer gave her a raise.
words.ex_cn: 雇主给她加了薪。
words.en: An employer is a person or organization that employs people, paying them for their work.

words.ex: He did an internship at a hospital last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，他在一家医院实习。
words.en: An internship is a period of work experience offered by an organization for a limited period of time. It is typically undertaken by students and graduates looking to gain relevant skills and experience in a particular field.

words.tr: phrase. 实习项目；实习计划
words.ex: She joined the internship program to gain practical experience in her field.
words.ex_cn: 她加入了实习计划，以在她的领域获得实践经验。
words.en: An internship program is a structured work experience offered by an employer to provide practical training and experience in a particular field.

words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the library.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请图书馆的工作。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.ex: He submitted his application for the job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周提交了那份工作申请。
words.en: An application is a formal request, often written, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something. It can also refer to the act of putting something to a special use or purpose, or a program or piece of software designed to perform a specific function.

words.ex: He filled out the application form yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天填了申请表。
words.en: A document used to apply for something, such as a job or membership, by providing personal information and details.

words.tr: phrase. 学生中心；学生活动中心
words.ex: The student center is a hub for social activities and academic services.
words.ex_cn: 学生中心是社交活动和学术服务的中心。
words.en: A student center is a building on a college or university campus that is dedicated to student activities and services.

words.ex: He put a note on the bulletin board.
words.ex_cn: 他把一张便条贴在公告栏上。
words.en: A bulletin board is a board on a wall which notices can be pinned to.

words.ex: He handed out a flyer about the concert.
words.ex_cn: 他分发了一张关于音乐会的传单。
words.en: A flyer is a small handbill advertising an event or product.

words.ex: He put up a poster on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把一张海报贴在墙上。
words.en: A poster is a large notice or picture that you stick on a wall or board, often in order to advertise something.

words.tr: phrase. 职业博览会；招聘会
words.ex: He went to the career fair to find a job.
words.ex_cn: 他去职业博览会找工作。
words.en: A career fair is an event where employers and recruiters meet with potential employees to discuss job opportunities.

words.tr: phrase. 职业咨询服务；提供职业规划、就业指导和职业发展建议的服务
words.ex: The university offers a career advisory service to help students plan their future.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学提供职业咨询服务，帮助学生规划未来。
words.en: A service that provides advice and guidance to individuals about their career paths and opportunities.

words.tr: phrase. 招聘启事；职位公告
words.ex: He saw a job announcement for a teacher at the school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校看到了一份教师招聘启事。
words.en: A public notice or advertisement seeking candidates for a job position.

words.tr: phrase. 招聘信息；征募信息
words.ex: The company tries to recruit information from job applicants.
words.ex_cn: 公司试图从求职者那里获取信息。
words.en: Details and data provided to inform potential applicants about a job opening, including requirements and benefits.

words.tr: phrase. 开局位置；起始职位；初始姿态
words.ex: The trader decided to take an opening position in the new stock.
words.ex_cn: 交易员决定在新股票中建立开仓位。
words.en: The initial position or stance from which something begins, especially in games or strategic contexts.

words.ex: There is a vacancy in the sales department.
words.ex_cn: 销售部门有一个空缺职位。
words.en: A vacancy is a position or job that is available for someone to fill.

words.ex: He is a teaching assistant for math class.
words.ex_cn: 他是数学课的助教。
words.en: A teaching assistant is a person who helps a teacher in a classroom, often by providing support to students or helping with the preparation of lessons.

words.tr: phrase. 行政助理；行政助手
words.ex: She works as an administrative assistant in an office.
words.ex_cn: 她在办公室担任行政助理。
words.en: An administrative assistant is someone whose job is to help in the running of an office by organizing things such as appointments, meetings, and correspondence.

words.ex: The lifeguard saved a boy from drowning.
words.ex_cn: 救生员救了一个差点溺水的男孩。
words.en: A lifeguard is a person who is responsible for the safety of people at a beach or swimming pool, and who rescues those who are in danger of drowning.

words.ex: The waiter brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waiter is a man who works in a restaurant, serving people with food and drink.

words.tr: phrase. 食物准备工作；指烹饪前对食材进行的清洗、切割、腌制等处理工作
words.ex: He does food prep work every morning before the restaurant opens.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上餐厅开门前都做食物准备工作。
words.en: The tasks involved in preparing food, such as chopping, mixing, and organizing ingredients.

words.ex: The librarian helps students find books.
words.ex_cn: 图书管理员帮助学生找书。
words.en: A librarian is a person who is in charge of a library or who has been trained to do this work.

words.ex: The sales person helped me buy a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 销售人员帮我买了一部新手机。
words.en: An employee who sells goods or services directly to customers in a retail environment.

words.tr: n. 代人临时照看婴孩者
words.ex: She works as a baby-sitter on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 她在周末做保姆。
words.en: A person paid to look after a child or children while the parents are away.

words.tr: n. 自助餐厅；自助食堂；
words.ex: We ate lunch in the school cafeteria.
words.ex_cn: 我们在学校自助餐厅吃午饭。
words.en: A cafeteria is a type of food service location within an institution in which there is little or no waiting staff table service, whether a restaurant or within an institution such as a large office building or school; a school dining location is also referred to as a dining hall or canteen (in British English).

words.ex: He drinks coffee at a small cafe.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小咖啡馆喝咖啡。
words.en: A cafe is a small restaurant where drinks and snacks are sold.

words.ex: He bought a novel at the bookstore.
words.ex_cn: 他在书店买了一本小说。
words.en: A bookstore is a shop where books are sold.

words.ex: They swim in the swimming pool every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天早上在游泳池里游泳。
words.en: A swimming pool is a large container filled with water, designed for people to swim in.

words.tr:
n. 面试；访谈；
v. 面试；接见；
words.ex: He has an interview tomorrow for a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他明天有一场新工作的面试。
words.en: An interview is a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out if they are suitable for a job or a course of study.

words.ex: After a short break, he resumed his work.
words.ex_cn: 短暂休息后，他继续工作。
words.en: If you resume an activity or if it resumes, it begins again or continues after an interruption.

words.tr: abbr. 简历；履历；“curriculum vitae”的缩写
words.ex: He sent his cv to the company.
words.ex_cn: 他把简历发给了公司。
words.en: A document that summarizes a person's education, work experience, and other qualifications for a job.

words.ex: He sent his curriculum vitae to the company.
words.ex_cn: 他把简历发给了公司。
words.en: A curriculum vitae is a written account of your education and the jobs you have done, which you send when you are applying for a job.

words.ex: He got a teaching qualification last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了教师资格。
words.en: A qualification is a skill or type of experience that you need in order to do a particular job or activity.

words.ex: The teacher gave me a recommendation for the scholarship.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我写了一封奖学金推荐信。
words.en: A suggestion or proposal as to the best course of action, especially one put forward by an authoritative body.

words.ex: He asked his teacher for a letter of recommendation.
words.ex_cn: 他请老师写一封推荐信。
words.en: A letter of recommendation is a letter in which the writer describes the qualities, skills, and achievements of a person they know well, with the purpose of supporting that person's application for a job, admission to a school, or other opportunities.

words.ex: He has much working experience in sales.
words.ex_cn: 他在销售方面有丰富的经验。
words.en: Working experience refers to the knowledge or skill acquired by working in a particular job or field.

words.ex: He is responsible for cleaning the room.
words.ex_cn: 他负责打扫房间。
words.en: To have the duty of taking care of something or someone, so that you may be blamed if something goes wrong.

words.ex: He took responsibility for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了这个错误的责任。
words.en: If you have responsibility for something or someone, or if they are your responsibility, it is your job or duty to deal with them and to take decisions relating to them.

words.ex: The team showed good team work spirit during the game.
words.ex_cn: 团队在比赛中展现了良好的团队合作精神。
words.en: The cooperative attitude and collective effort of a group working together towards a common goal.

words.tr: phrase. 创造性思维；创新性思考
words.ex: He uses creative thinking to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用创造性思维解决数学问题。
words.en: Creative thinking involves the generation of new ideas or concepts, or new associations between existing ideas or concepts, which leads to original and valuable outcomes.

words.tr: phrase. 创新思维；具有创造性的思考方式
words.ex: He uses innovative thinking to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用创新思维解决数学问题。
words.en: The process of generating new and original ideas or concepts.

words.ex: His workload is too heavy this week.
words.ex_cn: 他这周的工作量太大了。
words.en: The amount of work to be done by someone, especially in a particular period of time.

words.ex: His working hours are from 9 to 5.
words.ex_cn: 他的工作时间是早上九点到下午五点。
words.en: The period of time that a person spends at their job on a given day.

words.tr: phrase. 工作条件；劳动环境
words.ex: The workers want better working conditions.
words.ex_cn: 工人们想要更好的工作条件。
words.en: The state or circumstances in which a person works, especially in terms of physical environment, hours, and safety.

words.tr: phrase. 工作位置；作业姿势
words.ex: He found a new working position at a local store.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家本地商店找到了一份新工作。
words.en: The specific role, duties, and responsibilities assigned to an employee within an organization.

words.tr:
v. 转换；
n. 开关；
words.ex: He switched off the light before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前把灯关掉了。
words.en: A switch is a small control for an electrical device which you use to turn the device on or off.

words.ex: He works the morning shift at the factory.
words.ex_cn: 他在工厂上早班。
words.en: The morning shift refers to a work period that starts early in the day, typically in the morning hours.

words.ex: He works the night shift at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院上夜班。
words.en: A night shift is a period of work that occurs during the night, typically from late evening to early morning, in various industries and services.

words.tr: phrase. 接管或承担工作时间；开始获得（如收听率、营业时间等）；捡起时间（字面义，通常用于比喻）
words.ex: He picks up the hours at the grocery store after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后在杂货店多上班。
words.en: To increase the number of hours worked, often temporarily or to cover for someone else.

words.ex: The company will hire a new manager next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司下周将雇用一位新经理。
words.en: If you hire someone, you employ them or pay them to do a particular job for you.

words.tr: phrase. 雇用一名替代者；聘用替补人员
words.ex: They will hire a replacement next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们下周会雇一个替代者。
words.en: To employ someone to take over the duties of a person who has left a job or position.

words.tr:
n. 火车；列车；列；队；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: I took the train to work this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上我坐火车去上班。
words.en: A train is a number of carriages or trucks which are all connected together and which are pulled by an engine along a railway. Train also means to teach someone the skills of a particular job or activity, or to be taught these skills.

words.ex: He is learning vocational education to become a mechanic.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习职业教育，以成为一名机械师。
words.en: Vocational education is education that prepares people to work in various jobs, such as a trade, a craft, or as a technician. Vocational education is sometimes referred to as career and technical education.

words.tr: adj. 艰苦的；强硬的；严厉的；
words.ex: The hike was tough but beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 这次徒步旅行很艰苦但很美丽。
words.en: A tough person is strong and determined, and can tolerate difficulty or suffering.

words.tr: adj. 要求高的；费力的； v. 需要；“demand”的现在分词；
words.ex: The job is demanding because it needs long hours and high focus.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作要求高，因为它需要长时间工作和高度专注。
words.en: Requiring much effort or attention; exacting.

words.ex: The department secretary answers phone calls and files papers.
words.ex_cn: 部门秘书接电话并整理文件。
words.en: A department secretary is an administrative professional who supports the management of a department by performing clerical and organizational tasks.

words.tr: n. 付薪水的支票；薪水
words.ex: He gets his paycheck every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五领工资。
words.en: A paycheck is a check that an employee receives from their employer as payment for their work.

words.ex: He made the payment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在线支付了。
words.en: A payment is an amount of money that is paid to someone, or the act of paying this money.

words.ex: He gets a salary of 3000 dollars each month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月赚3000美元的工资。
words.en: A salary is the money that someone is paid each month by their employer, especially when they are in a profession such as teaching, law, or medicine.

words.ex: He receives his wage every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五领工资。
words.en: A wage is the money that someone is paid each week by their employer, especially for manual or unskilled work. To wage means to carry on (a war or campaign).

words.ex: The company updated the payroll last Friday.
words.ex_cn: 公司上星期五更新了职工工资册。
words.en: A payroll is a list of employees and the amount of money they are to be paid, or the total amount of money paid to the employees of a company.

words.ex: He checks his bank account every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天检查他的银行账户。
words.en: A bank account is an arrangement by which a bank holds money on behalf of a customer, who can deposit and withdraw funds.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.tr: phrase. 支付生活费用；负担日常开销
words.ex: He works part-time to pay for living expense.
words.ex_cn: 他兼职工作来支付生活开销。
words.en: To cover the costs associated with one's daily life and accommodation.

words.ex: He is looking for housing and a job.
words.ex_cn: 他正在寻找住房和工作。
words.en: A phrase used to list items, often implying 'housing and other benefits' or 'housing and related costs'.

words.tr: phrase. 膳食津贴；伙食补贴
words.ex: He gets a food allowance of $10 each day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天有10美元的伙食补贴。
words.en: A sum of money provided by an employer or institution to help cover the cost of meals.

words.ex: He decided to quit smoking last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年决定戒烟。
words.en: If you quit, or quit something, you stop doing it or leave it.

words.tr:
n. 志愿者；
v. 自愿做；
words.ex: He is a volunteer at the local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他是当地医院的一名志愿者。
words.en: A volunteer is someone who does work without being paid for it, especially work that involves helping people.

words.tr:
n. 信用；赊账；赞扬；贷款；荣誉；
v. 相信；
words.ex: He has good credit with the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他在银行有良好的信用。
words.en: If you are allowed credit, you are allowed to pay for goods or services several weeks or months after you have received them.

words.ex: The bonus is an incentive to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 奖金是努力工作的动机。
words.en: Something that encourages a person to do something or to work harder.

words.ex: The sun shone with great glory at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 黎明时分，太阳闪耀着辉煌的光辉。
words.en: High renown or honor won by notable achievements; magnificence or great beauty.

words.ex: The advancement of technology helps people live better.
words.ex_cn: 技术的进步帮助人们生活得更好。
words.en: The process of promoting a cause or plan; the act of moving forward or making progress.

words.tr: phrase. 就业安置服务；职业介绍服务；实习安排服务
words.ex: He used a placement service to find a job.
words.ex_cn: 他使用了一家职业介绍服务来找工作。
words.en: A service that helps students find suitable jobs or internships.

words.ex: He goes to the gym every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身房。
words.en: A gym is a place equipped for physical exercise and training, especially for athletes or for people who want to keep fit.

words.tr: phrase. 运动中心：一个提供各种体育活动和设施的场所，如健身房、游泳池、篮球场等。
words.ex: We go to the sport center to swim and play basketball.
words.ex_cn: 我们去运动中心游泳和打篮球。
words.en: A sport center is a facility that provides space and equipment for sports and physical activities.

words.tr: phrase. 健康中心；医疗中心
words.ex: I go to the health center for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 我去健康中心做体检。
words.en: A health center is a place where people can receive medical care, health education, and other health-related services. It often serves as the primary point of contact for individuals seeking health services in a community.

words.tr: phrase. 学术顾问；负责为学生提供课程选择、学业规划等建议的教师或工作人员
words.ex: My academic advisor helped me choose my classes.
words.ex_cn: 我的学术顾问帮我选了课程。
words.en: An academic advisor is a person who helps students with their educational planning and career choices.

words.tr:
n. 补助金；授予物；
v. 承认；授予；允许；
words.ex: The university received a grant for scientific research.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学收到了一笔用于科学研究的补助金。
words.en: If someone in authority grants you something, or if something is granted to you, you are allowed to have it or do it.

words.tr: phrase. 公立大学；由政府资助设立并运营的高等教育机构
words.ex: He goes to a public university in Texas.
words.ex_cn: 他在德克萨斯州的一所公立大学上学。
words.en: A higher education institution funded and operated by the government.

words.ex: He attends a private university in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他在纽约的一所私立大学上学。
words.en: A higher education institution funded and operated by private entities.

words.tr: phrase. 社区学院（美国提供两年制高等教育的公立学院，通常授予副学士学位）
words.ex: She decided to attend a community college to save money.
words.ex_cn: 她决定去社区大学就读以节省学费。
words.en: A community college is a type of educational institution providing post-secondary education and lower-level tertiary education, granting certificates, diplomas, and associate's degrees.

words.ex: He has a good reputation for honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他以诚实著称。
words.en: The opinion that people have about someone or something because of what has happened in the past.

words.tr: n. 入会；入学 ；登记；注册；加入人数
words.ex: His enrollment in the club was approved last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周被批准加入该俱乐部。
words.en: The act of officially joining a course, school, etc., or the number of people who do this.

words.ex: The ticket is your admission to the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这张票是进入音乐会的许可。
words.en: An admission is a statement in which you admit that something bad, unpleasant, or embarrassing is true, or the act of allowing someone to enter a place or organization.

words.tr: phrase. 招生办公室；负责处理入学申请和相关事务的机构
words.ex: He visited the admissions office to apply for school.
words.ex_cn: 他去招生办公室申请入学。
words.en: The department at a university or college responsible for processing applications and managing student enrollment.

words.tr: phrase. 注册办公室；招生办公室
words.ex: He went to the enrollment office to register for classes.
words.ex_cn: 他去注册办公室报名上课。
words.en: An office at an educational institution where students can register for courses or complete administrative tasks.

words.ex: The tuition for this course is $500.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程的学费是500美元。
words.en: Tuition is the fee charged for instruction, especially at a college, university, or private school.

words.ex: The expense of the trip was higher than expected.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的费用比预期的要高。
words.en: An expense is the amount of money that you spend on something.

words.tr:
n. 费用；代价；
v. 花费；
words.ex: The cost of the book is ten dollars.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的费用是十美元。
words.en: The amount of money that you need in order to buy, make, or do something.

words.tr: v. 买得起；担负得起；有时间做；
words.ex: I can't afford a new car.
words.ex_cn: 我买不起一辆新车。
words.en: If you cannot afford something, you do not have enough money to pay for it.

words.ex: This phone is affordable for students.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机对学生来说价格合理。
words.en: If something is affordable, most people have enough money to buy it.

words.ex: The location of the store is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的位置在公园附近。
words.en: A location is the place where something happens or is situated.

words.ex: He won a scholarship to study at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一项去哈佛学习的奖学金。
words.en: A scholarship is a grant or payment made to support a student's education, awarded on the basis of academic or other achievement.

words.tr: phrase. 教学助理职位；助教奖学金（通常指研究生担任教学辅助工作以换取学费减免或津贴）
words.ex: He got a teaching assistantship to pay for his tuition.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一个助教职位来支付学费。
words.en: A teaching assistantship is a position in which a student assists a professor in teaching, often in exchange for financial support or academic credit.

words.tr: phrase. 研究助理奖学金；研究助理职位（通常指研究生在导师指导下参与科研项目并获得学费减免及生活津贴的资助形式）
words.ex: He got a research assistantship to help with the science project.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了研究助理奖学金来协助科学项目。
words.en: A position in which a person assists in research, typically at a university or research institution, often providing financial support and academic benefits.

words.ex: He took a student loan to pay for his tuition.
words.ex_cn: 他申请了学生贷款来支付学费。
words.en: A student loan is a sum of money borrowed by a student to help pay for their education, which they must repay, often with interest, after they finish their studies.

words.tr:
n. 补助金；授予物；
v. 承认；授予；允许；
words.ex: The university received a grant for scientific research.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学收到了一笔用于科学研究的补助金。
words.en: If someone in authority grants you something, or if something is granted to you, you are allowed to have it or do it.

words.tr: n. 资金；款项；拨款； v. “fund”的现在分词；
words.ex: The school needs more funding for new books.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校需要更多资金来购买新书。
words.en: Funding is money which is used to pay for a particular activity or to help achieve a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 财政援助；经济资助
words.ex: He got financial aid to pay for his books.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了经济援助来支付书本费用。
words.en: Financial aid refers to funding intended to help students pay education expenses including tuition, books, and living costs for study at post-secondary educational institutions.

words.ex: The committee meets every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 委员会每周一开会。
words.en: A committee is a group of people who are chosen to do a particular job or make decisions on behalf of a larger group.

words.tr: 按需求评定的（美国大学提供奖学金的一种评定方式）
words.ex: He gets need-based help from the school.
words.ex_cn: 他从学校获得基于需求的帮助。
words.en: Relating to or based on financial need, especially for grants or aid.

words.tr: adj. 基于优点的，基于功绩的
words.ex: Scholarships are merit-based.
words.ex_cn: 奖学金是基于成绩的。
words.en: Based on merit or achievement rather than other factors such as seniority or connections.

words.tr:
v. 转移；转让；调任；
n. 转移；转让；调任；
words.ex: He will transfer the money to his bank account.
words.ex_cn: 他将把钱转到他的银行账户。
words.en: If you transfer something or someone from one place to another, or they transfer from one place to another, they go from the first place to the second.

words.tr: phrase. 转学生；从一所学校转到另一所学校就读的学生
words.ex: The transfer student quickly adapted to the new school environment.
words.ex_cn: 转学生迅速适应了新学校的环境。
words.en: A student who moves from one educational institution to another.

words.ex: He is an exchange student from Japan.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名来自日本的交换生。
words.en: A student who goes to a foreign country to live and study for a period of time, often as part of an organized program.

words.ex: He lives in a large city.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一座大城市。
words.en: A populous and densely populated urban area.

words.ex: He grew up in a small town.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个小镇上长大。
words.en: A small, often rural settlement with a limited population.

words.tr: phrase. 感到不知所措；被压倒；被淹没（常指情绪或事务过多而难以应对）
words.ex: She is overwhelmed by too much homework.
words.ex_cn: 她被太多的作业压得喘不过气。
words.en: To feel completely overcome by a task or situation, unable to cope.

words.tr: phrase. 被淹没；忙得不可开交；被大量事务压得喘不过气
words.ex: He is swamped with homework every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都被作业压得喘不过气。
words.en: To be extremely busy or overwhelmed with work or tasks.

words.ex: The class size is too big for the teacher to help everyone.
words.ex_cn: 班级人数太多，老师无法帮助每个人。
words.en: The number of students in a class.

words.tr: phrase. 个人关注；个别关照；专人照顾
words.ex: The teacher gives each student personal attention.
words.ex_cn: 老师给每个学生个别关注。
words.en: Personal attention refers to the individual care or consideration given to someone to meet their specific needs or preferences.

words.tr: phrase. 个别关注；单独关照；针对个人的注意力
words.ex: The teacher gives each student individual attention.
words.ex_cn: 老师给每个学生单独的关注。
words.en: Personalized focus or assistance given to a single person.

words.ex: He felt culture shock when he moved to Japan.
words.ex_cn: 当他搬到日本时，他感受到了文化冲击。
words.en: Culture shock is the feeling of disorientation experienced by someone when they are suddenly subjected to an unfamiliar culture, way of life, or set of attitudes.

words.tr: adj. 不受个人感情影响的；没有人情味的；
words.ex: The judge gave an impersonal decision based on the law.
words.ex_cn: 法官基于法律作出了不受个人感情影响的判决。
words.en: If you describe someone's behavior as impersonal, you mean that they do not show any emotion about the person they are dealing with.

words.tr: phrase. 社交生活；社会生活
words.ex: He improved his social life by joining a club.
words.ex_cn: 他通过加入一个俱乐部改善了社交生活。
words.en: Social life refers to the part of a person's time spent doing enjoyable things with others, as opposed to working or being alone.

words.ex: He tries to fit in with his new classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力融入新同学中。
words.en: If you fit in with a group of people, you are accepted by them because you are similar to them or because your behaviour is acceptable to them.

words.tr: n. 学者；[复数]（院校的）学术活动；学者( academic的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The academics published a new research paper.
words.ex_cn: 这些学者发表了一篇新的研究论文。
words.en: Academics refers to the scholarly activities of a school or educational institution, especially the pursuit of research, education, and scholarship.

words.ex: He works hard to keep pace with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以跟上同学的步伐。
words.en: To move or progress at the same rate as someone or something else.

words.tr: n. 住处；膳宿；(交通工具内的)空间；
words.ex: The hotel provided cheap accommodation for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 酒店为旅客提供了便宜的住处。
words.en: Accommodation is a place where someone lives or stays, or the act of providing someone with a place to live or stay.

words.ex: He lives in the dormitory with three roommates.
words.ex_cn: 他和三个室友住在宿舍里。
words.en: A dormitory is a large bedroom where many people sleep, especially in a school or college.

words.ex: He lives in the dorm with three roommates.
words.ex_cn: 他和三个室友住在宿舍里。
words.en: A dorm is a large building at a college or university where students live.

words.ex: My roommate likes to listen to music at night.
words.ex_cn: 我的室友喜欢晚上听音乐。
words.en: A roommate is a person with whom one shares a room or rooms, especially in a college or university dormitory or a shared apartment.

words.tr: phrase. 校内住宿；校园内的学生宿舍
words.ex: He lives in on campus housing near the library.
words.ex_cn: 他住在图书馆附近的校内住宿。
words.en: Accommodation provided by a university or college for students, located on the institution's grounds.

words.tr: phrase. 校外住房；指学生在校外租住的住所
words.ex: He lives in off campus housing near the university.
words.ex_cn: 他住在大学附近的校外住宿。
words.en: Accommodation for students located away from the university or college campus, typically in private rentals.

words.tr: phrase. 住房办公室；负责管理或分配住房的机构
words.ex: The housing office assists residents with their housing applications.
words.ex_cn: 房屋管理处协助居民处理住房申请。
words.en: An office that deals with matters related to housing, such as leases, maintenance, and tenant issues.

words.tr: phrase. 住房主管；住房部门负责人
words.ex: The housing director assigns rooms to students.
words.ex_cn: 住房主任为学生分配房间。
words.en: The university official responsible for managing student accommodation facilities and policies.

words.tr: phrase. 住宿顾问；宿舍辅导员（通常指在大学宿舍中为学生提供支持和指导的学生工作人员）
words.ex: The residence advisor helps students with dorm rules.
words.ex_cn: 宿舍管理员帮助学生了解宿舍规则。
words.en: A student living in university housing who is trained to assist and support other residents.

words.ex: The hotel provides a convenient laundry facility for its guests.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店为客人提供方便的洗衣设施。
words.en: A laundry facility refers to a place equipped with machines for washing and drying clothes, typically available in apartment buildings, dormitories, or public areas.

words.tr: phrase. 休息区；休息室；供人放松的公共区域
words.ex: He is sitting in the lounge area with a cup of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他正坐在休息区喝咖啡。
words.en: A lounge area is a space in a building, especially in a hotel or airport, where people can sit and relax.

words.ex: The toys are in the basement.
words.ex_cn: 玩具在地下室里。
words.en: The basement of a building is a room or area that is partly or completely below ground level.

words.ex: He is conserving energy by turning off the lights.
words.ex_cn: 他通过关灯来节约能源。
words.en: Using less energy to reduce waste and preserve resources.

words.ex: The room has air-conditioning to keep it cool.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有空调来保持凉爽。
words.en: a system that keeps the air in a building cool and dry

words.ex: Please keep the tools in the designated storage area.
words.ex_cn: 请将工具存放在指定的存储区。
words.en: A designated space or room where items are kept for future use.

words.ex: The children ran down the hallway.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在走廊里奔跑。
words.en: A hallway is a long passage inside a building with doors leading off to rooms on either side.

words.tr: phrase. 社区空间；供社区成员共享和互动的公共区域
words.ex: The community space is open for everyone to use.
words.ex_cn: 这个社区空间对所有人开放使用。
words.en: A shared area for group activities and social interaction.

words.tr: phrase. 消防规范；防火法规（指为预防火灾和保障人员安全而制定的建筑和安全规定）
words.ex: The building must follow the fire code.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑必须遵守消防法规。
words.en: Regulations governing fire safety in buildings and public spaces.

words.tr: phrase. 供暖费用；取暖成本
words.ex: The heating cost has increased significantly this winter.
words.ex_cn: 今年冬天的供热成本显著增加。
words.en: The amount of money required to provide heat to a building or room.

words.tr: n. 自助餐厅；自助食堂；
words.ex: We ate lunch in the school cafeteria.
words.ex_cn: 我们在学校自助餐厅吃午饭。
words.en: A cafeteria is a type of food service location within an institution in which there is little or no waiting staff table service, whether a restaurant or within an institution such as a large office building or school; a school dining location is also referred to as a dining hall or canteen (in British English).

words.tr: phrase. 膳食计划；饮食安排；餐食安排表
words.ex: She created a meal plan to help her lose weight.
words.ex_cn: 她制定了一个饮食计划来帮助她减肥。
words.en: A meal plan is a pre-arranged plan that specifies the timing, composition, and quantity of meals for a person or group, often used in institutions like schools or hospitals to ensure nutritional needs are met.

words.tr: phrase. 饭卡；餐卡；用于在学校或公司食堂刷卡消费的卡片
words.ex: He used his meal card to pay for lunch at the cafeteria.
words.ex_cn: 他用餐卡在自助餐厅支付了午餐费用。
words.en: A card that allows the holder to purchase meals, typically in a school or workplace cafeteria.

words.ex: He uses a meal pass to eat in the cafeteria.
words.ex_cn: 他用餐券在食堂吃饭。
words.en: A voucher or ticket providing access to meals, often in a cafeteria or for a specific event.

words.ex: The car is in the parking lot.
words.ex_cn: 车在停车场里。
words.en: A parking lot is an area of ground where people can leave their cars.

words.ex: The parking fee at the mall is quite high.
words.ex_cn: n. 商场的停车费相当高。
words.en: A charge made for the privilege of parking a vehicle in a particular place.

words.ex: He received a parking ticket for overstaying in a no-parking zone.
words.ex_cn: 他因为在禁停区停留过久而收到了一张停车罚单。
words.en: A parking ticket is a notice informing a driver that they have violated parking regulations and must pay a fine.

words.ex: He needs a parking permit to park near the office.
words.ex_cn: 他需要一张停车许可证才能在办公室附近停车。
words.en: A parking permit is an official document that allows you to park your vehicle in a particular place.

words.ex: He goes to the gym every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身房。
words.en: A gym is a place equipped for physical exercise and training, especially for athletes or for people who want to keep fit.

words.tr: phrase. 健身房通行证；允许进入健身房的凭证或会员卡
words.ex: With a gym pass, you can access all the facilities during your membership period.
words.ex_cn: 有了健身房通行证，你可以在会员期间使用所有设施。
words.en: A gym pass is a card or ticket that allows you access to a gym or fitness center.

words.tr: phrase. 学生中心；学生活动中心
words.ex: The student center is a hub for social activities and academic services.
words.ex_cn: 学生中心是社交活动和学术服务的中心。
words.en: A student center is a building on a college or university campus that is dedicated to student activities and services.

words.tr: phrase. 钢琴独奏会；钢琴演奏会
words.ex: He will play at a piano recital next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将参加一场钢琴独奏会。
words.en: A formal performance by a pianist, typically featuring a program of solo works for piano.

words.tr:
n. 赞助商；
v. 赞助；
words.ex: The company is a sponsor of the football match.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司是这场足球赛的赞助商。
words.en: A sponsor is a person or organization that pays for or contributes to the costs involved in staging a sporting or artistic event in return for advertising. A sponsor can also be someone who introduces and supports a proposal for a new law.

words.ex: My family came to my graduation.
words.ex_cn: 我的家人来参加我的毕业典礼。
words.en: Graduation is the successful completion of a course of study at a university, college, or school, often marked by a ceremony.

words.tr: phrase. 毕业表格；用于办理毕业手续的正式文件
words.ex: He filled out the graduation form last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周填了毕业表格。
words.en: A document required to complete academic studies or a course.

words.tr: n. 毕业文凭；学位证书；
words.ex: He received his diploma last June.
words.ex_cn: 他去年六月拿到了毕业文凭。
words.en: A diploma is a document which may be awarded by a university or college, or by a high school, showing that someone has successfully completed a course of study.

words.tr: phrase. 毕业派对；毕业庆祝会
words.ex: We are planning a graduation party for our son.
words.ex_cn: 我们正在为我们的儿子计划一个毕业派对。
words.en: A celebration held to honor someone's graduation from an educational institution.

words.tr: n. 开始；毕业典礼；学位授予典礼
words.ex: The commencement of the class was at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 课程的开始时间是上午9点。
words.en: The commencement of something is its beginning.

words.ex: He earned a bachelor's degree in biology.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了生物学学士学位。
words.en: A bachelor's degree is an undergraduate academic degree awarded by colleges and universities upon completion of a course of study lasting three to seven years (depending on institution and academic discipline).

words.ex: He earned a master's degree in engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了工程学的硕士学位。
words.en: A master's degree is an advanced academic degree awarded by universities or colleges upon completion of a course of study demonstrating mastery or a high-order overview of a specific field of study or area of professional practice.

words.ex: He earned his doctor's degree in physics after five years of research.
words.ex_cn: 他经过五年的研究获得了物理学博士学位。
words.en: A doctor's degree is the highest level of academic degree awarded by universities, signifying the completion of advanced studies and research in a specific field.

words.ex: He completed the registration for the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了这门课程的登记。
words.en: Registration is the act of officially recording something, especially in an official list or record.

words.tr: n. 入学介绍；岗前训练；方向；取向；
words.ex: The school held an orientation for new students on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 学校在周一为新生举行了入学介绍。
words.en: The act of orienting or the state of being oriented; the determination of the relative position of something or someone (especially oneself).

words.tr: n. （认为生物通过自然选择而进化的）达尔文主义；达尔文学说；进化论；
words.ex: Darwinism explains how species change over time through natural selection.
words.ex_cn: 达尔文主义解释了物种如何通过自然选择而随时间变化。
words.en: The theory of the evolution of species by natural selection advanced by Charles Darwin.

words.tr: phrase. 自然选择；物竞天择
words.ex: Birds with strong beaks survive by natural selection.
words.ex_cn: 喙强的鸟通过自然选择生存下来。
words.en: The process by which forms of life having traits that better enable them to adapt to specific environmental pressures, as predators, changes in climate, or competition for food or mates, will tend to survive and reproduce in greater numbers than others of their kind, thus ensuring the perpetuation of those favorable traits in succeeding generations.

words.tr: phrase. 动物适应（指动物为适应环境而发生的生理、行为或结构上的变化）
words.ex: Polar bears show animal adaptation by growing thick fur in winter.
words.ex_cn: 北极熊通过在冬天长出厚毛来展示动物的适应性。
words.en: A trait developed by an organism to survive in its environment.

words.ex: Darwin wrote about the origin of species.
words.ex_cn: 达尔文写了关于物种起源的内容。
words.en: A seminal work of scientific literature by Charles Darwin, introducing the scientific theory that populations evolve over generations through a process of natural selection.

words.ex: The community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区居民一起清理了公园。
words.en: A community is a group of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.ex: This forest has many different species of birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有多种不同的鸟类物种。
words.en: A species is a class of plants or animals whose members have the same main characteristics and are able to breed with each other.

words.ex: The survival of the animals depends on the weather.
words.ex_cn: 这些动物的生存取决于天气。
words.en: The state or fact of continuing to live or exist, typically in spite of an accident, ordeal, or difficult circumstances.

words.ex: The lion belongs to the genus Panthera.
words.ex_cn: 狮子属于豹属。
words.en: A genus is a class of things which have common characteristics and which can be divided into subordinate kinds.

words.ex: He is a zoologist who studies animals in the wild.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位研究野外动物的动物学家。
words.en: A zoologist is a scientist who studies animals and their behavior, habitats, and physiology.

words.ex: A dog is a mammal.
words.ex_cn: 狗是一种哺乳动物。
words.en: A mammal is a type of animal that feeds its young with milk produced by the mother's body. Mammals are warm-blooded and usually have hair or fur.

words.ex: Monkeys and apes are primates.
words.ex_cn: 猴子和猿类是灵长类动物。
words.en: A primate is a member of the most developed and intelligent group of mammals, which includes humans, apes, and monkeys. In a religious context, a primate can also refer to the chief bishop or archbishop in a province or country.

words.ex: A snake is a reptile.
words.ex_cn: 蛇是一种爬行动物。
words.en: A reptile is a cold-blooded vertebrate of the class Reptilia, including snakes, lizards, crocodiles, turtles, and tortoises. They are characterized by their scaly skin and the fact that they lay eggs on land.

words.ex: The rodent ran quickly across the floor.
words.ex_cn: 这只啮齿动物迅速跑过地板。
words.en: A rodent is a small mammal which has sharp front teeth that it uses for gnawing. Rodents include rats, mice, and squirrels.

words.ex: The frog is an amphibian.
words.ex_cn: 青蛙是一种两栖动物。
words.en: An amphibian is a type of animal that can live both on land and in water. Frogs, toads, and salamanders are examples of amphibians.

words.ex: Fish and birds are vertebrates.
words.ex_cn: 鱼和鸟是脊椎动物。
words.en: A vertebrate is an animal that has a spine or backbone.

words.ex: The jellyfish is an invertebrate.
words.ex_cn: 水母是一种无脊椎动物。
words.en: An invertebrate is an animal that does not have a backbone or spinal column.

words.tr: adj. 水生的；水栖的；水中的；
words.ex: The fish live in aquatic plants.
words.ex_cn: 这些鱼生活在水生植物中。
words.en: Relating to water; living in or near water or taking place in water.

words.tr: phrase. 温血动物；指能自我调节体温、保持恒定体温的动物，如哺乳类和鸟类
words.ex: Birds and mammals are warm-blooded animals.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类和哺乳动物是温血动物。
words.en: A warm-blooded animal is an animal that can maintain a constant body temperature regardless of the external environment, typically higher than that of the surrounding environment.

words.tr: phrase. 冷血动物，指体温随环境变化而变化的动物，如爬行动物和两栖动物
words.ex: A snake is a cold-blooded animal.
words.ex_cn: 蛇是一种冷血动物。
words.en: An animal whose body temperature varies with the temperature of its surroundings; any animal except birds and mammals.

words.ex: The deer is a herbivore.
words.ex_cn: 鹿是食草动物。
words.en: An herbivore is an animal that gets its energy from eating plants, and only plants.

words.ex: Lions are carnivores that eat meat.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是吃肉的食肉动物。
words.en: A carnivore is an animal that eats the flesh of other animals.

words.tr: n. 杂食动物；不偏食的人
words.ex: The bear is an omnivore that eats berries and fish.
words.ex_cn: 这只熊是杂食动物，吃浆果和鱼。
words.en: An omnivore is an animal that is able to eat both plants and meat.

words.ex: The child found a mollusk on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在海滩上发现了一只软体动物。
words.en: A mollusk is a type of animal with a soft body, often protected by a hard shell, such as a snail or clam.

words.ex: He loves ornithology and watches birds every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱鸟类学，每天早上都观察鸟类。
words.en: Ornithology is the branch of zoology that deals with the study of birds.

words.ex: He loves entomology and collects bugs.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱昆虫学，喜欢收集昆虫。
words.en: The branch of zoology concerned with the study of insects.

words.ex: The beast ran fast through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 那只野兽在森林里快速奔跑。
words.en: A beast is a large and dangerous animal.

words.ex: The creature lived in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这个生物生活在森林里。
words.en: A creature is a living thing, especially an animal.

words.ex: The extinction of dinosaurs happened millions of years ago.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙的灭绝发生在数百万年前。
words.en: The state or process of a species, family, or larger group being or becoming extinct.

words.tr:
n. 平衡；天平；秤；
v. （使）相抵；（使）平衡；
words.ex: She maintains a good balance between work and rest.
words.ex_cn: 她在工作和休息之间保持良好的平衡。
words.en: Balance is the ability to remain steady when you are standing up. Also, it refers to the state of having your weight spread equally so that you do not fall. In finance, it refers to the amount of money you have in a bank account.

words.tr: phrase. 保护色；保护性伪装（指动物或军事装备等为躲避敌人或捕食者而采用的与环境相似的颜色或图案）
words.ex: The frog uses protective camouflage to hide from predators.
words.ex_cn: 这只青蛙使用保护性伪装来躲避捕食者。
words.en: Coloring or patterns that help an animal blend into its surroundings.

words.tr:
n. 壳体；贝壳；炮弹；
v. 剥…的壳；去…的皮；炮轰；炮击；
words.ex: The crab crawled out of its shell.
words.ex_cn: 螃蟹从它的壳里爬了出来。
words.en: A shell is the hard protective outer case of a mollusk or crustacean, or the outer layer of an egg, nut, or seed. It can also refer to a metal case filled with explosive, to be fired from a gun.

words.ex: The doctor used ultrasound to check the baby.
words.ex_cn: 医生用超声波检查了婴儿。
words.en: Ultrasound is sound which is very high and cannot be heard by humans, used in medical examinations to produce images of the inside of the body.

words.ex: Bats use echolocation to find insects in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 蝙蝠利用回声定位在黑暗中寻找昆虫。
words.en: Echolocation is a method used by certain animals to determine the location of objects by emitting sound waves and listening for the echo.

words.ex: The bird hatched her eggs after three weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟在三周后孵出了她的蛋。
words.en: To hatch means to cause an egg to break open so that a young animal can come out, or to plan secretly with other people to do something bad or illegal.

words.ex: The bird spread its wing to fly.
words.ex_cn: 鸟张开翅膀飞翔。
words.en: One of the two flat parts that stick out from the side of a bird's body and are used for flying.

words.ex: The bird has a soft feather.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟有一根柔软的羽毛。
words.en: One of the light, horny structures that form the principal covering of birds.

words.ex: The mother grooms her puppy every morning.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈每天早上给她的小狗梳理毛发。
words.en: A groom is a man who is getting married. Also, to groom means to clean and brush an animal, or to prepare someone for a particular job or position.

words.tr: v. 用喙整理羽毛；精心打扮；感觉良好
words.ex: The bird preens its feathers every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟每天早上梳理它的羽毛。
words.en: If a bird preens or preens itself, it cleans and arranges its feathers using its beak.

words.tr:
v. 脱毛；换毛
n. 脱毛；换毛
words.ex: The bird molts its feathers every spring.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟每年春天都会脱毛。
words.en: When an animal molts, it loses its feathers, hair, or skin so that new ones can grow.

words.ex: The bird uses its beak to eat seeds.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟用它的喙吃种子。
words.en: The hard, pointed, often curved part of a bird's mouth, used for picking up and eating food.

words.ex: I paid the electric bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天付了电费账单。
words.en: A bill is a statement of money owed for goods or services, a proposed law presented to a legislature for approval, a piece of paper money, or the beak of a bird.

words.tr:
n. 窝；鸟巢；
v. 筑巢；
words.ex: The bird built a nest in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 鸟在树上筑了一个窝。
words.en: A nest is a structure made by a bird for laying eggs and sheltering its young. It can also refer to a place where insects or other animals lay eggs or raise their young. As a verb, to nest means to build or use a nest.

words.tr:
v. 陷入（困境）；设圈套；
n. 圈套；陷阱；困境；
words.ex: He trapped himself in debt by spending too much.
words.ex_cn: 他因花钱太多而陷入债务困境。
words.en: A trap is a device or enclosure designed to catch and retain animals, typically by allowing entry but not exit or by catching hold of a part of the body.

words.tr: n. 栖息地；居留地；产地；
words.ex: The panda's habitat is in the mountains of China.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫的栖息地在中国的山区。
words.en: The natural environment in which a species or group of species lives.

words.tr: phrase. 大量涌向栖息地；成群结队地前往栖息地
words.ex: Birds flock to habitat near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类聚集到湖边的栖息地。
words.en: To gather or move in large numbers to a specific natural area.

words.tr:
n. 群；蜂群
v. 云集；充满
words.ex: Bees swarm around the flower.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂围绕着花朵成群飞舞。
words.en: A swarm is a large group of insects, especially bees, moving together. As a verb, it means to move in or form a swarm.

words.tr:
n. （鸟或羊）群；（人）群；
v. 聚集；群集；
words.ex: A flock of birds flew over the field.
words.ex_cn: 一群鸟飞过田野。
words.en: A flock is a group of birds, sheep, or goats, or a large group of people. It can also refer to a soft material for stuffing cushions, quilts, etc., made from wool or cotton. As a verb, it means to gather or move in a flock.

words.tr:
n. 兽群；
v. 放牧；
words.ex: The herd of cows walked slowly to the pasture.
words.ex_cn: 一群牛缓缓走向牧场。
words.en: A herd is a large group of animals of one kind that live together.

words.tr: n. 一束；一串；一群；大量
words.ex: A bunch of birds flew over the tree.
words.ex_cn: 一群鸟飞过树顶。
words.en: A bunch of things is a group of them. A bunch of people is a group of them who are together or who are connected in some way.

words.ex: The insect flew over the grass.
words.ex_cn: 那只昆虫飞过了草地。
words.en: An insect is a small animal that has six legs. Most insects have wings. Ants, flies, butterflies, and beetles are all insects.

words.ex: The ant moved its antenna to feel the ground.
words.ex_cn: 蚂蚁用它的触角感知地面。
words.en: An antenna is a device that sends and receives radio or television signals. In biology, it refers to the long, thin sensory appendages on the heads of insects and crustaceans.

words.ex: The bird ate a worm.
words.ex_cn: 鸟吃了一条蚯蚓。
words.en: A worm is a small, long, thin creature with no bones or legs that lives in soil.

words.ex: The caterpillar is eating leaves on the tree.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫正在树上吃叶子。
words.en: A caterpillar is a small, worm-like animal that eventually develops into a butterfly or moth.

words.ex: The caterpillar's metamorphosis into a butterfly takes weeks.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫变成蝴蝶的变形需要几周时间。
words.en: Metamorphosis is a process of transformation from an immature form to an adult form in two or more distinct stages.

words.ex: She boiled an egg for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她为早餐煮了一个蛋。
words.en: An egg is an oval object that is produced by a female bird and which contains a baby bird. Other animals such as reptiles and fish also lay eggs.

words.ex: The butterfly starts as a larva.
words.ex_cn: 蝴蝶从幼虫开始。
words.en: An insect in the stage of development when it has just come out of an egg and before it changes into its adult form.

words.ex: The caterpillar spun a cocoon around itself.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫为自己织了一个茧。
words.en: A cocoon is a covering of silky threads that the larvae of insects such as moths make to protect themselves while they are developing into adults.

words.ex: The caterpillar turned into a pupa.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫变成了蛹。
words.en: A pupa is the life stage of some insects undergoing transformation between immature and mature stages.

words.tr:
n. 成人；
adj. 成年的；
words.ex: An adult must pay taxes.
words.ex_cn: 成人必须缴税。
words.en: An adult is a mature, fully developed person. An adult has reached the age when they are legally responsible for their actions.

words.ex: The farmer tried to kill the pest with a spray.
words.ex_cn: 农民试图用喷雾杀死害虫。
words.en: A pest is an animal or insect that damages crops, food, or livestock, or is generally troublesome. It can also refer to a person or thing that causes annoyance or trouble.

words.ex: Farmers use pesticide to kill insects on crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用杀虫剂来杀死作物上的昆虫。
words.en: A pesticide is a chemical substance used to kill pests, especially insects, that damage crops or are harmful to human health.

words.ex: Farmers use insecticide to kill bugs on crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用杀虫剂来杀死作物上的害虫。
words.en: A substance used for killing insects.

words.ex: Birds migrate south in winter.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在冬天迁徙到南方。
words.en: If people migrate, they move from one place to another, especially in order to find work or to live somewhere for a short time.

words.tr: phrase. 栖息地路线（指动物在不同栖息地之间移动的路径）
words.ex: The bird follows a familiar route to its habitat.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟沿着熟悉的路线飞向它的栖息地。
words.en: A path or corridor used by animals to travel between habitats.

words.ex: Fish reproduce in the river.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在河里繁殖。
words.en: To produce something again; to make a copy of something.

words.ex: The bacteria multiply quickly.
words.ex_cn: 细菌迅速增加。
words.en: If you multiply one number by another, you add the first number to itself as many times as is indicated by the second number. For example, 2 multiplied by 3 is equal to 6.

words.tr:
v. 交配繁殖；饲养；
n. 品种；
words.ex: The farmers breed cows to get more milk.
words.ex_cn: 农民让奶牛交配繁殖以获得更多牛奶。
words.en: If you breed animals or plants, you keep them for the purpose of producing more animals or plants with particular qualities, in a controlled way.

words.ex: The reproductive system helps humans have babies.
words.ex_cn: 生殖系统帮助人类生育孩子。
words.en: The organs and parts of the body involved in the process of producing offspring.

words.ex: Bears hibernate in winter to save energy.
words.ex_cn: 熊在冬天冬眠以保存能量。
words.en: To spend the winter in a dormant state.

words.ex: The soldier wore camouflage to hide in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 士兵穿着伪装服在森林中隐藏自己。
words.en: Camouflage is the way in which some animals are colored and shaped so that they cannot easily be seen in their natural surroundings.

words.ex: Lizards can regenerate their tails.
words.ex_cn: 蜥蜴可以再生尾巴。
words.en: To regenerate means to grow or form again, especially after being damaged or lost, or to improve a place or system by making it more active or successful.

words.ex: Humans domesticated dogs thousands of years ago.
words.ex_cn: 人类几千年前就驯养了狗。
words.en: To domesticate an animal or plant means to bring it under human control in order to provide food, power, or company.

words.tr:
n. 猎物；受害者；受骗者；
v. 捕食；坑害；折磨；
words.ex: The lion chased its prey across the plain.
words.ex_cn: 狮子在平原上追逐它的猎物。
words.en: An animal that is hunted and killed by another for food.

words.tr: n. 掠夺者；捕食性动物；食肉动物；
words.ex: The lion is a predator that hunts deer.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是一种捕食鹿的掠夺者。
words.en: A predator is an animal that naturally preys on others.

words.ex: The birds mate in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟在春天交配。
words.en: A mate is a friend, someone you work with, or someone you are married to or in a sexual relationship with. As a verb, to mate means to have sex in order to produce young or to bring two animals together for breeding.

words.ex: Birds perform a mating ritual to find a partner.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类通过求偶仪式来寻找伴侣。
words.en: A mating ritual is a set of behaviors exhibited by animals as part of the process of attracting and selecting a mate for reproduction.

words.ex: The butterfly has perfect symmetry.
words.ex_cn: 这只蝴蝶有完美的对称性。
words.en: Symmetry is the quality of being made up of exactly similar parts facing each other or around an axis.

words.ex: The painting has asymmetry in its design.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的构图不对称。
words.en: The quality of being asymmetrical; lack of symmetry.

words.ex: The barren land cannot grow any crops.
words.ex_cn: 这片贫瘠的土地无法种植任何庄稼。
words.en: If you describe something as barren, you mean that it is not able to produce anything, especially plants or crops.

words.ex: Bread and rice are rich in carbohydrate.
words.ex_cn: 面包和米饭富含碳水化合物。
words.en: A carbohydrate is a substance found in foods such as bread, potatoes, and rice which provides your body with heat and energy and which consists of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen.

words.tr:
n. 脂肪；
adj. 肥的；
words.ex: This food has too much fat.
words.ex_cn: 这种食物含有太多脂肪。
words.en: Fat is a substance contained in foods such as meat, cheese, and butter, which is used by the body to produce energy or stored in the body as a layer.

words.ex: The lion is at the top of the food chain.
words.ex_cn: 狮子处于食物链的顶端。
words.en: A food chain is a series of organisms each dependent on the next as a source of food.

words.tr: n. 腐生菌；腐生物；分解体
words.ex: The fungus is a decomposer in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这种真菌是森林中的分解者。
words.en: An organism, especially a soil bacterium, fungus, or invertebrate, that decomposes organic material.

words.tr: n. 生产者；制造商；制片人；
words.ex: The farmer is a producer of milk.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民是牛奶的生产者。
words.en: A producer is a person or company that makes or grows things, or a person who controls and organizes the making of a film, play, or television or radio programme.

words.ex: The consumer buys food at the store.
words.ex_cn: 消费者在商店购买食物。
words.en: A consumer is a person who buys goods or uses services.

words.ex: Marine biology is the study of marine life and ecosystems.
words.ex_cn: 海洋生物学是研究海洋生物及其生态系统的学科。
words.en: Marine biology is the scientific study of organisms in the ocean or other marine bodies of water. It is a branch of biology that deals with the study of marine organisms, their behaviors, and their interactions with the environment.

words.ex: Plankton float in the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 浮游生物漂浮在海洋中。
words.en: Plankton are the diverse collection of organisms found in water (or air) that are unable to propel themselves against a current (or wind).

words.tr:
n. 规模；等级；比例（尺）；刻度；秤；
v. 改变…大小；
words.ex: The scale of the project surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的规模让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: A scale is a set of levels or numbers which are used in a particular system of measuring things or are used when comparing things.

words.ex: The fish spawn in the river each spring.
words.ex_cn: 鱼每年春天在河里产卵。
words.en: To spawn means to produce or deposit eggs, especially in large quantities, as fish, frogs, etc. do. It can also mean to give rise to or generate something.

words.ex: The fish swim among the coral in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在海中的珊瑚间游动。
words.en: A hard stony substance secreted by certain marine coelenterates as an external skeleton, typically forming large reefs in warm seas.

words.ex: Fish live in a coral reef near the island.
words.ex_cn: 鱼生活在岛屿附近的珊瑚礁中。
words.en: A coral reef is a structure in the sea formed from the calcium carbonate skeletons of corals, typically found in warm, shallow waters.

words.ex: The pond is full of green algae.
words.ex_cn: 池塘里长满了绿色藻类。
words.en: Algae are simple plants that can range from the microscopic (microalgae), to large seaweeds (macroalgae), such as giant kelp more than one hundred feet in length.

words.ex: The trapper caught a fox in the woods.
words.ex_cn: 捕兽者在树林里抓到了一只狐狸。
words.en: A trapper is a person who traps wild animals, especially for their fur.

words.ex: He uses fertilizer to help his plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 他用肥料帮助植物生长。
words.en: A substance that is added to soil to improve the growth of plants.

words.tr:
v. 搜寻；（动物）觅食；
n. 饲料；草料；
words.ex: The bear forages for berries in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这只熊在森林里搜寻浆果。
words.en: If you forage, you search for food or other supplies. Forage can also refer to food for animals, especially when it is grown or collected.

words.ex: The ingestion of too much sugar can cause health problems.
words.ex_cn: 摄食过多的糖会导致健康问题。
words.en: The process of taking food, drink, or another substance into the body by swallowing or absorbing it.

words.ex: Good digestion helps your body absorb nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 良好的消化有助于身体吸收营养。
words.en: The process by which food is broken down in the stomach and intestines so that the body can absorb it and use it for energy and nutrients.

words.ex: His metabolism is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 他的新陈代谢非常快。
words.en: Metabolism is the set of life-sustaining chemical transformations within the cells of living organisms.

words.ex: The dogs had three offspring last spring.
words.ex_cn: 这些狗去年春天生了三只幼崽。
words.en: Someone's offspring are their children.

words.ex: His descendent traits include blue eyes and curly hair.
words.ex_cn: 他的遗传特征包括蓝眼睛和卷发。
words.en: A descendent is a person who is directly descended from a particular ancestor.

words.ex: The insect's compound eye allows it to see in many directions at once.
words.ex_cn: 昆虫的复眼使它能够同时看到多个方向。
words.en: A compound eye is a visual organ found in arthropods such as insects and crustaceans. It consists of multiple small visual units, each of which contributes to the overall image perceived by the animal.

words.tr: n. 寄生虫；寄生生物；依赖他人过活者；
words.ex: The parasite lives inside the host's body.
words.ex_cn: 这种寄生虫生活在宿主的体内。
words.en: A parasite is an organism that lives on or in a host organism and gets its food from or at the expense of its host.

words.ex: The tribe lives in a primitive hut.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落住在原始的小屋里。
words.en: Belonging to a very early period in the history of the world, or to a time before modern things existed.

words.tr:
adj. 文明的；开化的；有法制伦理的
v. 使开化；使文明；教化；“civilize”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He lives in a civilized society.
words.ex_cn: 他生活在一个文明的社会中。
words.en: Someone who is civilized is polite and reasonable.

words.ex: Eating vegetables is beneficial to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜对你的健康有益。
words.en: Promoting or enhancing well-being; advantageous.

words.ex: The school values diversity in its students.
words.ex_cn: 学校重视学生的多样性。
words.en: The state of being diverse; variety.

words.ex: The forest has high biodiversity.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林生物多样性很高。
words.en: Biodiversity refers to the variety of life in the world or in a particular habitat or ecosystem.

words.ex: The paleontologist found a dinosaur bone in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 古生物学家在沙漠中发现了一块恐龙骨头。
words.en: A paleontologist is a scientist who studies fossils to understand the history of life on Earth.

words.ex: Breathing deeply helps with respiration.
words.ex_cn: 深呼吸有助于呼吸。
words.en: The process of breathing, which involves inhaling oxygen and exhaling carbon dioxide.

words.ex: The gland secrete sweat to cool the body.
words.ex_cn: 腺体分泌汗液来降温。
words.en: If part of a plant, animal, or human secretes a liquid or substance, it produces it.

words.ex: The gland produces a secretion to help digestion.
words.ex_cn: 腺体分泌一种物质以帮助消化。
words.en: The process by which substances are produced and discharged from a cell, gland, or organ for a particular function in the organism or for excretion.

words.ex: Hormones control growth and mood in the body.
words.ex_cn: 荷尔蒙控制身体的生长和情绪。
words.en: A hormone is a chemical substance produced in the body that controls and regulates the activity of certain cells or organs.

words.ex: Vaccines help build immunity against diseases.
words.ex_cn: 疫苗有助于增强对疾病的免疫力。
words.en: Immunity is the state of being immune from or insusceptible to a particular disease or the legal status of being exempt from certain obligations or penalties.

words.ex: The students learned the anatomy of the human heart.
words.ex_cn: 学生们学习了人类心脏的解剖组织构造。
words.en: Anatomy is the study of the structure of the bodies of people or animals.

words.ex: The heart is an important organ in the body.
words.ex_cn: 心脏是身体中重要的器官。
words.en: An organ is a part of an organism that is typically self-contained and has a specific vital function, such as the heart or liver in humans.

words.ex: The doctor examined the tissue under a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 医生在显微镜下检查了组织。
words.en: Tissue is a group of cells that have a similar structure and that work together to perform a specific function.

words.ex: The intestine helps digest food.
words.ex_cn: 肠道帮助消化食物。
words.en: The part of the alimentary canal between the stomach and the anus.

words.ex: The doctor checked the vein in his arm.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他手臂上的静脉。
words.en: A vein is a tube in your body that carries blood towards your heart. It can also refer to a thin layer of a mineral in rock, or a particular style or mood in writing or speech.

words.ex: The team improved its defense in the second half.
words.ex_cn: 球队在下半场改进了防守。
words.en: The act of defending against attack, danger, or injury.

words.tr: phrase. 防御机制；心理防卫机制（指个体在面对压力或冲突时无意识采取的心理策略，如压抑、投射、合理化等）
words.ex: He uses humor as a defense mechanism.
words.ex_cn: 他用幽默作为防御机制。
words.en: A defense mechanism is a psychological strategy brought into play by the unconscious mind to manipulate, deny, or distort reality in order to defend against feelings of anxiety and unacceptable impulses.

words.tr: adj. 独自的；单独的；孤寂的；
words.ex: He lives in a solitary house far from the town.
words.ex_cn: 他住在离城镇很远的独自一人的房子里。
words.en: A solitary person or thing is the only one in a place.

words.ex: The ferocious wind knocked down the tree.
words.ex_cn: 强烈的风把树吹倒了。
words.en: A ferocious animal or person is very fierce and violent.

words.ex: The movie was tame and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影枯燥无味。
words.en: If you describe an animal as tame, you mean that it is not afraid of humans and is not dangerous. If you describe a person or their behavior as tame, you mean that they are not very exciting or interesting.

words.tr: adj. 分泌毒液的；有毒的；恶毒的
words.ex: The snake is venomous.
words.ex_cn: 这条蛇是有毒的。
words.en: If you describe a person or their behavior as venomous, you mean that they show great bitterness and anger toward someone.

words.ex: The cat is agile and jumps high.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫很敏捷，跳得很高。
words.en: Someone who is agile can move quickly and easily.

words.ex: The two countries argued over territorial rights.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家就领土权利发生了争执。
words.en: Relating to the ownership of an area of land or sea.

words.ex: The child loves to watch dinosaurs on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子喜欢在电视上看恐龙。
words.en: A dinosaur is a type of reptile that lived millions of years ago, known for its large size and often extinct species.

words.ex: The lizard sits on the rock in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 蜥蜴趴在阳光下的石头上。
words.en: A lizard is a reptile with a long body, four legs, a long tail, and rough, scaly skin.

words.tr: n. 变色龙；见风使舵的人
words.ex: The chameleon changes color to hide.
words.ex_cn: 变色龙改变颜色来隐藏自己。
words.en: A chameleon is a type of lizard that can change the color of its skin in order to blend in with its surroundings.

words.ex: The alligator swims slowly in the river.
words.ex_cn: 鳄鱼在河里慢慢游动。
words.en: An alligator is a large reptile with a long body, thick skin, and a long tail, living in the water and on land in the hot wet parts of America and China.

words.ex: The crocodile is swimming in the river.
words.ex_cn: 鳄鱼正在河里游泳。
words.en: A crocodile is a large reptile that lives in rivers in the tropical regions of Africa, Asia, America, and Australia. It has a long body, a long tail, and very strong jaws.

words.ex: The rhinoceros walks slowly in the grass.
words.ex_cn: 犀牛在草地上慢慢行走。
words.en: A rhinoceros is a large, thick-skinned animal with one or two horns on its nose, native to Africa and southern Asia.

words.ex: The marmot hides in its burrow before winter.
words.ex_cn: 土拨鼠在冬天来临前躲进它的洞穴里。
words.en: A marmot is a large, burrowing rodent of the squirrel family, found in mountainous areas of North America and Eurasia.

words.ex: The squirrel ran up the tree with a nut.
words.ex_cn: 松鼠带着一颗坚果跑上了树。
words.en: A squirrel is a small animal with a bushy tail that lives in trees and is known for its ability to climb and jump.

words.ex: The turtle walks slowly on the sand.
words.ex_cn: 乌龟在沙子上慢慢走。
words.en: A turtle is a reptile with a hard shell that lives in the sea or on land.

words.ex: A bat flew out of the cave at night.
words.ex_cn: 一只蝙蝠在晚上从洞穴里飞了出来。
words.en: A bat is a piece of wood used to hit the ball in games such as cricket, baseball, and table tennis. It can also refer to a small animal that flies at night.

words.ex: A moth flew into the room through the window.
words.ex_cn: 一只蛾子从窗户飞进了房间。
words.en: A moth is an insect with wings that is related to the butterfly. Moths are often attracted to light and are mostly active at night.

words.ex: The ape climbed slowly up the tree.
words.ex_cn: 这只猿慢慢爬上了树。
words.en: An ape is a large primate that does not have a tail, for example a chimpanzee or gorilla.

words.ex: The gorilla sits quietly in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 大猩猩静静地坐在森林里。
words.en: A gorilla is a large, powerful ape that is native to the forests of central Africa. Gorillas are the largest living primates and are closely related to humans.

words.ex: The chimpanzee is eating a banana.
words.ex_cn: 这只黑猩猩正在吃一根香蕉。
words.en: A chimpanzee is a great ape native to the forest and savannah of tropical Africa. It is known for its intelligence, use of tools, and complex social structures.

words.ex: The whale swims deep in the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 鲸在海洋深处游动。
words.en: A whale is a very large mammal that lives in the sea.

words.ex: The dolphin jumped high out of the water.
words.ex_cn: 海豚从水中高高跳起。
words.en: A dolphin is a marine mammal that is known for its intelligence and friendly nature towards humans.

words.ex: The octopus swims quickly in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 章鱼在海里游得很快。
words.en: An octopus is a sea creature with a soft, oval body and eight long arms.

words.ex: The frog jumps over the pond.
words.ex_cn: 青蛙跳过池塘。
words.en: A frog is a small creature with smooth skin, big eyes, and long back legs, which it uses for jumping. Frogs live in or near water.

words.ex: The tadpole swims in the pond.
words.ex_cn: 蝌蚪在池塘里游泳。
words.en: A tadpole is the larval stage in the life cycle of an amphibian, particularly that of a frog or toad.

words.ex: He ate grilled shrimp for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃了烤虾。
words.en: A shrimp is a small shellfish with a long tail and many legs, which can be eaten as food.

words.ex: He bought a fresh lobster at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一只新鲜的龙虾。
words.en: A lobster is a sea creature with a hard shell, two large claws, and eight legs, or the flesh of this animal eaten as food.

words.ex: He ate a fresh oyster for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃了一个新鲜的牡蛎。
words.en: An oyster is a large flat shellfish. Some oysters can be eaten and others produce valuable objects called pearls.

words.ex: He caught a crab at the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他在海滩上抓到一只蟹。
words.en: A crab is a sea creature with a flat round body covered by a shell, and five pairs of legs with large claws on the front pair. Crabs usually move sideways.

words.ex: He found a clam on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他在海滩上发现了一只蛤。
words.en: A clam is a type of shellfish with a shell in two parts that can open and close. Clams can be eaten as food.

words.ex: The fruit fly is a common pest in many households.
words.ex_cn: 果蝇是许多家庭中常见的害虫。
words.en: A fruit fly is a small fly that feeds on fruit and is often used in genetic research.

words.ex: The botanist studies plants in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这位植物学家在森林里研究植物。
words.en: A botanist is a scientist who studies plants.

words.tr:
n. 植物；工厂；发电厂；装置；
v. 种植；栽培；
words.ex: The plant grows near the window.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物长在窗边。
words.en: A plant is a living thing that grows in the earth and has a stem, leaves, and roots. As a verb, to plant means to put a seed or plant into the ground so that it will grow.

words.tr: phrase. 沼泽植物；生长在湿地或沼泽中的植物
words.ex: The marsh plant grows near the water.
words.ex_cn: 这种沼泽植物长在水边。
words.en: A plant that grows in or near marshes and wetlands.

words.tr: phrase. 寄主植物；宿主植物（为寄生生物提供生存环境或营养的植物）
words.ex: The caterpillar relies on the host plant for its nutrition.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫依赖寄主植物获取营养。
words.en: A plant that serves as a source of food or habitat for another organism, such as an insect or parasite.

words.tr:
n. 样品；样本；
v. 抽样；
words.ex: The scientist tested the sample from the river.
words.ex_cn: 科学家测试了来自河流的样品。
words.en: A sample is a small quantity of a product, especially food, given to customers so that they can try it before buying it.

words.ex: The teacher showed a specimen of a butterfly.
words.ex_cn: 老师展示了一个蝴蝶标本。
words.en: A specimen is a single thing or example of something, especially one that is used to represent the whole group or type.

words.tr:
n. 根；根源；
v. 生根；
words.ex: The root of 9 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 9的平方根是3。
words.en: The root of a plant is the part that grows underground and absorbs water and minerals. It can also refer to the origin or cause of something.

words.ex: Vegetables are rich in nutrient.
words.ex_cn: 蔬菜富含营养物。
words.en: A nutrient is a substance that is essential for life and growth, such as the vitamins and minerals in food.

words.ex: He uses fertilizer to help his plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 他用肥料帮助植物生长。
words.en: A substance that is added to soil to improve the growth of plants.

words.ex: Plants need nitrogen to grow.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要氮来生长。
words.en: A chemical element with the symbol N and atomic number 7. It is a colorless, odorless, tasteless gas that is the most plentiful element in Earth's atmosphere and is a constituent of all living tissues.

words.tr:
n. 茎；词干；
v. 起源于(~ from)；
words.ex: The flower grows on a long green stem.
words.ex_cn: 花长在一根长长的绿色茎上。
words.en: The main body or stalk of a plant or shrub, typically rising above ground but occasionally subterranean; to stop or restrict (the flow of something).

words.tr: v. 发芽；长出；迅速成长；涌现；
words.ex: The seed will sprout in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这颗种子会在春天发芽。
words.en: If a plant sprouts, or if it sprouts something, it produces new leaves or buds.

words.ex: The trees bud in spring.
words.ex_cn: 树木在春天发芽。
words.en: A bud is a small pointed lump that appears on a tree or plant and develops into a leaf or flower.

words.tr:
n. 茎；柄；梗
v. 跟踪；偷偷接近；昂首阔步地走
words.ex: The stalk of the sunflower is very tall.
words.ex_cn: 向日葵的茎很高。
words.en: The main stem of a plant, typically rising above ground but occasionally subterranean. Also, to pursue or approach stealthily.

words.ex: A bird built a nest on a small twig.
words.ex_cn: 一只鸟在一根小嫩枝上筑了巢。
words.en: A twig is a very small thin branch that grows out from a main branch of a tree or bush.

words.ex: The soldier shoot at the target.
words.ex_cn: 士兵向目标射击。
words.en: To shoot means to fire a bullet from a gun or to take a photograph. It can also refer to the act of a plant sprouting or a player attempting to score in sports by sending the ball or puck towards the goal.

words.tr: n. 藤；藤蔓；藤本植物；葡萄藤；
words.ex: The grapes grow on a vine.
words.ex_cn: 葡萄长在藤上。
words.en: A vine is a plant that climbs up or along a support, such as a wall or trellis, and produces fruit or flowers.

words.ex: The garden is full of bright flowers.
words.ex_cn: 花园里开满了鲜艳的花。
words.en: A flower is the part of a plant which is often brightly colored, grows at the end of a stem, and only survives for a short time.

words.tr:
n. （果树的）花朵；
v. 开花；
words.ex: The apple tree is full of blossom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，苹果树上开满了花。
words.en: When a tree or plant blossoms, it produces flowers before producing fruit that can be eaten.

words.ex: The rose has five pink petals.
words.ex_cn: 这朵玫瑰有五片粉红色的花瓣。
words.en: A petal is one of the colored parts of a flower that are often shaped like a leaf and grow in a circle around the center.

words.ex: The trees bud in spring.
words.ex_cn: 树木在春天发芽。
words.en: A bud is a small pointed lump that appears on a tree or plant and develops into a leaf or flower.

words.ex: Bees collect nectar from flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂从花朵中采集花蜜。
words.en: A sweet liquid secreted by flowers and collected by bees for making honey.

words.ex: Bees collect pollen from flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂从花朵中采集花粉。
