words.en: Pollen is a fine powder produced by flowers, which is carried by the wind or insects to other flowers of the same species, causing them to produce seeds.

words.ex: Bees pollinate flowers in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂给花园里的花授粉。
words.en: To pollinate means to transfer pollen from the male part of a flower to the female part, enabling fertilization and the production of seeds.

words.ex: The flowers wither in the hot sun.
words.ex_cn: 花朵在烈日下枯萎。
words.en: If a plant withers, it dries up and dies. If something withers, it becomes weaker or less important until it disappears completely.

words.ex: The apple shrivels in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 苹果在阳光下皱缩。
words.en: If something shrivels or if you shrivel it, it becomes dryer and smaller, often with lines in its surface, as a result of losing the water it contains.

words.tr:
n. 枯萎；凋谢；憔悴；
v. 枯萎；凋谢；憔悴；
words.ex: The flowers showed signs of wilt after the long heat.
words.ex_cn: 这些花在长时间高温后出现了枯萎的迹象。
words.en: If a plant wilts, it bends over because it is too dry, too hot, or too weak to stay upright.

words.ex: The colors of the painting fade in the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的颜色在阳光下逐渐消失。
words.en: To gradually grow faint and disappear.

words.ex: The apple's flesh is sweet and juicy.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的果肉又甜又多汁。
words.en: The soft substance consisting of muscle and fat that is found between the skin and bones of an animal or a human.

words.ex: The boy picked up a stone from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 男孩从地上捡起一块石头。
words.en: A stone is a small piece of rock that is found on the ground.

words.tr:
n. 核；核心；重点；
adj. 核心的；
words.ex: The core of the apple is not edible.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的核心不能吃。
words.en: The central or most important part of something.

words.ex: The kernel of the computer is the operating system.
words.ex_cn: 计算机的核心是操作系统。
words.en: The kernel of something such as a nut or a seed is the part inside the shell. The kernel of an idea or a theory is the central and most important part of it.

words.tr:
n. 果皮；
v. 去皮；剥落；
words.ex: The apple peel is rich in fiber.
words.ex_cn: 苹果皮富含纤维。
words.en: To remove the outer covering from something, especially a fruit or vegetable.

words.ex: The sun burned his skin.
words.ex_cn: 太阳晒伤了他的皮肤。
words.en: Your skin is the natural outer covering of your body.

words.tr:
n. 壳体；贝壳；炮弹；
v. 剥…的壳；去…的皮；炮轰；炮击；
words.ex: The crab crawled out of its shell.
words.ex_cn: 螃蟹从它的壳里爬了出来。
words.en: A shell is the hard protective outer case of a mollusk or crustacean, or the outer layer of an egg, nut, or seed. It can also refer to a metal case filled with explosive, to be fired from a gun.

words.tr: n. 树干；大衣箱；象鼻子；
words.ex: The elephant held the branch with its trunk.
words.ex_cn: 大象用它的鼻子抓住树枝。
words.en: The main stem of a tree, below the branches, and above the ground; the main part of the body, excluding the head, arms, and legs; the long, flexible nose of an elephant; a large, strong box used for transporting or storing clothes and other personal possessions.

words.ex: The tree has many branches.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树有许多分支。
words.en: A branch of a tree is one of its parts that grows out from its trunk. A branch of a business or organization is one of its offices or shops that are in different places.

words.ex: The bird sat on a heavy bough.
words.ex_cn: 鸟停在一根粗壮的树枝上。
words.en: A bough is a large branch of a tree.

words.ex: A bird built a nest on a small twig.
words.ex_cn: 一只鸟在一根小嫩枝上筑了巢。
words.en: A twig is a very small thin branch that grows out from a main branch of a tree or bush.

words.tr:
n. 树皮；
v. 狗吠；
words.ex: The dog climbed the tree and touched the bark.
words.ex_cn: 狗爬上了树，摸了摸树皮。
words.en: The sound a dog makes; the outer covering of a tree.

words.ex: The tropical plant grows in hot, wet places.
words.ex_cn: 这种热带植物生长在炎热潮湿的地方。
words.en: A tropical plant is a plant that grows naturally in the tropics, where the climate is warm and humid.

words.tr:
adj. 常绿的；常青的；
n. 常绿树；常绿植物；
words.ex: The evergreen trees stay green all year.
words.ex_cn: 常绿树一年四季都是绿色的。
words.en: An evergreen is a plant, tree, or bush that has green leaves all the year round.

words.ex: The lion lives in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 狮子生活在丛林中。
words.en: A jungle is a dense, tropical forest that is home to a wide variety of plants and animals.

words.ex: The pine tree stands tall in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 松树站在院子里，高高耸立。
words.en: A pine tree is a type of evergreen tree that has long, thin leaves called needles and produces cones.

words.ex: She picked up a needle to sew the button.
words.ex_cn: 她拿起一根针来缝纽扣。
words.en: A needle is a thin, pointed piece of metal that is used in sewing. It has a hole at one end for thread to pass through.

words.ex: The oak tree stands tall in the backyard.
words.ex_cn: 橡树站在后院里。
words.en: An oak tree is a large, strong tree that is common in northern countries, or the wood from this tree.

words.ex: The children play on the lawn after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在草坪上玩耍。
words.en: A lawn is an area of grass that is kept cut short and is usually part of someone's garden or yard, or part of a park.

words.ex: The cows are grazing in the meadow.
words.ex_cn: 牛群正在草地上吃草。
words.en: A meadow is a field with grass and often wild flowers in it.

words.ex: The cows graze on the prairie.
words.ex_cn: 牛在草原上吃草。
words.en: A prairie is a large area of flat, grassy land, especially in North America.

words.ex: The shrub grows near the fence.
words.ex_cn: 这丛灌木长在篱笆附近。
words.en: A shrub is a woody plant which is smaller than a tree and has several main stems arising at or near the ground.

words.ex: The cat hid behind the bush.
words.ex_cn: 猫躲到了灌木丛后面。
words.en: A bush is a plant which is much smaller than a tree and has a lot of branches.

words.tr:
n. 群；团；簇；
v. 聚集；
words.ex: The stars form a bright cluster in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 星星在夜空中形成了一群明亮的星群。
words.en: A cluster of things or people is a small group of them close together.

words.ex: The fern grows near the wet rock.
words.ex_cn: 蕨类植物长在潮湿的石头旁边。
words.en: A fern is a plant that has long stems with feathery or leafy fronds and reproduces by means of spores.

words.ex: She dried the herb to make tea.
words.ex_cn: 她晒干了这种药草来泡茶。
words.en: A plant or a part of a plant that is used for its medicinal, savory, or aromatic qualities.

words.tr: phrase. 草本茶；花草茶（不含茶叶成分，由植物的花、叶、根等泡制而成）
words.ex: She drinks herbal tea every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喝草药茶。
words.en: A drink made from the infusion or decoction of herbs, spices, or other plant material in hot water, often consumed for their perceived health benefits or for their soothing properties.

words.ex: The flower has a sweet fragrance.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花有一种甜美的香味。
words.en: A fragrance is a pleasant smell, especially that of a flower or perfume.

words.ex: She is flexible with her schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她的日程安排很灵活。
words.en: Able to change or be changed easily according to the situation.

words.ex: Plants use sunlight for photosynthesis.
words.ex_cn: 植物利用阳光进行光合作用。
words.en: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants and some other organisms use sunlight to synthesize foods from carbon dioxide and water.

words.ex: Plants use chlorophyll to make food from sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 植物利用叶绿素利用阳光制造食物。
words.en: Chlorophyll is a green pigment found in plants and algae that is essential for photosynthesis, the process by which light energy is converted into chemical energy.

words.ex: The seeds germinate in warm soil.
words.ex_cn: 种子在温暖的土壤中发芽。
words.en: To germinate means to begin to grow or develop, especially for a seed or spore.

words.ex: Some species have a mutualistic relationship, benefiting each other.
words.ex_cn: 一些物种之间存在共生关系，彼此受益。
words.en: Mutualistic refers to a relationship between organisms of different species in which each benefits from the activity of the other.

words.tr:
n. 杂交种；混合物；
adj. 混合的；
words.ex: The corn hybrid grows faster than the old type.
words.ex_cn: 这种玉米杂交种比旧品种长得更快。
words.en: A hybrid is a plant or animal that has been produced from two different types of plant or animal, especially to get better characteristics. It can also refer to something that is a mixture of two different things.

words.ex: He grows soybean in his field.
words.ex_cn: 他在田里种植大豆。
words.en: A soybean is a type of legume native to East Asia, widely grown for its edible bean which has numerous uses.

words.ex: He ate popcorn made from corn.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了用玉米做的爆米花。
words.en: Corn is a tall plant which produces long vegetables covered with yellow seeds. It is also a cereal crop.

words.ex: The density of water is 1 gram per cubic centimeter.
words.ex_cn: 水的密度是每立方厘米1克。
words.en: Density is a measure of how much mass is contained in a given unit volume of a substance.

words.ex: The amoeba is a one-celled organism.
words.ex_cn: 变形虫是一种单细胞生物。
words.en: Consisting of a single cell; unicellular.

words.ex: Bacteria can make you sick.
words.ex_cn: 细菌会让你生病。
words.en: Bacteria are very small organisms. Some bacteria can cause diseases.

words.ex: The fungus grows on old trees.
words.ex_cn: 真菌生长在老树上。
words.en: A fungus is a simple type of plant that has no leaves or flowers and that grows on plants or decaying matter.

words.ex: The enzyme helps break down food in the stomach.
words.ex_cn: 这种酶帮助分解胃里的食物。
words.en: An enzyme is a protein that acts as a catalyst to bring about a specific biochemical reaction.

words.ex: The bread rises because of fermentation.
words.ex_cn: 面包因发酵而膨胀。
words.en: Fermentation is a metabolic process that converts sugar to acids, gases, or alcohol. It occurs in yeast and bacteria, and also in oxygen-starved muscle cells, as in the case of lactic acid fermentation.

words.ex: The wound caused a serious infection.
words.ex_cn: 伤口引起了严重的感染。
words.en: An infection is a disease caused by microorganisms such as bacteria, viruses, or parasites invading the body.

words.ex: The epidemic spread quickly across the country.
words.ex_cn: 这种流行病迅速蔓延到全国。
words.en: An epidemic is a large number of cases of an infectious disease occurring at the same time.

words.ex: He got malaria from a mosquito bite.
words.ex_cn: 他被蚊子叮咬后得了疟疾。
words.en: Malaria is a disease caused by a parasite that is transmitted to humans through the bites of infected mosquitoes.

words.ex: The poison in the snake is a natural toxin.
words.ex_cn: 蛇的毒液是一种天然毒素。
words.en: A toxin is a poisonous substance, especially one produced by bacteria, which causes disease.

words.ex: The virus made many people sick.
words.ex_cn: 这个病毒让很多人病了。
words.en: A virus is a very small organism that causes infectious diseases in people, animals, and plants.

words.ex: Each cell has 46 chromosomes.
words.ex_cn: 每个细胞有46条染色体。
words.en: A chromosome is a thread-like structure of nucleic acids and protein found in the nucleus of most living cells, carrying genetic information in the form of genes.

words.ex: He has a gene that makes him tall.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个让他长高的基因。
words.en: A gene is the basic physical and functional unit of heredity. Genes, which are made up of DNA, act as instructions to make molecules called proteins.

words.tr: 名词短语. 遗传突变；基因发生永久性改变的现象，可能导致生物性状的变化
words.ex: The genetic mutation caused the plant to grow differently.
words.ex_cn: 这种基因突变使植物生长方式不同了。
words.en: A permanent alteration in the DNA sequence of an organism, which can be inherited or occur spontaneously.

words.ex: Heredity determines eye color in humans.
words.ex_cn: 遗传决定人类的眼睛颜色。
words.en: Heredity is the process by which features and characteristics are passed on from parents to their children before the children are born.

words.ex: Proteins are made of amino acids.
words.ex_cn: 蛋白质由氨基酸组成。
words.en: An amino acid is a type of organic acid that contains both a carboxyl group and an amino group, and is a basic component of proteins.

words.ex: The doctor gave him penicillin for his infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他开了青霉素治疗感染。
words.en: An antibiotic drug obtained from molds or produced synthetically, used to treat infections caused by bacteria.

words.tr: phrase. 生物制剂；生物战剂；生物因子（指能引起疾病的微生物或毒素等）
words.ex: The use of biological agents in warfare is strictly prohibited.
words.ex_cn: 在战争中使用生物战剂是被严格禁止的。
words.en: A living organism or toxin used in warfare or bioterrorism.

words.ex: The body makes an antibody to fight the virus.
words.ex_cn: 身体产生一种抗体来对抗病毒。
words.en: An antibody is a protein produced by the body's immune system when it detects harmful substances, called antigens. Each type of antibody is unique and defends the body against one specific type of antigen.

words.ex: He got a vaccine last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周打了疫苗。
words.en: A vaccine is a substance containing a virus or bacterium in a form that is not harmful, given to a person or animal to prevent them from getting the disease that the virus or bacterium causes.

words.ex: Bread and rice are rich in carbohydrate.
words.ex_cn: 面包和米饭富含碳水化合物。
words.en: A carbohydrate is a substance found in foods such as bread, potatoes, and rice which provides your body with heat and energy and which consists of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen.

words.ex: Plants take in carbon dioxide from the air.
words.ex_cn: 植物从空气中吸收二氧化碳。
words.en: Carbon dioxide is a gas that is produced when people and animals breathe out, or when carbon is burned in the air. It is used by plants in photosynthesis.

words.tr: n. 生物体；有机体；有机组织；
words.ex: A bacterium is a simple organism.
words.ex_cn: 细菌是一种简单的生物体。
words.en: An organism is a living thing that has an organized structure, can react to stimuli, reproduce, grow, adapt, and maintain homeostasis.

words.tr: n. 氧化；氧化作用；氧化反应
words.ex: The iron shows oxidation after being in the rain.
words.ex_cn: 铁在雨后出现了氧化。
words.en: Oxidation is a chemical reaction in which a substance combines with oxygen, or in which atoms lose electrons.

words.ex: He eats eggs for protein.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋来获取蛋白质。
words.en: Proteins are large, complex molecules that play many critical roles in the body. They are necessary for the structure, function, and regulation of the body's tissues and organs.

words.ex: The doctor checked his glucose level.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他的血糖水平。
words.en: A simple sugar which is an important energy source in living organisms and is a component of many carbohydrates.

words.ex: He loves watching stars and learning astronomy.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢看星星并学习天文学。
words.en: Astronomy is the scientific study of celestial objects, space, and the physical universe as a whole.

words.ex: He uses an astronomical telescope to watch stars.
words.ex_cn: 他用一架天文望远镜观察星星。
words.en: If you describe an amount, especially the cost of something as astronomical, you are emphasizing that it is very large indeed.

words.ex: The astronomer looks at stars through a telescope.
words.ex_cn: 这位天文学家通过望远镜观察星星。
words.en: An astronomer is a scientist who studies celestial bodies such as planets, stars, and galaxies.

words.ex: He loves studying astrophysics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在大学学习天体物理学。
words.en: Astrophysics is the branch of astronomy that deals with the physics of the universe, including the physical properties of celestial objects, as well as their interactions and behavior.

words.ex: He reads his horoscope every morning because he believes in astrology.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都看星座运势，因为他相信占星术。
words.en: Astrology is the study of the movements and relative positions of celestial bodies interpreted as having an influence on human affairs and the natural world.

words.ex: The car deviated from the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车偏离了道路。
words.en: To deviate means to do something that is different from the usual or common way of behaving.

words.ex: He loves studying cosmology to understand the universe.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢学习宇宙学来理解宇宙。
words.en: Cosmology is the study of the origin, structure, and evolution of the universe.

words.ex: The universe may be infinite.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙可能是无限的。
words.en: If you describe something as infinite, you are emphasizing that it is extremely great in amount or degree.

words.ex: The cosmic rays come from outer space.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙射线来自外太空。
words.en: Relating to the universe or cosmos, especially as distinct from the earth.

words.tr: adj. 天空的；天体的；天国的；
words.ex: The celestial lights shone brightly in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 天空中的光芒在夜空中明亮地闪耀。
words.en: Relating to the sky or the heavens; belonging or relating to heaven as the abode of the gods.

words.ex: The moon is a celestial body.
words.ex_cn: 月亮是一个天体。
words.en: A celestial body is any natural body outside the Earth's atmosphere, such as the Moon, the Sun, an asteroid, planet, or star.

words.ex: The moon is a heavenly body in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 月亮是夜空中一个天体。
words.en: A heavenly body is any natural body outside the Earth's atmosphere, such as a planet, star, or moon.

words.tr: phrase. 天球仪；天体仪（用于表示天体在天球上的位置）
words.ex: He bought a celestial globe to learn the stars.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个天球仪来学习星星。
words.en: A model of the celestial sphere showing stars, planets, and constellations.

words.tr: phrase. 地球仪；陆地 globe，用于表示地球表面的球形模型
words.ex: He spins the terrestrial globe to find countries.
words.ex_cn: 他转动地球仪来找国家。
words.en: A spherical model of the Earth, used to represent the planet's surface and geographical features.

words.tr: phrase. 天文导航；利用天体（如太阳、月亮、星星）确定位置的导航方法
words.ex: Sailors use celestial navigation to find their way at sea.
words.ex_cn: 水手们使用天文导航在海上辨别方向。
words.en: A method of determining position on Earth by observing celestial bodies like stars, the sun, and the moon.

words.ex: Astronavigation was crucial for ancient sailors to find their way across the oceans.
words.ex_cn: 天文导航对于古代水手跨越海洋至关重要。
words.en: The method of navigating by the positions of stars, planets, and other celestial bodies, especially in space travel.

words.ex: He gave a stellar performance in the play.
words.ex_cn: 他在剧中表现出色。
words.en: Of or relating to stars; outstanding or excellent.

words.ex: The telescope showed a bright nebula in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 望远镜在夜空中显示了一个明亮的星云。
words.en: A nebula is a cloud of gas and dust in outer space, visible in the night sky either as an indistinct bright patch or as a dark silhouette against other luminous matter.

words.ex: The star formed from a nebular cloud in space.
words.ex_cn: 这颗恒星是从太空中的星云形成的。
words.en: Relating to a nebula or nebulae; resembling a nebula.

words.ex: The fairy tale features a dwarf who lives in a small house.
words.ex_cn: 这个童话故事中有一个住在小房子里的侏儒。
words.en: A dwarf is a person, animal, or plant that is much smaller than the usual size of its species. As a verb, to dwarf means to make someone or something seem small or insignificant in comparison.

words.ex: The star shines brightly in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 这颗星星在夜空中明亮地闪耀。
words.en: A star is a large ball of burning gas in space that you can see as a point of light in the sky at night.

words.tr: n. 星座；一群杰出人物；一系列（相关的想法、事物）
words.ex: He saw the Orion constellation in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 他在夜空中看到了猎户座。
words.en: A constellation is a group of stars which form a pattern and have a name.

words.ex: The shield volcano is characterized by its broad, gently sloping sides.
words.ex_cn: n. 盾状火山的特点是具有宽阔且平缓的斜坡。
words.en: A shield volcano is a type of volcano usually built almost entirely of fluid lava flows. They are named for their broad, shield-like profiles, resembling a warrior's shield lying on the ground.

words.ex: The Milky Way is our home galaxy.
words.ex_cn: 银河系是我们所在的星系。
words.en: A galaxy is an extremely large group of stars and planets that extends over many billions of light years.

words.ex: The milky way is bright in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 银河在夜空中很明亮。
words.en: The Milky Way is the galaxy that contains our Solar System, with the name describing the galaxy's appearance from Earth: a hazy band of light seen in the night sky formed from stars that cannot be individually distinguished by the naked eye.

words.ex: The change in her mood was observable.
words.ex_cn: 她情绪的变化是能察觉到的。
words.en: Something that is observable can be seen or noticed.

words.tr:
n. 群；团；簇；
v. 聚集；
words.ex: The stars form a bright cluster in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 星星在夜空中形成了一群明亮的星群。
words.en: A cluster of things or people is a small group of them close together.

words.ex: The solar panel collects energy from the sun.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能板从太阳收集能量。
words.en: Solar means relating to the sun or using the energy from the sun to produce electricity.

words.ex: The Earth is part of the solar system.
words.ex_cn: 地球是太阳系的一部分。
words.en: The solar system is the collection of eight planets and their moons in orbit around the Sun, together with smaller bodies in the form of asteroids, meteoroids, comets, and dwarf planets.

words.ex: The solar corona is visible during a total solar eclipse.
words.ex_cn: 日全食期间可以看到日冕。
words.en: The solar corona is the outermost part of the Sun's atmosphere, which is usually hidden by the bright light of the Sun's surface. It can be seen during a total solar eclipse.

words.ex: The sun gives us solar radiation.
words.ex_cn: 太阳给我们太阳辐射。
words.en: Solar radiation refers to the energy emitted by the sun, which reaches the Earth in the form of electromagnetic waves. It is essential for various processes on Earth, including photosynthesis in plants and the regulation of the Earth's climate.

words.ex: The planet Mars is red.
words.ex_cn: 火星是红色的。
words.en: A planet is a large object in space that moves around a star, such as the sun, and does not produce its own light.

words.ex: The small planetoid orbits the sun far from Earth.
words.ex_cn: 这个小行星体在远离地球的地方绕太阳运行。
words.en: A planetoid is a small celestial body that orbits the Sun, typically found in the asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter.

words.ex: The asteroid flew past Earth safely.
words.ex_cn: 这颗小行星安全地从地球旁飞过。
words.en: An asteroid is a small rocky body orbiting the sun. Large numbers of these, ranging enormously in size, are found between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter, though some have more eccentric orbits.

words.ex: The Earth revolves around the Sun.
words.ex_cn: 地球围绕太阳转。
words.en: If something revolves or if you revolve something, it moves or turns around a central point or line.

words.tr:
v. 闪耀；闪烁
n. 闪烁
words.ex: The stars twinkle in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 星星在夜空中闪烁。
words.en: If a star or a light twinkles, it shines with an unsteady light that rapidly and gently changes from bright to faint.

words.ex: You can see the moon with the naked eye.
words.ex_cn: 你可以用肉眼看到月亮。
words.en: The naked eye is the human eye unaided by any instrument that magnifies or otherwise enhances the vision.

words.ex: The thermometer contains mercury.
words.ex_cn: 温度计里含有水银。
words.en: Mercury is a heavy, silvery-white metal that is liquid at room temperature. It is used in thermometers, barometers, and other scientific apparatus.

words.ex: Venus is the brightest planet in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 金星是夜空中最亮的行星。
words.en: Venus is the second planet from the Sun, orbiting it every 224.7 Earth days. It is named after the Roman goddess of love and beauty.

words.ex: The earth goes around the sun.
words.ex_cn: 地球围绕太阳运转。
words.en: The planet on which we live; the land surface of the world as distinct from the sea or the air.

words.ex: The rover is exploring mars.
words.ex_cn: 探测器正在探索火星。
words.en: Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun in the Solar System and the second-smallest planet in the Solar System, after Mercury. Named after the Roman god of war, it is often referred to as the 'Red Planet' because the iron oxide prevalent on its surface gives it a reddish appearance.

words.ex: Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system.
words.ex_cn: 木星是我们太阳系中最大的行星。
words.en: Jupiter is the largest planet in the solar system, known for its prominent Great Red Spot and numerous moons.

words.ex: Saturn has beautiful rings around it.
words.ex_cn: 土星周围有美丽的光环。
words.en: Saturn is the sixth planet from the Sun in the Solar System and is known for its prominent ring system, which is composed mainly of ice particles with a smaller amount of rocky debris and dust.

words.ex: Uranus is the seventh planet from the Sun.
words.ex_cn: 天王星是离太阳第七远的行星。
words.en: Uranus is the seventh planet from the Sun in the Solar System. It has the third-largest planetary radius and fourth-largest planetary mass in the Solar System.

words.tr: n. 海王星；（罗马神话）海神尼普顿
words.ex: Neptune is the eighth planet from the sun.
words.ex_cn: 海王星是离太阳第八远的行星。
words.en: Neptune is the eighth and farthest known planet from the Sun in the Solar System. It is the fourth-largest planet by diameter, the third-most-massive planet, and the densest giant planet.

words.ex: Pluto is a dwarf planet far from the sun.
words.ex_cn: 冥王星是离太阳很远的一颗矮行星。
words.en: Pluto is a dwarf planet in the Kuiper belt, a ring of bodies beyond Neptune.

words.tr:
n. 轨道；
v. 绕...轨道而行；
words.ex: The moon moves around the Earth in an orbit.
words.ex_cn: 月亮围绕地球在轨道上运行。
words.en: An orbit is the curved path, usually elliptical, described by a planet, satellite, spaceship, etc., around a celestial body, as the sun.

words.tr:
n. 旋转；
v. 旋转；
words.ex: The spin of the top made it stay upright.
words.ex_cn: 陀螺的旋转让它保持直立。
words.en: If something spins or if you spin it, it turns quickly around a central point.

words.ex: The satellite sends pictures from space.
words.ex_cn: 卫星从太空发送图片。
words.en: A satellite is an object which has been sent into space in order to collect information or to be part of a communications system. Satellites move continually round the earth or around another planet.

words.ex: The lunar surface is covered with dust.
words.ex_cn: 月球表面覆盖着尘土。
words.en: Of or relating to the moon.

words.ex: A meteoroid flew across the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 一颗流星体划过了夜空。
words.en: A meteoroid is a small rocky or metallic body in outer space. Meteoroids are significantly smaller than asteroids, and range in size from small grains to one-meter-wide objects. Objects smaller than this are classified as micrometeoroids or space dust.

words.ex: A bright meteor flashed across the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 一颗明亮的流星划过夜空。
words.en: A meteor is a piece of rock or metal that burns very brightly when it enters the earth's atmosphere from space.

words.ex: We saw a meteor shower last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚看到了流星雨。
words.en: A meteor shower is a celestial event in which a number of meteors are observed to radiate, or originate, from one point in the night sky.

words.ex: The boy found a meteorite in the field.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在田野里发现了一块陨石。
words.en: A meteorite is a piece of rock or metal that has fallen to the earth's surface from outer space.

words.ex: The comet shines brightly in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 彗星在夜空中明亮地闪耀。
words.en: A comet is a celestial object consisting of a nucleus of ice and dust and, when near the sun, a 'tail' of gas and dust particles pointing away from the sun.

words.tr:
n. 空间；太空；空格；
v. 以一定间隔排列；
words.ex: The room has enough space for a bed and a desk.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有足够的空间放一张床和一张书桌。
words.en: Space refers to the physical dimensions in which objects exist and move, including the vast expanse beyond the Earth's atmosphere, known as outer space. It can also denote the interval or distance between two or more objects, or a period of time. As a verb, it means to arrange with spaces in between.

words.ex: Astronauts travel to outer space in rockets.
words.ex_cn: 宇航员乘坐火箭前往外太空。
words.en: The physical universe beyond the earth's atmosphere.

words.ex: The spacecraft landed safely on Mars.
words.ex_cn: 航天器在火星上安全着陆。
words.en: A spacecraft is a vehicle or machine designed to fly in outer space. Spacecraft are used for a variety of purposes, including communications, Earth observation, meteorology, navigation, space colonization, planetary exploration, and transportation of humans and cargo.

words.ex: The spaceship flew to the moon.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙飞船飞到了月球。
words.en: A spacecraft designed for travel or operation in outer space.

words.tr: phrase. 太空舱；宇宙飞船的返回舱
words.ex: The astronaut climbed into the space capsule.
words.ex_cn: 宇航员进入了太空舱。
words.en: A space capsule is a spacecraft designed to transport people or equipment in space, especially one that is part of a larger spacecraft and can return to Earth.

words.tr: n. 太空实验室；空间实验室
words.ex: The astronauts worked in Spacelab for two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 宇航员在太空实验室工作了两周。
words.en: A former NASA space station laboratory module used for scientific research in Earth's orbit.

words.ex: The spaceman walked on the moon.
words.ex_cn: 宇航员在月球上行走。
words.en: A spaceman is an astronaut, especially a male one, who travels in space.

words.ex: The astronaut walked on the moon.
words.ex_cn: 这名宇航员在月球上行走。
words.en: An astronaut is a person who is trained to travel in a spacecraft.

words.ex: The cosmonaut successfully completed the space mission.
words.ex_cn: 这位俄国宇航员成功完成了太空任务。
words.en: A cosmonaut is an astronaut from the former Soviet Union or Russia.

words.ex: The astronaut wears a space suit to walk in space.
words.ex_cn: 宇航员穿着宇航服在太空中行走。
words.en: A garment worn by astronauts to provide a pressurized, breathable environment and protection from extreme temperatures and radiation in space.

words.ex: The space shuttle flew to the International Space Station.
words.ex_cn: 航天飞机飞往国际空间站。
words.en: A spacecraft designed for repeated use, typically carrying astronauts and equipment between Earth and a space station or other celestial body.

words.tr: phrase. 太空望远镜；用于在地球大气层外观测天体的天文望远镜
words.ex: The space telescope shows stars far away.
words.ex_cn: 太空望远镜展示了遥远的恒星。
words.en: A telescope placed in orbit above Earth's atmosphere to observe celestial objects without atmospheric distortion or interference.

words.ex: The asteroid flew past Earth safely.
words.ex_cn: 这颗小行星安全地从地球旁飞过。
words.en: An asteroid is a small rocky body orbiting the sun. Large numbers of these, ranging enormously in size, are found between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter, though some have more eccentric orbits.

words.ex: The universe is very big.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙非常大。
words.en: The universe is the whole of space and everything in it, including stars, planets, and galaxies.

words.ex: He loves to watch the cosmos at night.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在夜晚观看宇宙。
words.en: The cosmos refers to the universe seen as a well-ordered whole, or to any system or structure that is complex and orderly.

words.tr: n. 紫外线辐射；紫外光；
words.ex: The ultraviolet from the sun can hurt your skin.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的紫外线会伤害你的皮肤。
words.en: Ultraviolet light or radiation has a wavelength shorter than that of visible light but longer than X-rays.

words.ex: The infrared ray warms the skin.
words.ex_cn: 红外线温暖皮肤。
words.en: Infrared rays are electromagnetic waves with wavelengths longer than visible light but shorter than microwaves, used in various applications such as thermal imaging and communication.

words.ex: The wheel rotates slowly.
words.ex_cn: 轮子缓慢地转动。
words.en: To rotate means to turn or cause to turn around an axis or center.

words.ex: The rotation of teachers helps the school run smoothly.
words.ex_cn: 教师的轮换有助于学校顺利运行。
words.en: Rotation refers to the action of rotating around an axis or center.

words.ex: The factory reduces emission to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 工厂减少排放以保护环境。
words.en: An emission is the production and discharge of something, especially gas or radiation.

words.tr: phrase. 太空碎片；轨道上废弃的人造物体，如报废卫星、火箭残骸等
words.ex: Space debris floats around the Earth.
words.ex_cn: 太空碎片在地球周围漂浮。
words.en: Space debris refers to the collection of defunct human-made objects in orbit around Earth, including old satellites, spent rocket stages, and fragments from disintegration, erosion, and collisions.

words.ex: The seafarer's life is filled with adventure and danger.
words.ex_cn: 船员的生活充满了冒险和危险。
words.en: A seafarer is a person who travels by sea, especially one who works on a ship.

words.tr: phrase. 天顶星：位于观测者正上方天顶位置的恒星
words.ex: The astronomer saw the zenith star at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 天文学家在午夜看到了天顶星。
words.en: A star that is directly overhead at a specific location and time, used historically for navigation and in astronomy to determine latitude.

words.ex: He loves geography and learns about countries and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢地理学，学习各国和河流的知识。
words.en: The study of the physical features of the earth and its atmosphere, and of human activity as it affects and is affected by these, including the distribution of populations and resources, land use, and industries.

words.ex: The geographer maps rivers and mountains.
words.ex_cn: 地理学家绘制河流和山脉。
words.en: A geographer is a scientist who studies the Earth's physical features and human populations, including their interactions with the environment.

words.ex: The Earth is divided into two hemispheres: north and south.
words.ex_cn: 地球被分为两个半球：北半球和南半球。
words.en: A hemisphere is one half of the earth, especially the northern or southern half above or below the equator, or the eastern or western half.

words.ex: The northern and southern hemispheres have opposite seasons.
words.ex_cn: 北半球和南半球的季节相反。
words.en: The two halves of the Earth divided by the Equator, with distinct climate and seasonal patterns.

words.ex: The equator divides the earth into eastern and western hemispheres.
words.ex_cn: 赤道把地球分成东半球和西半球。
words.en: The two halves of the Earth divided by the Prime Meridian and the 180th meridian, representing the Eastern and Western worlds.

words.tr:
adj. 平行的；
n. 类似的事物；
words.ex: The two lines are parallel and never meet.
words.ex_cn: 这两条线是平行的，永远不会相交。
words.en: Something that is parallel to something else is similar to it in many ways, or happens at the same time as it.

words.ex: The city is at a latitude of 40 degrees north.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市位于北纬40度。
words.en: Latitude is the distance of a place north or south of the equator, measured in degrees.

words.ex: The trees grow well in temperate latitudes.
words.ex_cn: 这些树在温带地区生长良好。
words.en: The regions of the Earth located between the Tropic of Cancer and the Arctic Circle in the Northern Hemisphere, and between the Tropic of Capricorn and the Antarctic Circle in the Southern Hemisphere, characterized by moderate climate conditions.

words.ex: The ship's longitude is 45 degrees west.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船的经度是西经45度。
words.en: Longitude is the distance of a place east or west of the Greenwich meridian, measured in degrees.

words.tr: n. 地平线；思想等的范围；眼界；
words.ex: The sun set below the horizon.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在地平线以下落山。
words.en: The horizon is the line at which the earth's surface and the sky appear to meet.

words.ex: The equator divides the Earth into two halves.
words.ex_cn: 赤道将地球分为两半。
words.en: The equator is an imaginary line around the Earth, equally distant from the North Pole and the South Pole, dividing the Earth into the Northern Hemisphere and the Southern Hemisphere.

words.ex: Many animals live in the tropics.
words.ex_cn: 许多动物生活在热带地区。
words.en: The tropics are the part of the Earth's surface that is closest to the equator, characterized by a hot climate.

words.tr:
n. 北极地区；
adj. 北极的；
words.ex: Polar bears live in the arctic.
words.ex_cn: 北极熊生活在北极地区。
words.en: The Arctic is the area around the Earth's North Pole, characterized by cold temperatures and ice.

words.tr:
adj. 南极的；
n. 南极地区；
words.ex: The antarctic ice is melting fast.
words.ex_cn: 南极的冰正在迅速融化。
words.en: The Antarctic is the area around the South Pole, characterized by its cold climate and ice-covered landscapes.

words.ex: Penguins live in Antarctica.
words.ex_cn: 企鹅生活在南极洲。
words.en: Antarctica is the Earth's southernmost continent, containing the geographic South Pole. It is situated in the Antarctic region of the Southern Hemisphere, almost entirely south of the Antarctic Circle, and is surrounded by the Southern Ocean.

words.ex: The team went on an expedition to the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍去山上探险了。
words.en: An expedition is an organized journey that is made for a particular purpose such as exploration.

words.ex: This is a no-parking zone.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个禁止停车的地带。
words.en: An area or a region distinguished from adjacent parts by a distinctive feature or characteristic.

words.ex: He lives in a different time zone from me.
words.ex_cn: 他住在我不同的时区。
words.en: A time zone is a region of the Earth that has a uniform standard time for legal, commercial, and social purposes.

words.ex: The map shows the topography of the mountain area.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图显示了山区的地形。
words.en: The topography of an area is the physical features of its surface, such as hills, valleys, and rivers, especially the representation of these features on maps.

words.tr:
n. 平原；
adj. 简单明了的；朴素的；
words.ex: The cows graze on the plain.
words.ex_cn: 牛在平原上吃草。
words.en: If something is plain, it is easy to see, hear, or understand.

words.tr:
n. 低地；
adj. 低地的；
words.ex: The farmers live in the lowland near the river.
words.ex_cn: 农民们住在河边的低地上。
words.en: Lowland refers to an area of land that is low in relation to the surrounding country.

words.tr: n. 盆地；流域；水池；脸盆；
words.ex: The river flows into a large basin.
words.ex_cn: 河流流入一个巨大的盆地。
words.en: A basin is a large or small depression in the Earth's surface or a large container that holds water.

words.ex: The boy found a dark cave near the hill.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在山附近发现了一个黑暗的洞穴。
words.en: A cave is a large hole in the side of a cliff or hill, or one that is under the ground.

words.ex: The hikers struggled across the rough terrain.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者艰难地穿越了崎岖的地形。
words.en: Terrain is used to refer to an area of land or a type of land when you are considering its physical features.

words.ex: The subterranean tunnel connects two buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这条地下的隧道连接着两栋大楼。
words.en: Existing, occurring, or done under the earth's surface.

words.tr:
adj. 地下的；
n. 地铁；地下；
adv. 在地下；
words.ex: The underground tunnel connects two buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这条地下的隧道连接了两座建筑。
words.en: Something that is underground is below the surface of the ground. It can also refer to secret activities or organizations.

words.ex: The fishers live in a coastal region near the sea.
words.ex_cn: 渔民住在靠近大海的沿海地区。
words.en: coastal region: an area of land near the sea or ocean

words.ex: He lives on a small island.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个小岛上。
words.en: An island is a piece of land that is completely surrounded by water.

words.ex: Greenland is a continental island.
words.ex_cn: 格陵兰是一个大陆岛。
words.en: A continental island is an island that is part of a continental shelf and was once connected to a continent.

words.ex: The volcano erupted last year.
words.ex_cn: 这座火山去年喷发了。
words.en: A volcano is a mountain that opens downward to a pool of molten rock below the surface of the earth. When pressure builds up, eruptions occur.

words.ex: Hawaii is a volcanic island in the Pacific Ocean.
words.ex_cn: 夏威夷是太平洋中的一个火山岛。
words.en: An island that has been formed by volcanic activity.

words.ex: The volcano had a big eruption last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周这座火山发生了大喷发。
words.en: An eruption is a sudden, often violent, outburst or discharge, such as that of a volcano, emotion, or conflict.

words.ex: He visited a small coral island in the Pacific.
words.ex_cn: 他参观了太平洋上一个小小的珊瑚岛。
words.en: A coral island is an island that has been formed from coral.

words.ex: The small islet is surrounded by blue water.
words.ex_cn: 这个小岛被蓝色的海水环绕。
words.en: A very small island.

words.ex: The peninsular town has narrow streets and old houses.
words.ex_cn: 这个半岛上的小镇有狭窄的街道和古老的房屋。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of a peninsula; resembling a peninsula.

words.ex: Asia is the largest continent.
words.ex_cn: 亚洲是最大的洲。
words.en: A continent is a very large area of land, such as Africa or Asia, that consists of several countries.

words.ex: The fish live on the continental shelf near the coast.
words.ex_cn: 鱼生活在近海的大陆架上。
words.en: The continental shelf is the extended perimeter of each continent and associated coastal plain, and is part of the continental crust.

words.tr: n. [地理] 山脉；[仪] 量程；范围；[数]值域，极差（range的复数）；
words.ex: The Rocky Ranges stretch across western North America.
words.ex_cn: 落基山脉横跨北美西部。
words.en: If things range between two points or range from one point to another, they vary within these points on a scale of measurement or quality.

words.ex: The village is located in a quiet valley.
words.ex_cn: 村庄坐落在一个宁静的山谷中。
words.en: A valley is a low area of land between hills or mountains, typically with a river or stream flowing through it.

words.ex: The river flows through a deep canyon.
words.ex_cn: 河流流经一个深峡谷。
words.en: A canyon is a large valley with very steep sides and usually a river flowing along the bottom.

words.tr:
n. 海峡；渠道；河床；频道；
v. 引导；
words.ex: The English Channel separates England from France.
words.ex_cn: 英吉利海峡将英格兰与法国分隔开。
words.en: A channel is a television station and the programs that it broadcasts. A channel is also a method or system that people use to send information, goods, etc. to each other.

words.ex: The ship sailed through the strait at night.
words.ex_cn: 船在夜间通过了海峡。
words.en: A strait is a narrow passage of water connecting two seas or two large areas of water.

words.ex: The wetland is home to many birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片湿地是许多鸟类的家园。
words.en: Wetlands are areas where water covers the soil, or is present either at or near the surface of the soil all year or for varying periods of time during the year, including during the growing season.

words.ex: The elevation of his skills helped him get a better job.
words.ex_cn: 他技能的提升帮助他找到了一份更好的工作。
words.en: The height to which something is elevated or to which it rises.

words.ex: The village is at an altitude of 2,000 meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的海拔是2000米。
words.en: The height of an object or point in relation to sea level or ground level.

words.ex: Scientists use remote-sensing to monitor forests from satellites.
words.ex_cn: 科学家使用遥感技术从卫星上监测森林。
words.en: Remote-sensing refers to the acquisition of information about an object or phenomenon without making physical contact with the object, typically by using satellite or aircraft-based sensor technologies.

words.tr: phrase. 地球仪；陆地 globe，用于表示地球表面的球形模型
words.ex: He spins the terrestrial globe to find countries.
words.ex_cn: 他转动地球仪来找国家。
words.en: A spherical model of the Earth, used to represent the planet's surface and geographical features.

words.ex: The town uses geothermal energy to heat homes.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇利用地热能为房屋供暖。
words.en: Geothermal refers to the heat that comes from the sub-surface of the earth. It is contained in the rocks and fluids beneath the earth's crust and can be found as far down as to the earth's hot molten rock, magma.

words.tr: phrase. 地热；地球内部产生的热量
words.ex: Terrestrial heat comes from inside the Earth.
words.ex_cn: 地热来自地球内部。
words.en: Heat energy generated and stored in the Earth.

words.ex: The sun affects geomagnetism on Earth.
words.ex_cn: 太阳影响地球的地磁现象。
words.en: The study of the Earth's magnetic field, including its origin, structure, and variations.

words.ex: He loves studying geology in high school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在高中学习地质学。
words.en: The science which deals with the physical structure and substance of the earth, their history, and the processes which act on them.

words.ex: The geologist studied rocks in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这位地质学家研究了山里的岩石。
words.en: A geologist is a scientist who studies the solid, liquid, and gaseous matter that constitutes the Earth and other terrestrial planets, as well as the processes that shape them.

words.tr: n. 地质学家（geologist 的非标准或罕见变体形式）
words.ex: The geologician studied rocks in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这位地质学家研究了山中的岩石。
words.en: A specialist in geology, the scientific study of the Earth's physical structure, substance, history, and processes.

words.tr: phrase. 地质年代；地质时代
words.ex: This rock has a geologic age of 200 million years.
words.ex_cn: 这块岩石的地质年代为两亿年。
words.en: A specific period in the Earth's history defined by significant geological events and the fossil record.

words.ex: The rock layers show changes over geological time.
words.ex_cn: 岩层展示了地质时间内的变化。
words.en: The entire span of time from the formation of the Earth to the present, studied through geological evidence.

words.tr: n. 地质年代学；地质年代表
words.ex: He studies geochronology to date ancient rocks.
words.ex_cn: 他研究地质年代学来测定古老岩石的年代。
words.en: The branch of geology concerned with determining the age of rocks, fossils, and geological events.

words.tr: n. 地球科学; 地学
words.ex: He loves geoscience because it explains rocks and earthquakes.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢地球科学，因为它解释了岩石和地震。
words.en: The scientific study of the Earth's physical structure, substance, history, and processes.

words.tr: phrase. 地球科学（研究地球及其组成部分、过程和历史的学科，包括地质学、气象学、海洋学和天文学等）
words.ex: He likes to study earth science in school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在学校学习地球科学。
words.en: The scientific study of the Earth, including its composition, structure, processes, and history.

words.ex: The earth's crust is made of rock.
words.ex_cn: 地球的地壳由岩石组成。
words.en: The crust is the hard outer layer of something, such as bread or the Earth's surface.

words.ex: The continental crust is thicker than the oceanic crust.
words.ex_cn: 大陆地壳比大洋地壳更厚。
words.en: The continental crust is the layer of igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic rocks that forms the continents and the areas of shallow seabed close to their shores, known as continental shelves.

words.ex: The oceanic crust is thin and made of basalt.
words.ex_cn: 大洋地壳很薄，由玄武岩组成。
words.en: The oceanic crust is the outermost layer of Earth's lithosphere that lies beneath the oceans.

words.ex: The cake has three layers of chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕有三层巧克力。
words.en: A layer of a substance or material is a quantity or piece of it that covers a surface or that is between two other things.

words.ex: The mantle lies below the Earth's crust.
words.ex_cn: 地幔位于地球地壳之下。
words.en: The mantle is the part of the earth between the crust and the core. It can also refer to a cloak or covering.

words.tr:
n. 核；核心；重点；
adj. 核心的；
words.ex: The core of the apple is not edible.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的核心不能吃。
words.en: The central or most important part of something.

words.ex: She put the food on a clean plate.
words.ex_cn: 她把食物放在一个干净的盘子里。
words.en: A flat dish, typically circular and made of china, from which food is eaten or served.

words.ex: Scientists study plate tectonics to understand earthquakes.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究板块构造以理解地震。
words.en: Plate tectonics is a scientific theory describing the large-scale motion of seven large plates and the movements of a larger number of smaller plates of the Earth's lithosphere, since tectonic processes began on Earth between 3 and 3.5 billion years ago.

words.tr: n. 过错；故障；缺陷；断层；
words.ex: It was his fault that the car crashed.
words.ex_cn: 汽车撞车是他的过错。
words.en: A fault is a mistake or a weakness in something or someone.

words.ex: The old bridge began disintegration after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧桥在风暴后开始崩解。
words.en: The process of breaking into small parts or pieces and losing strength or effectiveness.

words.ex: The decomposition of the apple took weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果的分解花了几个星期。
words.en: Decomposition is the process by which organic substances are broken down into simpler organic or inorganic matter such as carbon dioxide, water, simple sugars and mineral salts.

words.ex: Water causes erosion of the soil.
words.ex_cn: 水会导致土壤腐蚀。
words.en: The process by which the surface of the earth is worn away by the action of water, glaciers, winds, waves, etc.

words.ex: The boy found a fossil in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在岩石中发现了一块化石。
words.en: A fossil is the remains or impression of a prehistoric organism preserved in petrified form or as a mold or cast in rock.

words.tr:
n. 岩石；摇滚乐；
v. （使）摇动；（使）摇晃；
words.ex: The children climbed on the big rock near the river.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在河边的大岩石上攀爬。
words.en: A rock is a large piece of stone that forms part of a hill or mountain. Rock can also refer to a type of music that is loud and has a strong beat. As a verb, to rock means to move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side.

words.ex: Sedimentary rocks are formed from the accumulation of sediments over time.
words.ex_cn: 沉积岩是由长时间沉积物的积累形成的。
words.en: Sedimentary rock is a type of rock that is formed by the accumulation or deposition of mineral or organic particles at the Earth's surface, followed by cementation.

words.tr: phrase. 变质岩（由火成岩或沉积岩在高温高压下发生矿物成分或结构变化而形成的一类岩石）
words.ex: The mountain has metamorphic rock deep inside.
words.ex_cn: 这座山内部有变质岩。
words.en: A type of rock that has been transformed from its original form by heat, pressure, or chemical processes.

words.ex: The clock has a quartz crystal inside.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟里面有一个石英晶体。
words.en: Quartz is a hard, crystalline mineral composed of silicon and oxygen atoms. It is one of the most common minerals in the Earth's continental crust.

words.ex: The building is made of limestone.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑是由石灰岩建造的。
words.en: Limestone is a sedimentary rock composed largely of the mineral calcite (calcium carbonate: CaCO3).

words.ex: The statue is made of white marble.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像由白色大理石制成。
words.en: Marble is a type of very hard rock which is used for making statues and for building. It is usually white with dark lines in it.

words.ex: The table is made of granite.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是花岗岩做的。
words.en: Granite is a very hard rock that is often used in building.

words.ex: The volcano spewed hot magma into the air.
words.ex_cn: 火山喷出了炽热的岩浆。
words.en: Magma is molten rock that is found beneath the surface of the Earth, and which may erupt from a volcano as lava.

words.ex: The prospect of a better job makes him happy.
words.ex_cn: 更好工作的前景让他感到高兴。
words.en: A prospect is the possibility that something will happen, or a view of a wide area.

words.tr: v. 听起来；响；“sound”的现在分词；
words.ex: The music is sounding better now.
words.ex_cn: 现在音乐听起来更好了。
words.en: Sounding can refer to the act of measuring the depth of water or the process of making a sound. It can also describe something that appears to be a certain way based on how it sounds.

words.tr:
pron. 我的（东西）；
n. 矿；
v. 采矿；
words.ex: This book is mine.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是我的。
words.en: Used to refer to a thing or things belonging to or associated with the speaker. A place where minerals are extracted from the earth. To extract minerals from the earth.

words.ex: Rock contains many minerals.
words.ex_cn: 岩石中含有许多矿物。
words.en: A mineral is a solid substance that occurs naturally and has a specific chemical composition and structure.

words.ex: The miners dug deep to find iron ore.
words.ex_cn: 矿工们深入地下寻找铁矿石。
words.en: Ore is rock or earth from which metal can be obtained.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.ex: The ring is made of platinum.
words.ex_cn: 这个戒指是铂金做的。
words.en: Platinum is a precious metal, silver-white in color, that is used especially in jewelry and in industry.

words.ex: The wire is made of copper.
words.ex_cn: 这根电线是铜制的。
words.en: Copper is a reddish-brown metal that is used especially for making wire and coins.

words.ex: He uses aluminum foil to wrap the food.
words.ex_cn: 他用铝箔纸包食物。
words.en: A light, silvery metal that is used especially for making cooking equipment and aircraft parts.

words.ex: The bottle contains zinc to help your body stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子里含有锌，有助于你的身体健康。
words.en: Zinc is a bluish-white metal that is used in making other metals or for covering other metals to protect them.

words.ex: The sheep graze on the highland.
words.ex_cn: 羊在高地上吃草。
words.en: Highland refers to an area of high or mountainous land, often characterized by its elevation above sea level and distinct geographical features.

words.ex: The thermometer contains mercury.
words.ex_cn: 温度计里含有水银。
words.en: Mercury is a heavy, silvery-white metal that is liquid at room temperature. It is used in thermometers, barometers, and other scientific apparatus.

words.tr: n. 水银，汞；变化莫测的事物; adj. 瞬息万变的; v. 用水银处理
words.ex: The quicksilver flowed fast in the thermometer.
words.ex_cn: 水银在温度计里快速流动。
words.en: Quicksilver is an old-fashioned name for mercury, a heavy, silvery metal that is liquid at room temperature.

words.ex: She wore a red gem on her necklace.
words.ex_cn: 她脖子上戴着一颗红宝石。
words.en: A gem is a jewel or stone that is used in jewellery.

words.ex: She wore a diamond ring on her finger.
words.ex_cn: 她手指上戴着一枚钻石戒指。
words.en: A diamond is a precious stone consisting of a clear and colorless crystalline form of pure carbon, the hardest naturally occurring substance.

words.ex: The ice age covered big parts of the Earth with ice.
words.ex_cn: 冰河时代使地球的大部分地区被冰覆盖。
words.en: A period in the Earth's history when ice sheets covered large areas of the planet's surface.

words.ex: The interglacial period had warm weather and tall trees.
words.ex_cn: 间冰期气候温暖，树木高大。
words.en: An interglacial period is a geological interval of warmer global average temperature lasting thousands of years that separates consecutive glacial periods within an ice age.

words.ex: The glacier moves slowly down the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 冰川缓慢地沿着山向下移动。
words.en: A glacier is a large, persistent body of ice that forms where the accumulation of snow exceeds its ablation over many years, often centuries.

words.ex: The glacial landscape was covered in snow.
words.ex_cn: 冰河地貌被雪覆盖着。
words.en: relating to, resulting from, or denoting the presence or agency of ice, especially in the form of glaciers.

words.ex: The glacial epoch covered the land with ice.
words.ex_cn: 冰河时代用冰覆盖了陆地。
words.en: A glacial epoch is a period in the Earth's history when ice sheets cover large areas of the Earth's surface.

words.ex: The glacial drift covered the valley with rocks.
words.ex_cn: 冰川漂砾用岩石覆盖了山谷。
words.en: Glacial drift refers to the material deposited by glaciers, including rocks, sand, and silt, as they move and melt.

words.ex: The iceberg is floating in the cold sea.
words.ex_cn: 冰山在寒冷的海面上漂浮。
words.en: An iceberg is a large piece of ice that has broken off from a glacier and is floating in the sea.

words.tr: adj. 寒冷的；冷淡的；性冷淡的（女子）
words.ex: The water is frigid in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天的水很冰冷。
words.en: Frigid means extremely cold in temperature or lacking warmth or enthusiasm.

words.tr: adj. 冷冻的；冷却的； v. 冷藏；“refrigerate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The milk is kept in a refrigerated box.
words.ex_cn: 牛奶保存在冷冻箱里。
words.en: Kept at a low temperature to preserve freshness and prevent spoilage.

words.tr: adj. 极冷的；冰冻的； v. 结冰；冻结；“freeze”的现在分词；
words.ex: The weather is freezing today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气极冷。
words.en: If you say that something is freezing, you are emphasizing that it is very cold.

words.tr:
v. 使融解；解冻；变缓和
n. 融雪
words.ex: The ice begins to thaw in spring.
words.ex_cn: 冰在春天开始融化。
words.en: If ice, snow, or something else that is frozen thaws, it melts. A thaw is a period of warmer weather when snow and ice melt, usually at the end of winter.

words.ex: The ice melts in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 冰在阳光下融化。
words.en: If a solid substance melts or if you melt it, it changes to a liquid, usually because it has been heated.

words.tr:
n. 撤退；退却；静居处；
v. 撤退；退却；
words.ex: The army ordered a retreat after the battle.
words.ex_cn: 战斗后，军队下令撤退。
words.en: If you retreat, you move away from something or someone, often because you are frightened or because you want to be alone. A retreat is also a quiet, isolated place that you go to in order to rest or to do things in private.

words.ex: The teacher will terminate the class at 5 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 老师将在下午5点结束课程。
words.en: To terminate something means to bring it to an end or to stop it from continuing.

words.ex: The volcano erupted last year.
words.ex_cn: 这座火山去年喷发了。
words.en: A volcano is a mountain that opens downward to a pool of molten rock below the surface of the earth. When pressure builds up, eruptions occur.

words.ex: The active volcano erupted last year.
words.ex_cn: 这座活火山去年喷发了。
words.en: An active volcano is a volcano that has erupted in the past 10,000 years and is expected to erupt again.

words.ex: The extinct volcano has no lava now.
words.ex_cn: 这座死火山现在没有熔岩。
words.en: An extinct volcano is a volcano that is not expected to erupt again.

words.ex: The volcano had a big eruption last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周这座火山发生了大喷发。
words.en: An eruption is a sudden, often violent, outburst or discharge, such as that of a volcano, emotion, or conflict.

words.ex: The bomb left a deep crater in the road.
words.ex_cn: 炸弹在道路上炸出了一个深深的弹坑。
words.en: A crater is a large hole in the ground, typically caused by an explosion or the impact of a meteorite.

words.ex: The volcano spilled hot lava down the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 火山喷出炽热的岩浆流下山。
words.en: Lava is the molten rock that comes out of a volcano during an eruption.

words.ex: The village gets water from a deep aquifer.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的水源来自一个深层地下蓄水层。
words.en: An aquifer is a body of permeable rock which can contain or transmit groundwater.

words.ex: The volcanic eruption destroyed the village.
words.ex_cn: 火山喷发摧毁了村庄。
words.en: Volcanic is used to describe things that are connected with volcanoes or caused by volcanoes.

words.ex: The earthquake shook the houses last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚地震震动了房屋。
words.en: An earthquake is a sudden shaking of the ground caused by the passage of seismic waves through Earth's rocks.

words.tr:
v. 震动；颤抖
n. 震动；地震
words.ex: The ground began to quake during the earthquake.
words.ex_cn: 地震时，地面开始震动。
words.en: To shake or tremble, especially from fear or cold.

words.ex: The earthquake caused a strong tremor in the building.
words.ex_cn: 地震使大楼发生了强烈的震动。
words.en: A tremor is a small earthquake or a shaking or vibrating movement, especially one caused by fear or nervousness.

words.ex: The seism shook the city last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚地震袭击了这座城市。
words.en: An earthquake or earth tremor.

words.ex: He studies seismology to understand earthquakes.
words.ex_cn: 他学习地震学以了解地震。
words.en: The scientific study of earthquakes and the propagation of elastic waves through the Earth or through other planet-like bodies.

words.tr: phrase. 震源（地震发生的实际位置，位于地表以下）
words.ex: The hypocenter focus was deep under the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 震源位于海洋深处。
words.en: The point within the Earth where an earthquake rupture starts, often called the focus.

words.tr: phrase. 地震波，指地震时从震源向四周传播的振动波
words.ex: The earthquake wave shook the houses.
words.ex_cn: 地震波震摇了房屋。
words.en: A seismic wave, specifically a body wave (P or S wave) that travels through the Earth's interior.

words.ex: The explosion created a shock wave that broke windows.
words.ex_cn: 爆炸产生了冲击波，震碎了窗户。
words.en: A shock wave is a sharp change of pressure in a narrow region traveling through a medium, especially air, caused by explosion or by a body moving faster than sound.

words.ex: The earthquake was a sudden cataclysm.
words.ex_cn: 这场地震是一场突如其来的灾难。
words.en: A cataclysm is an event that causes great damage or makes a big change to something.

words.ex: The forest is a healthy ecosystem.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林是一个健康的生态系统。
words.en: An ecosystem is a complex network or interconnected system, especially one that involves a community of living organisms in conjunction with their environment.

words.tr: phrase. 自然界的平衡；生态平衡
words.ex: People must protect the balance of nature.
words.ex_cn: 人们必须保护自然的平衡。
words.en: The balance of nature refers to the equilibrium between living organisms such as plants, animals, and humans, and their environment. This balance ensures that ecosystems function healthily and sustainably.

words.tr: n. （地球或其他行星上的）生物圈；生态圈，生态层（指理论上可供生物生存的宇宙空间）
words.ex: The ecosphere is the part of the Earth where life exists.
words.ex_cn: 生物圈是地球上存在生命的部分。
words.en: The ecosphere refers to the global ecosystem, including all living organisms and their environment, encompassing the atmosphere, hydrosphere, and lithosphere.

words.ex: The biosphere includes all living things on Earth.
words.ex_cn: 生物圈包括地球上所有生物。
words.en: The biosphere is the part of the Earth's surface and atmosphere in which plants and animals can live.

words.ex: The proposed law aims to criminalize ecocide.
words.ex_cn: 这项拟议的法律旨在将生态灭绝定为犯罪。
words.en: Ecocide refers to the extensive damage to, destruction of, or loss of ecosystem(s) of a given territory, whether by human agency or by other causes, to such an extent that peaceful enjoyment by the inhabitants of that territory has been severely diminished.

words.ex: The atmosphere keeps the Earth warm.
words.ex_cn: 大气使地球保持温暖。
words.en: The atmosphere is the layer of gases surrounding a planet or other material body, held in place by the gravity of the body.

words.ex: Applications arrived in an avalanche after the job posting.
words.ex_cn: 职位发布后，申请纷至沓来。
words.en: An avalanche is a large mass of snow, ice, and rocks that falls quickly down the side of a mountain.

words.ex: The snow slide covered the road after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雪过后，雪崩覆盖了道路。
words.en: A mass of snow, ice, and rocks falling rapidly down a mountainside.

words.ex: A blizzard covered the town in snow.
words.ex_cn: 一场暴风雪将整个小镇覆盖在雪中。
words.en: A blizzard is a severe snowstorm with strong winds.

words.ex: The snowstorm stopped all traffic yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天暴风雪让所有交通都停了。
words.en: A snowstorm is a very heavy fall of snow, usually with strong winds.

words.tr:
n. 冰雹；
v. 把…誉为；
words.ex: The hail broke many car windows.
words.ex_cn: 冰雹打碎了许多汽车窗户。
words.en: Hail is small balls of ice that fall like rain from the sky. It can also mean to call out to someone in order to attract their attention, or to praise someone enthusiastically.

words.ex: The climate in summer is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 夏天的气候非常炎热。
words.en: The climate of a place is the general weather conditions that are typical of it.

words.ex: The steam condenses into water when it touches the cold glass.
words.ex_cn: 当蒸汽接触到冷的玻璃时，会凝结成水。
words.en: If you condense something, especially a piece of writing or a speech, you make it shorter, usually by including only the most important parts.

words.ex: Heat rises through convection in the room.
words.ex_cn: 热量通过空气对流在房间中上升。
words.en: Convection is the process by which heat is transferred by the movement of a fluid, such as air or water, due to the difference in density caused by temperature differences.

words.ex: A cold front is coming tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 一个冷锋明天要来。
words.en: A weather front where a cold air mass advances and replaces a warmer air mass.

words.ex: Warm air mass moves slowly over the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 暖空气团缓慢地移动过海洋。
words.en: A large body of air with relatively high temperature compared to its surroundings.

words.ex: She wears a necklace made of crystal.
words.ex_cn: 她戴一条水晶制成的项链。
words.en: A crystal is a solid that has a regular, repeating arrangement of atoms. Crystals are often transparent and can be used in jewelry or as decorative objects.

words.tr:
adj. 当前的；流通的；
n. （水、气、电）流；趋势；
words.ex: The current weather is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 当前的天气非常热。
words.en: belonging to the present time; happening or being used or done now

words.ex: The humidity in the room made the air feel heavy.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的湿度让空气感觉很闷。
words.en: Humidity is the amount of water vapor in the air. High humidity makes the air feel wet and sticky.

words.ex: The soil has too much moisture.
words.ex_cn: 土壤中有太多湿气。
words.en: Moisture is tiny drops of water in the air, on a surface, or in a substance, that make it feel wet.

words.ex: The earthquake caused total devastation in the city.
words.ex_cn: 地震给这座城市造成了严重的破坏。
words.en: The state of being devastated; severe and widespread destruction or damage.

words.ex: Dew forms on the grass in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早晨露水出现在草地上。
words.en: Dew is small drops of water that form on the ground and other surfaces outside during the night.

words.ex: The earthquake caused a big disaster.
words.ex_cn: 地震造成了一场大灾难。
words.en: A disaster is an unexpected event causing great damage, destruction, or distress.

words.ex: The earthquake was a terrible calamity.
words.ex_cn: 这场地震是一场巨大的灾难。
words.en: A calamity is an event that causes great harm or damage, such as a flood or a fire.

words.ex: The earthquake was a catastrophe.
words.ex_cn: 这场地震是一场灾难。
words.en: An event causing great and often sudden damage or suffering; a disaster.

words.ex: I take a shower every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上都洗淋浴。
words.en: A shower is a device that sprays water over you so that you can wash yourself. It is also a short period of rain or snow.

words.ex: The fishermen feared the tempest at sea.
words.ex_cn: 渔民们害怕海上的暴风雨。
words.en: A tempest is a violent and windy storm.

words.ex: The storm broke out at night.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨在夜间爆发了。
words.en: A storm is very bad weather, with heavy rain, strong winds, and often thunder and lightning.

words.ex: There was torrential rain last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚下着倾盆大雨。
words.en: Torrential rain refers to very heavy rain that falls in large amounts over a short period of time, often causing flooding.

words.ex: A droplet fell from the leaf.
words.ex_cn: 一滴水从叶子上落下。
words.en: A droplet is a very small drop of a liquid.

words.ex: The drought made it hard to grow crops.
words.ex_cn: 旱灾使种植庄稼变得困难。
words.en: A drought is a long period of time during which no rain falls and hence there is a shortage of water.

words.ex: A dust storm blew through the desert yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天一场沙尘暴席卷了沙漠。
words.en: A dust storm is a meteorological phenomenon common in arid and semi-arid regions, characterized by strong winds lifting large amounts of dust and sand into the atmosphere, reducing visibility and affecting air quality.

words.ex: The sandstorm covered the whole city.
words.ex_cn: 沙尘暴覆盖了整个城市。
words.en: A sandstorm is a strong wind in a desert that carries clouds of sand with it, often making it difficult to see or breathe.

words.ex: The car drove slowly through the fog.
words.ex_cn: 汽车缓缓驶过浓雾。
words.en: Fog is a thick cloud of tiny water droplets suspended in the atmosphere at or near the earth's surface which obscures or restricts visibility (to a greater extent than mist; strictly, reducing visibility to below 1 km).

words.ex: There was a thin mist over the lake at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 黎明时分，湖面上有一层薄雾。
words.en: Mist is a thin layer of cloud that touches the ground. It is less dense than fog and can make it difficult to see clearly.

words.tr:
n. 预测；预报；
v. 预测；预报；
words.ex: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 天气预测说明天会下雨。
words.en: If you forecast future events, you say what you think is going to happen in the future.

words.ex: The old woman predict rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 那位老妇人预言明天会下雨。
words.en: If you predict an event, you say that it will happen.

words.ex: There was frost on the grass this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上草地上有霜。
words.en: A thin layer of ice that forms on surfaces when the temperature drops below freezing.

words.ex: The typhoon destroyed many houses last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周的台风摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A typhoon is a very violent tropical storm that occurs in the western Pacific Ocean.

words.ex: The hurricane destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 飓风摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A hurricane is an extremely violent wind or storm.

words.ex: He works in meteorology and predicts the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他从事气象学工作，预测天气。
words.en: Meteorology is the scientific study of the atmosphere and of atmospheric conditions, especially as they relate to weather and weather forecasting.

words.ex: The precipitation increased last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周降水增加了。
words.en: Precipitation is rain, snow, sleet, or hail — any kind of weather condition where something's falling from the sky.

words.ex: The rainbow appears after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后出现了彩虹。
words.en: A rainbow is an arch of different colors that appears in the sky when the sun shines through rain.

words.tr: v. 使浸透；使湿透；使满；使饱和
words.ex: The sponge will saturate if you pour too much water.
words.ex_cn: 如果你倒太多水，海绵会吸满。
words.en: To saturate something means to make it completely wet, or to fill it completely with something so that no more can be added.

words.ex: The city has heavy smog in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市冬天有严重的雾霾。
words.en: Smog is a mixture of smoke and fog, or a similar mixture of air pollutants, which can be harmful to health.

words.ex: The diver submerge to explore the coral reef.
words.ex_cn: 潜水员潜水去探索珊瑚礁。
words.en: To submerge something means to put it below the surface of a liquid, especially water. If something submerges, it goes below the surface of a liquid.

words.tr: phrase. 海啸；潮汐波（常误用于指地震引发的海啸，实际应称 tsunami）
words.ex: The tidal wave destroyed the small village.
words.ex_cn: 海啸摧毁了那个小村庄。
words.en: A tidal wave is a very large ocean wave that is caused by the tide and can cause a lot of destruction when it reaches land.

words.ex: We heard thunder during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间我们听到了雷声。
words.en: the loud noise that you hear during a storm, usually after a flash of lightning

words.tr: phrase. 热带低气压；指风速低于热带风暴强度的热带气旋
words.ex: The tropical depression brought heavy rain to the island.
words.ex_cn: 热带低压给这个岛屿带来了大雨。
words.en: A low-pressure system with organized thunderstorms and winds up to 38 mph, often a precursor to a hurricane.

words.ex: The water vapor rose into the sky.
words.ex_cn: 水蒸气升上了天空。
words.en: Vapor is a substance in the gas phase at a temperature lower than its critical temperature, which means that the vapor can be condensed to a liquid by increasing its pressure without reducing the temperature.

words.ex: The sun makes the puddle evaporate quickly.
words.ex_cn: 太阳使水坑很快蒸发。
words.en: If a liquid evaporates, or if something evaporates it, it changes from a liquid state to a gas, because its temperature has increased.

words.ex: The wind velocity is high today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的风速很高。
words.en: The speed at which air moves horizontally, often measured in meters per second or miles per hour.

words.tr: phrase. 风向；风吹来的方向
words.ex: The wind direction changed from north to south.
words.ex_cn: 风向从北变成了南。
words.en: The direction from which the wind is blowing.

words.tr: phrase. 上层大气（指地球大气层中较高的部分，通常包括平流层、中间层和热层）
words.ex: The satellite moves in the upper atmosphere.
words.ex_cn: 卫星在高层大气中运行。
words.en: The highest layer of the Earth's atmosphere, above the mesosphere, where the thermosphere and exosphere are located.

words.ex: The museum focuses on the preservation of old books.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆专注于旧书的保存。
words.en: The act of keeping something in its original state or in good condition.

words.ex: The forest is home to a rich fauna.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林是丰富动物群的家园。
words.en: The animals of a particular region, habitat, or geological period.

words.ex: The forest has rich flora with many wild flowers.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有丰富的植物，有许多野花。
words.en: The plants of a particular region, habitat, or geological period.

words.ex: The rain forest has many tall trees and loud animals.
words.ex_cn: 热带雨林有许多高大的树木和嘈杂的动物。
words.en: A dense, tropical forest that receives a high amount of rainfall.

words.ex: The fish swim near the coral reef.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在珊瑚礁附近游动。
words.en: A reef is a long line of rocks or sand, the top of which is just above or just below the surface of the sea.

words.ex: The fish swim among the coral in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在海中的珊瑚间游动。
words.en: A hard stony substance secreted by certain marine coelenterates as an external skeleton, typically forming large reefs in warm seas.

words.ex: Rivers carry sediment to the sea.
words.ex_cn: 河流把沉积物带到大海。
words.en: Material that settles to the bottom of a liquid; matter that has been deposited by some natural process.

words.ex: The permafrost is melting because of global warming.
words.ex_cn: 永久冻土因全球变暖而融化。
words.en: Permafrost is a thick subsurface layer of soil that remains below freezing point throughout the year, occurring chiefly in polar regions.

words.ex: The children played on the big dune near the sea.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在海边的大沙丘上玩耍。
words.en: A dune is a hill of sand near the sea or in a desert, formed by the wind.

words.ex: He swims in the Mediterranean Sea every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他每年夏天都在地中海游泳。
words.en: The Mediterranean Sea is a sea connected to the Atlantic Ocean, surrounded by the Mediterranean Basin and almost completely enclosed by land: on the north by Southern Europe and Anatolia, on the south by North Africa, and on the east by the Levant.

words.tr: phrase. 新石器时代（约公元前10000年至公元前2000年，以农业、畜牧业和磨制石器为特征）
words.ex: People lived in villages during the neolithic period.
words.ex_cn: 在新石器时代，人们生活在村庄里。
words.en: The Neolithic Period, also known as the New Stone Age, was a period in human history marked by the development of agriculture and the use of polished stone tools.

words.tr: phrase. 埃及金字塔（古埃及法老的陵墓，通常为四面锥体结构）
words.ex: The Egyptian pyramid stands near the Nile River.
words.ex_cn: 埃及金字塔位于尼罗河附近。
words.en: A monumental stone structure in Egypt, built as a tomb for pharaohs, characterized by a triangular base and smooth sides.

words.tr:
n. 洪水；水灾；
v. 淹没；泛滥；
words.ex: The heavy rain caused a flood in the village.
words.ex_cn: 大雨导致了村庄发生洪水。
words.en: A flood is an overflow of water that submerges land which is usually dry. In the sense of 'flowing water', the word may also be applied to the inflow of the tide.

words.ex: He likes chemistry because it is fun.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢化学，因为它很有趣。
words.en: Chemistry is the scientific study of the structure of substances and how they react with each other.

words.tr: n. 构成；作曲；（学生）作文；创作技巧；
words.ex: The composition of the rock includes sand and clay.
words.ex_cn: 这种岩石的构成包括沙子和黏土。
words.en: The way in which something is composed or arranged; the act of creating something, especially a piece of writing or music.

words.ex: The decomposition of the apple took weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果的分解花了几个星期。
words.en: Decomposition is the process by which organic substances are broken down into simpler organic or inorganic matter such as carbon dioxide, water, simple sugars and mineral salts.

words.ex: The smell of perfume shows diffusion in the air.
words.ex_cn: 香水的气味展示了在空气中的扩散。
words.en: Diffusion is the process by which a new idea or product spreads through a population.

words.ex: The enzyme acts as a catalyst in the reaction.
words.ex_cn: 这种酶在反应中充当催化剂。
words.en: A catalyst is a substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction without itself undergoing any permanent chemical change. In a broader sense, it can also refer to a person or thing that precipitates a change.

words.ex: The enzyme helps to catalyze the reaction.
words.ex_cn: 这种酶有助于催化反应。
words.en: To cause or accelerate a reaction, process, or change.

words.tr:
n. 酸；
adj. 酸性的；
words.ex: The acid in lemon juice tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 柠檬汁中的酸味道很酸。
words.en: An acid is a chemical substance, usually a liquid, which contains hydrogen and can react with other substances to form salts. Some acids burn or dissolve other substances that they come into contact with.

words.ex: The alkalinity of the water is measured to ensure it is safe for drinking.
words.ex_cn: 水的碱度被测量以确保其适合饮用。
words.en: Alkalinity refers to the capacity of water to neutralize acids, a property imparted by the water's content of carbonate, bicarbonate, hydroxide, and occasionally borate, silicate, and phosphate.

words.tr:
n. 化合物；
adj. 复合的；混合的；
words.ex: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水是由氢和氧组成的化合物。
words.en: A compound is a substance that consists of two or more elements chemically combined in fixed proportions.

words.ex: The lab tests inorganic compounds in water.
words.ex_cn: 实验室检测水中的无机化合物。
words.en: Chemical compounds that do not contain carbon-hydrogen bonds, typically derived from minerals and inorganic sources.

words.ex: Rust is an oxide of iron.
words.ex_cn: 铁锈是铁的氧化物。
words.en: An oxide is a chemical compound that contains at least one oxygen atom and one other element in its chemical formula.

words.ex: The iron will oxidize in wet air.
words.ex_cn: 铁在潮湿的空气中会氧化。
words.en: To combine or become combined chemically with oxygen.

words.tr: v. 使中立；中和；使无效
words.ex: The government tried to neutralize the conflict by talking to both sides.
words.ex_cn: 政府试图通过与双方交谈来使冲突中立化。
words.en: To neutralize something means to stop it from having any effect or to make it ineffective.

words.ex: The iron fence will corrode in the rain.
words.ex_cn: 铁栅栏在雨中会生锈。
words.en: If metal or stone corrodes, or if something corrodes it, it is gradually destroyed by a chemical reaction.

words.ex: The ring is made of platinum.
words.ex_cn: 这个戒指是铂金做的。
words.en: Platinum is a precious metal, silver-white in color, that is used especially in jewelry and in industry.

words.ex: A sliver of wood stuck in his finger.
words.ex_cn: 一小片木头扎进了他的手指。
words.en: A sliver is a small, thin piece of something that has been cut, broken, or torn off from a larger piece.

words.ex: The wire is made of copper.
words.ex_cn: 这根电线是铜制的。
words.en: Copper is a reddish-brown metal that is used especially for making wire and coins.

words.ex: He uses aluminum foil to wrap the food.
words.ex_cn: 他用铝箔纸包食物。
words.en: A light, silvery metal that is used especially for making cooking equipment and aircraft parts.

words.tr:
v. 引导；领导；带头；
n. 主导地位；铅；领先；
words.ex: The teacher leads the students to the library.
words.ex_cn: 老师带领学生去图书馆。
words.en: To be in charge of a group, country, or situation; to guide or direct in a course; a position of advantage in a contest or competition; a heavy, malleable, ductile, bluish-white, dense metallic element.

words.ex: The bottle contains zinc to help your body stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子里含有锌，有助于你的身体健康。
words.en: Zinc is a bluish-white metal that is used in making other metals or for covering other metals to protect them.

words.ex: The coin is made of nickel.
words.ex_cn: 这枚硬币是镍制的。
words.en: A hard silver-white metal that is used in making alloys and is a chemical element. It is also a coin worth five cents in the US and Canada.

words.ex: The thermometer contains mercury.
words.ex_cn: 温度计里含有水银。
words.en: Mercury is a heavy, silvery-white metal that is liquid at room temperature. It is used in thermometers, barometers, and other scientific apparatus.

words.ex: He adds sodium to his food for taste.
words.ex_cn: 他为了味道在食物里加钠。
words.en: Sodium is a soft, silvery-white, highly reactive metal. Sodium is an alkali metal, being in group 1 of the periodic table, because it has a single electron in its outer shell that it readily donates, creating a positively charged ion—the Na⁺ cation.

words.ex: Ammonia has a strong smell.
words.ex_cn: 氨有一种刺鼻的气味。
words.en: Ammonia is a colorless gas with a characteristic pungent smell. It is used in the manufacture of fertilizers and as a refrigerant.

words.ex: He memorized the periodic table for his science test.
words.ex_cn: 他为了科学考试背诵了元素周期表。
words.en: A chart of the chemical elements arranged in order of atomic number, usually in rows, so that elements with similar atomic structure (and hence similar chemical properties) appear in vertical columns.

words.ex: Spectroscopy is used to analyze the composition of materials.
words.ex_cn: 光谱学用于分析材料的成分。
words.en: The study of the interaction between matter and electromagnetic radiation as a function of the wavelength or frequency of the radiation.

words.ex: He lost all his property in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中失去了所有财产。
words.en: Something owned; a possession.

words.ex: The atomic structure of hydrogen is simple.
words.ex_cn: 氢的原子结构很简单。
words.en: relating to atoms or the energy that comes from splitting atoms

words.ex: The atom is the smallest part of matter.
words.ex_cn: 原子是物质的最小单位。
words.en: An atom is the smallest unit of ordinary matter that forms a chemical element. Every solid, liquid, gas, and plasma is composed of neutral or ionized atoms.

words.ex: A proton has a positive charge.
words.ex_cn: 质子带正电。
words.en: A proton is a subatomic particle found in the nucleus of every atom. The particle has a positive electrical charge, equal and opposite to that of the electron.

words.ex: The radioactive material glows in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 这种放射性物质在黑暗中发光。
words.en: Something that is radioactive contains a substance that produces energy in the form of powerful and harmful rays.

words.ex: The miners dug deep to find iron ore.
words.ex_cn: 矿工们深入地下寻找铁矿石。
words.en: Ore is rock or earth from which metal can be obtained.
